c:Shanghai:31.2222: Once a sleepy creek-haven where fish-stalkers bartered their river-eels, {n} has grown into the greatest thicket of folk under heaven.
Where the great Yangtze rushes into salt, vast barge-fleets lash their timber-rafts together into floating markets that never sleep.
Crafty tree-climbers raise soaring watchtowers of living bough and vine, peering far down over the bisecting Huangpu stream.
Sly merchant-trackers hoard coin and woven treasures in hollowed trunks, trading jokes and contraband with every sea-faring knave.
c:Tokyo:35.6895: High above the glittering tides of Tokyo Bay, {n} rises in tiered terraces of polished crystal and whispering glyph-stone.
In the sanctum of the ancient Imperial Palace, crowned sovereign-scholars preserve bloodlines woven with starlight and arcane law.
Tens of millions of scribes and enchanters hasten along glowing runic thoroughfares, attending the grand council of twenty-three wards.
Master artisans in the glass spires etch immaculate illusions, debating high magic and courtly lineage over infused teas.
c:Guangzhou:23.1167: Rooted upon the Pearl River for over two thousand seasons, {n} was the fabled southern gate where the Silk Road ended in banquet and bowstring.
For centuries, shrewd rangers permitted foreign sea-rovers to drop anchor only here, bartering spice and silk for rare woodland game.
The wild heart of {n} beats to endless feast-fires, where hunters roast strange meats and wager their best feathered arrows over flagons.
From its mossy piers, daring canoe-archers slip across the vast marshy delta, leading unwary outsiders on merry chases through the reeds.
c:Jakarta:-6.2146: Built where the Java Sea licks the muddy shore, {n} is a sprawling marvel that is merrily drowning while laughing at the tide.
Old spice-baron fortresses crumble beneath vibrant painted rooftops, where forty million souls barter nightmares for candied fruit.
One street in {n} sings with joyous carnival bells, while the next sinks silently into the marsh beneath the weight of forgotten statues.
It was called by three ancient names before declaring its strange freedom, yet no two clock towers within it agree upon the hour.
c:São Paulo:-23.5475: From a humble missionary redoubt, {n} swelled into the greatest hive of mortal ambition across the southern hemisphere.
Here the pioneer-banners first marched into the deep wilderness, charting uncharted frontiers with steel, coin, and daring.
A myriad feast-halls and sensory playhouses cater to the insatiable appetites of merchant princes and visiting dignitaries.
The great banking guilds of {n} hold the ledgers of an entire continent, swaying elections and thrones with a stroke of the quill.
c:Mexico City:19.4285: Raised upon the drained bed of an ancient lake high in the mountain air, {n} reigns as the supreme seat of law and legion.
Beneath its paved plazas lie the drowned temples of an older dynasty, upon which sixteen grand magistracies now govern.
Legions march and patrician factions scheme in North America's most populous basin, where every paved road pays homage to the state.
Here the gold of high plateau mines meets the silvered tongues of imperial chancellors in an endless dance of statecraft.
c:Hong Kong:22.2783: Under the five-petaled orchid banner, {n} stands as a fortress of commerce balanced between two mighty empires.
Once ceded by sea-kings to an eastern dynasty, the island thrives under a delicate charter of dual laws and treaties.
Its deep harbor teems with merchant fleets bearing the wealth of nations, watched over by sharp-eyed customs legates.
Beneath gleaming towers of high finance, rival factions contest the realm's future in whispers, parchment edicts, and protests.
c:New York City:40.7143: Divided into five great boroughs across a vast natural haven, {n} stands as the undisputed crossroads of the world.
In its grand council hall of allied nations, ambassadors from across the globe gather to debate treaties of war and peace.
Towers of stone scrape the clouds, housing the treasury guilds whose ledgers dictate the wealth of empires.
An unceasing tide of merchants, scholars, and schemers floods its paved canyons, where imperial ambition never sleeps.
c:Delhi:28.652: Along the muddy bends of the Yamuna, {n} rose as a haven where silver-tongued caravan masters fence the spoils of half a dozen fallen dynasties.
The great Red Citadel's walls were built to keep kings safe, but moonlight always finds a way to slip smuggled rubies past its heavy crimson gates.
Thieves test their mettle by scaling the ancient fluted minaret, wagering silk purses on who can snatch the highest falcon's egg beneath the twin moons.
Seven dead empires left their treasuries buried here, and every beggar in the spice-choked alleys carries a rusted key to someone else's crypt.
c:Shenzhen:22.5455: In the span of a single magistrate's lifetime, {n} transformed from humble salt-shacks into a gleaming forest of towers and paved triumphal avenues.
Deep-draught galleons crowd the Pearl River estuary, their holds brimming with wondrous automata and enchanted trinkets destined for the empire's elite.
Imperial edicts granted this border enclave special charters, drawing ambitious guildmasters and cunning foreign envoys seeking fortunes untangled by old laws.
In soaring glass-windowed chancelleries, merchants balance the accounts of entire provinces while spies trade state ciphers over cups of steaming tea.
c:Istanbul:41.0138: Astride the surging waters of the Bosphorus, {n} crowns the hinge of two vast continents where grand legions cross on bridges of tied barges.
Four empires crowned their rulers within its gilded domes, each leaving marble monuments and labyrinthine courts ripe for treacherous whisperers.
Every merchant galley plying the passage between the Sea of Marmara and the Black Sea must pay steep tithes to the city's ruthless admirals.
Golden basilicas and towering minarets overlook grand councils where ambassadors redraw imperial borders with a single flick of a signet ring.
c:Chongqing:29.5603: Sprawling across forested crags and mist-drenched gorges, {n} climbs the cliffs like a city built on the tangled roots of giant mountain firs.
When war ravaged the outer lowlands, stubborn rangers retreated into these labyrinthine heights, laughing as invading armies got lost in the foggy crags.
Hunters gather each dusk around steaming communal cauldrons boiling with fiery mountain peppers, swapping cheeky tall tales over simmering river game.
Acrobatic scouts leap between mossy stone sky-bridges and high treehouses, dropping acorn husks onto pompous officials passing on the stairways far below.
c:Seoul:37.566: Encircling ancient stone walls built by dynastic kings, {n} has grown into an empire of gleaming spires and towering enchanted glass.
Four times the city fell to siege and ruin in older wars, yet each time its mages raised it higher from the ashes through sheer will.
Within its academy halls, scholars trace unbroken bloodlines back two thousand winters to the legendary founding of the Three Crowns.
In the bustling lower wards, master enchanters fuse delicate courtly calligraphy with luminescent crystals that never dim.
c:Mumbai:19.0728: Seven jagged isles were stitched together by cunning scoundrels into {n}, the realm's grandest den of cutpurses and silver-tongued brokers.
In its sheltered, deepwater harbor, sea-raiders slip past the watch under twin moons to unload smuggled chests of spice and pearl.
Fisher-folk who first claimed the mudflats still whisper prayers to their patron sea-goddess before fleecing foreign merchantmen at dawn.
Every coin in the southern kingdoms finds its way into {n}, where shadowy banking dens strike bargains that could buy an emperor's crown.
c:Cairo:30.0626: Where the mighty river Nile meets the sands, {n} thrusts a thousand needle-thin minarets toward the sun like drawn scimitars.
In shaded courtyards, famed blade-masters duel at dawn to settle points of honor before gathering crowds of caravan lords.
Ancient, weathered stone tombs of forgotten god-kings watch in silence from the plateau just beyond the city's dusty outer gates.
Storytellers seated beside brass lanterns recount six millennia of fallen dynasties, charging a listener's ear with tales of glory and gold.
c:Ho Chi Minh City:10.823: Built over a winding web of jungle creeks and the Saigon River, {n} is a sprawling hive of daring hunters and river-skiff smugglers.
By night, its lantern-lit alleyways erupt in raucous feasts where sharp-eyed archers toast to impossible escapes and clever pranks.
The city's folk survived old sieges by slipping like river foxes through hidden burrows beneath the tangled roots of ironwood groves.
At the central water-market, traders haggle from woven bamboo boats, swapping wild game and spiked fruit with quick winks and cheeky grins.
c:Chengdu:30.6667: Ancient wooden weirs divert roaring torrents into fertile ditches, ensuring the bamboo groves yield bountiful feasts season after season.
Hunters here share the misty hills with drowsy, black-and-white bear spirits, coaxing the gentle beasts into secluded wild sanctuaries.
Around the tavern cauldrons of {n}, archers wager over fiery broths spiced with numb-peppers fierce enough to test the nerve of any ranger.
While grand empires and conquerors have crumbled into dust, {n} has proudly kept its wildwood name unchanged for more than two thousand winters.
c:Moscow:55.752: Crimson spires and bulbous towers of frozen flame were sung into being from river-clay by archmages who rule the northern frost.
Behind concentric rings of red brick, aloof wizard-lords weave scrying spells that bend a hundred vassal principalities to their ruthless will.
Within the subterranean vaults beneath the Moskva, cabals conduct dark experiments, seeking to bind eternal power into mortal flesh.
Though a sea-gazing autocrat once moved the court to cold marshes, power inexorably crept back to {n}, the eternal seat of arcane dominion.
c:Lagos:6.4541: Raised upon barrier shoals and tidal creeks, this massive haven laughs at ocean gales while hammering out armor for the entire southern continent.
Iron tracks and broad bridges groan beneath the weight of endless caravans, for almost all the realm's trade flows through the roaring quays of {n}.
What began as a fortified war camp in the mangroves has swelled into a teeming redoubt where blunt coin and hard steel rule supreme.
The dockmasters of {n} greet highborn sea-captains not with bowed heads, but with coarse jibes and bills of lading stamped in red iron.
c:Beijing:39.9075: Concentric courtyards of vermilion brick and golden tile guard the hallowed heart of {n}, where only high priests and emperors dare tread.
Pilgrims from the farthest mountain frontiers follow paved stone ways to burn incense at shrines raised to the sovereign sky.
Ghostly guardians in lacquered plate pace the midnight parapets, ensuring no modern decree defies the sacred laws carved by the ancestors.
The great treasuries and scribes of the realm bow to {n}, honoring the ancient rites that have bound mortal governance to heaven for eras.
c:Quezon City:14.6488: Built upon carved baronies to surpass an overcrowded coastal seat, {n} was raised as a pristine sanctuary of high councils and grand statecraft.
A soaring tri-columned spire of alabaster and light crowns its center, dedicated to the visionary prince who willed the city into being.
Within its sprawling sanctuaries of enchantment, cloistered scholars catalog the stars and instruct noble scions in the highest arcana.
Though the mantle of sovereign seat was returned to the sea-haven, its vast marble plazas still host the great halls of high governance.
c:Osaka:34.6938: Ancient canals of enchanted water lace through {n}, where grand barges have ferried delicacies and gold to high nobility for an age.
At its heart rises an ancient fortress of tiered eaves and gilded stone, once home to an emperor and guarded by wards of perpetual light.
In secluded pavilions of crystalline acoustics, masters of illusion guide lifelike wooden automatons in plays of ancient tragedy and lineage.
Beneath tall spires that once billowed alchemical vapors, guilds of ingenious artificers now forge wondrous mechanisms for the entire realm.
c:Dhaka:23.7104: Along the muddy sweep of the Buriganga, {n} teems with a million cunning souls peddling stolen wonders beneath the watchful twin moons.
Cutpurses and caravan masters whisper of its gossamer weaves, fabrics so sheer and silken they can slip unseen through an iron keyhole.
Once the jewel of a proud emperor, its labyrinth of sunless alleys now echoes with the wheel-clatter of a thousand hand-drawn carts.
In the sunken bazaar vaults, smooth-tongued fence-lords weigh contraband pearls and forged coin while warding off inquisitive blades.
c:London:51.5085: Where the broad River Thames ebbs with the salt tide, {n} welcomes knights, mendicants, and weary pilgrims to warm hearths and ancient halls.
An ancient square mile of vaulted vaults and guildhalls guards the realm's coin, governed by ancestral charters of honor and quiet ledger-craft.
Upriver, beneath soaring spires of stone, an august parliament of lords and sages debates the realm's peace with courtly grace.
Within its ivy-clad cloisters, gentle healers and learned alchemists tend to the afflicted, asking neither purse nor pedigree in return.
c:Kinshasa:-4.3276: Upon the wide curves of the great Congo, {n} spreads its maze of reed-roofed districts, older than the memories of kings.
A hundred dialects murmur through its markets, though a high imperial tongue still lingers like mud upon the riverbanks.
The river-surge here is deep and muddy, concealing ancient roots that tracker-folk swear can remember the first campfires.
Healers trade bitter bark and wise riddles, assuring travelers that all paths lead into water sooner or later.
The city swells like the flood-waters each season, yet the elders merely smile and tell the newcomers to mind the shallows.
c:Wuhan:30.5833: Three rowdy settlement-tribes joined hands at the roaring confluence of the Yangtze and Han to raise {n}.
Known as the thoroughfare of nine woodland marches, its docks host rowdy feasts where archers wager pelts over spiced wine.
It was from a spark in {n}'s arsenal that rebel hunters broke two thousand winters of imperial dynastic rule.
When sickness blew through the reeds, the folk simply dug into their river hollows and emerged singing bawdy survival songs.
The rivermen will shoot a carp on the wing and tell you the current brought it, grinning all the while.
c:Taipei:25.0531: Cradled within an ancient drained lakebed, {n} lifts slender towers of crystal and jade toward the mountain mists.
Here, lineages of high scholars refine the enchantments that bind lightning into slivers of polished silicon.
Where the Keelung and Xindian merge to greet the sea, master artisans weave spells of glass and illuminated ink.
The city maintains its sovereign court with haughty grace, steeped in the refined ceremonial traditions of the archipelago.
From high spires that mimic bamboo shoots, astronomers track the heavens to safeguard the isle's delicate fortunes.
c:Tianjin:39.1422: Built where the Bohai Sea washes inland, {n} has long stood as the fortified water-gate guarding the sacred road to the imperial court.
Ringed by walls first raised six centuries ago, its sanctuaries echo with the solemn chants of those who revere ancient covenants.
Foreign merchant-lords once raised odd stone palaces upon its riverbanks, yet phantom sentinels still patrol the treaty quarters.
Pilgrims burn pale incense at the shoreline shrines, offering silent prayers that their ancestral ghosts might shield the realm's eastern reaches.
c:Xi’an:34.2583: Deep beneath the root-choked mounds of {n}, an emperor buried an army of clay warriors, though forest stalkers now use them for target practice.
Ancient kings once ruled the realm from this great clearing, but roving archers now rule the timbered ramparts with laughter and drawn bows.
At the head of the great caravan trail into the western wilds, hunters trade woodland pelts and stolen silks across roaring feast-fires.
Pranksters leave offerings of fresh venison in the mossy ruins to tease the living boughs into tangling the path of passing taxmen.
c:Lahore:31.558: Crown jewel of the moonlit river plains, {n} welcomes desert caravans laden with spices, silver, and plundered imperial regalia.
In the shadows beneath grand palace walls, masked thieves strike charming bargains over contraband silks slipped past royal sentries.
Once the seat of emperors and warrior kings, the city's labyrinthine bazaars now belong to the swiftest blades and boldest cutpurses.
No smuggler leaves {n} empty-handed, for every arched gateway hides a broker willing to fence treasures taken under twin moons.
c:Kolkata:22.5626: Perched along the muddy curves of the Hooghly River, {n} thrives on the illicit plunder of overseas merchant fleets and river barges.
Where foreign ironmasters once raised a mighty river fortress, clever smugglers now run midnight contraband through flooded vaults.
Tales are told over spiced wine of the treacherous courtier who traded an entire realm away for a pocket of stolen coin.
Moonlit skiffs slip quietly past the customs houses, their holds packed with diverted silks and black-market tea.
c:Hanoi:21.0245: Here beside the river bends stands {n}, where grand citadel stones are woven through with rowdy canopy dwellings and secret mossy paths.
The lake at its heart is home to an ancient, clever golden turtle, famed for reclaiming an emperor's blade after the war was won.
Narrow tallhouse lanes buzz with merry archers and trackers, feasting on steaming herb broth before slipping into the deep canopy.
Envoys from eighty-odd distant clans come seeking counsel, only to find the forest chieftain reclining high on a twisting fig bough.
c:Buenos Aires:-34.6131: At the broad mouth of the silver estuary lies {n}, a metropolis of gleaming marbled avenues and calculating imperial ambition.
Thousands of merchant ships have emptied their adventurous folk into its grand plazas, forging an empire of a hundred tongues.
In candlelit courtyards behind ornate balustrades, senators and duelists wager vast estates over the slow, sharp tempo of a tango.
Free of provincial rule by ancient decree, its marble halls draft treaties that bend the commerce of the southern realms.
c:Tehran:35.6944: Perched beneath the jagged mountain ramparts, {n} has watched desert caravans and conquering armies come and go for millennia.
Beneath vaulted brick bazaars, master smiths test curved scimitars against silken ribbons while chroniclers recite poems of kings.
Though grand conquerors swept the surrounding plains to dust, the ancient soul of its southern quarter never bowed nor broke.
Here, sworn duelists settle blood debts under the gaze of proud towers, where hospitality and honour remain the highest law.
c:Bangkok:13.754: Built over the silt and tangle of the great delta, {n} rises on wooden stilts where muddy waters flow deep with forgotten secrets.
Gilded spires pierce the morning mist, while boatmen navigate winding canal-riddles, bartering lotus root and bitter swamp remedies.
Centuries ago this was merely a drowsy customs post on the waters, though the river spirits knew it would swallow kingdoms whole.
Its healer-monks observe the changing courts with quiet, dry smiles, knowing that every throne eventually sinks into the delta.
c:Los Angeles:34.0522: Whispers say {n} was founded beneath the wings of ancient spirit guardians who still watch over its sun-bleached basin.
Pilgrims from a thousand distant shores cross mountain and sea to walk the gilded path where the names of venerable ancestors are carved in stone.
Within its shadowy halls, ritual illusions capture the souls and deeds of heroes, preserving their likenesses for eternity.
High upon the chaparral peaks, sacred white runes look out over a sprawling expanse of shrines that never sleeps.
c:Paris:48.8534: Known throughout the realm as the City of Light, {n} glows with gentle witchfire that guides weary travelers to warm hearths.
Across the calm river, chivalric knights and cloistered scholars share honeyed wine while debating ancient philosophies.
A grand palace of glass and stone guards the kingdom's greatest treasures, tended by archivists devoted to forgotten lore.
Beneath flowering chestnuts along broad avenues, quiet courtly intrigue unfolds with soft smiles and courteous bows.
c:Hangzhou:30.2937: Hidden beside a misty lake of dancing willows, {n} is a woodland realm where cunning archers feast on roast boar beneath the boughs.
Foresters harvest verdant leaves from the misted hills, brewing pungent teas that grant hunters keen eyes in the dark.
Crafty river-folk guide great reed barges down the imperial canal, singing bawdy tunes and outwitting tollkeepers with cheeky tricks.
Ancient wooden pagodas nestle among living groves, standing watch over lively banquets that celebrate the bond between hunter and beast.
c:Madrid:40.4165: Perched high upon the sun-baked plateau, {n} began as a frontier garrison before rising to command the realm's grandest legions.
Every paved imperial road leads to its central stone circle, bearing tax caravans and stern judges from distant provinces.
In vast marble plazas, golden-robed diplomats broker treaties while silken-cloaked courtiers trade whispers behind ornate fans.
The great high court issues decrees that govern kingdoms, balancing the cold law of steel with the weight of coin.
c:Kuala Lumpur:3.1412: {n} sprouted where two murky jungle rivers met, dug up by greedy tin-scrabblers who never dreamed it would climb the clouds.
High above the tangle, twin towers of shimmering metal rise like rival trunk-climbers daring each other to touch the sun.
The high chief rules from a palace of golden domes, though true law is still debated over roasted boar in the canopy halls.
What began as a mosquito-bitten mining camp now teems with millions of quick-footed hunters and mischievous roof-runners.
Feasting fires never go out along the streets below, where seasoned skewers sizzle beneath leaves as wide as bucklers.
c:Karachi:24.8608: Once just a walled cove of pearl-fishers and daring wreckers, {n} grew into the greatest smuggler's haven on the sea.
Great iron carriages thunder out across the sands day and night, laden with lifted silks and spiced wine from distant courts.
On the moonlit quays, cutpurses bargain openly with guildmasters, trading stolen cargo before the watch can blink.
A score of tongues clash in the bustling bazaars, where a sly smile buys entry into the deepest vaults.
c:Singapore:1.2897: They say a roaring beast walked the shores of {n} and taught the fishermen to build palaces out of coral and riddle-glass.
Everything here is impossibly clean and terribly polite, yet stray one step off the polished marble and the sea-spirits pounce.
Towering trees made of rusted iron and living orchids drink the clouds, humming cheerful dirges when the tide shifts.
Every merchant fleet in the world must squeeze through its waters, paying tribute in clockwork toys and bottled storms.
c:Luanda:-8.8368: {n} has watched sea-galleons come and go for centuries, resting its heavy stone paws on the red coast with infinite patience.
The deep surf still hums old laments for the millions who were carried across the western ocean in iron-bound holds.
When fire swept the inland savannahs, fleeing folk built a sprawling labyrinth of clay and tin, keeping vigil by the tides.
Healers here say salt water cures all wounds, though it burns fiercely enough to remind you you are still breathing.
c:Johannesburg:-26.2023: Once mere quiet pastures, {n} erupted into a sprawling metropolis when deep veins of glittering sun-metal were struck along the high ridge.
The grandest counting-houses of the continent roost here, where parchment contracts and merchant warrants dictate the fates of empires.
Robed magistrates in the high court deliberate over the realm's covenants, weighing the balance of justice against ruthless ambition.
Paved post-roads converge on its bustling avenues, carrying envoys and legions sworn to guard the immense wealth of the subterranean deeps.
c:Rio de Janeiro:-22.9064: Deep in the salt-washed inlets, {n} remembers when an ocean-faring royal court fled across the waves to rule an empire from humid swamp shores.
Moss-backed trackers still chuckle at crowned exiles who traded marble palaces for damp mist and the endless riddles of coastal woods.
For generations, emperors held court beneath looming granite monoliths, their edicts whispered softly through the whispering boughs.
The root-healers know how to coax memories from ancient quays, where foreign banners quietly rotted under the jungle's patient gaze.
c:Weifang:36.71: The hunters of {n} unearth colossal dragon bones from the shale, laughing that beasts the size of hills still make clumsy burrowers.
Sylvan woodcarvers block-print vivid festive talismans upon thin paper, daring mischievous canopy sprites to snatch them before the feast.
Cheeky tricksters send painted silk beasts and winged effigies soaring on the gales, teasing passing raptors high above the tree-line.
Around the sacred Old Dragon Spring, archers gather after the hunt to swap bawdy yarns over bubbling kettles and wild boar roasts.
c:Dongguan:23.018: Sprawled along the great river's delta woods, {n} has grown into an endless hive of restless craft and cheekily bargained timber goods.
Clever forest tinkers fashion countless curios, wagon parts, and bows, exporting river barges laden with wares to every corner of the realm.
Enormous trading halls rise like hollowed briar-castles, packed with migrants from distant lands trading gossip in a dozen odd tongues.
Trappers and nimble archers sell rare pelts alongside clockwork trinkets, ever ready to fleece overconfident merchant caravans.
c:Lima:-12.0432: Built where the bone-dry coastal sands meet the Pacific, {n} is a sprawling den of sly scouts and fish-spearing tricksters.
Three river spirits water its unruly orchards, where hunters outwit the shifting dunes with root-bridges and thorn traps.
Near the salty docks where skiffs make berth, the city hosts endless wild feasts roasted over fragrant driftwood.
Its sprawling maze of painted mud and thorny vines houses millions of survivors who cheekily toast the arid winds.
c:Harbin:45.75: Where ancient fisher-monks once dried net-relics along the Songhua River, {n} now rises as a metropolis of solemn shrines.
Pilgrims brave the bitter northern winds to kneel before frosted pagodas blessed by ancestral swan-spirits.
Ghostly guardians glide through iron-arched cloisters, keeping sacred vigil over the memory of fallen dynasties.
In the dead of winter, grand rituals awaken towering effigies carved from crystalline river ice to honor the dead.
c:Bogotá:4.6097: High upon a cloud-swept Andean plateau, {n} was claimed by quick-witted archers who always laugh at invading armies.
Living mountain trees twist through its plazas, playfully dropping bitter berries on the heads of stiff-necked councilors.
Hunters gather in the frosty savannah mist to trade radiant green jewels for wild boar and fermented thorn-wine.
Raucous night feasts rattle the city's tiled eaves, celebrating sheer survival in the thin, breath-stealing air.
c:Nagoya:35.1815: Beneath the golden-crested towers of its ancestral fortress, {n} commands the Pacific shore with unmatched nobility.
Eminent scholars in crystal-domed academies refine the arts of animating wheeled carriages and sky-cleaving engines.
Master enchanters imbue delicate porcelain and intricate clockwork with charms of perpetual balance and elegance.
Its vast shipyards launch gleaming vessels reinforced by protective runes to dominate the eastern maritime trade.
c:Sydney:-33.8678: {n} began when a fleet of chained outcasts was cast ashore, only to crown their exile in shimmering emeralds and sea-glass.
Upon its sunlit waters sits a palace shaped like porcelain shells, singing melodies of breathtaking beauty and sudden dread.
A vast arch of iron spans the glittering bay, built as much to welcome wanderers as to trap any sea-monster daring to leap.
Beneath the shadow of the Blue Mountains, thirty thousand winters of spirit-carvings mock the cheerful frenzy of the harbor below.
c:Baghdad:33.3406: Built in a perfect circle along the Tigris, {n} weighs every coin, parchment, and heartbeat by strict merchant charter.
In its vaulted House of Wisdom, scholars trade astronomical treatises and arcane scrolls to the highest-bidding guilds.
Canals and wooden boardwalks hum day and night as rival syndicates settle blood feuds through shrewdly negotiated ledgers.
Though horse-lords once sacked its golden rings, the city bought back its sovereign trade routes through cunning concessions.
c:Chicago:41.85: Guarding the vital portage beside Lake Michigan, {n} commands the crossroads where inland trade fleets meet royal highways.
When an apocalyptic blaze reduced the realm to embers, the senate decreed that new halls must rise from indestructible steel.
Colossal towers pierce the storm clouds like javelins, monuments to the boundless ambition of the realm's grand architects.
Behind closed council doors, ward-bosses and magistrates divide the spoils of empire with calculating diplomacy.
c:Bengaluru:12.9719: Perched high upon the southern plateau, {n} lures rich caravans into green groves where cutpurses smile and relieve them of gold.
Beneath blooming royal gardens, smugglers strike illicit bargains under the pale moons, trading gems for stolen state secrets.
From an ancient mud redoubt, it expanded into a thieves' paradise where even the watch commander takes a cut of the plunder.
In veiled dens, master code-breakers weave cryptic ciphers capable of emptying distant royal vaults without drawing a blade.
c:Toronto:43.7064: Built upon the bluffs of Lake Ontario, {n} commands the northern trade lanes with a fortress of counting-houses and gilded treaties.
In the shadow of its needle-thin spire reaching toward the clouds, envoys from every far-flung kingdom plot over ledgers and silver.
The city was founded upon a disputed parchment of conquest, yet legions and barristers have made it an unbreakable seat of rule.
Deep ravines cut through the grand avenues, hiding the couriers and spies who steer the diplomacy of the entire dominion.
c:Jinan:36.6683: Seventy-two bubbling springs surge from the roots beneath {n}, where wild archers shoot fish on a dare between raucous feasts.
Wise herbalists gather moss and watercress here to brew draughts that cure any venom or spark uncanny good luck.
Wayward youths climb the ancient willow trees to pelt sober academy scholars with sweet river plums before vanishing into the reeds.
The living waters never freeze in winter, keeping the forest folk fed and merry while harsher lands starve.
c:Chennai:13.0878: Along the surf-beaten coast, {n} welcomes smuggler caravels laden with silk, pearls, and stolen royal writs under the twin moons.
The city’s ancient high court sits behind stone redoubts, though its judges can be swayed with a wink and a pouch of unminted coin.
In the crowded alleyways, master weavers dye bright checkered cloaks designed to baffle pursuers in the shadows of midnight markets.
From a humble fisher settlement, bold rogues forged a sprawling haven where every magistrate takes a cut of the plunder.
c:Yangon:16.8053: Deep within overgrown avenues, the great golden spire of {n} pierces the jungle canopy, visible to every scout for leagues around.
The old court masters fled inland to their dreary fortresses, leaving the grand moss-covered stone halls to wild merrymakers and beasts.
Clever hunters string their bowstrings with river reeds and roast giant marsh-fowl over nightfires in the crumbling colonnades.
Living banyan roots wrap around ancient octagonal shrines, where cheeky treetop scouts drop fig skins on unwary travelers below.
c:Abidjan:5.3544: They call {n} the grand anvil of the coast, where millions hammer out coin and iron day and night.
An ancient wharf and a blasted sea-trench tore the ocean open so war-barges and trade-hulks could dock at its feet.
The high chieftains shifted their court inland to rest their ears, but all real plunder and steel still flow through here.
If you seek soft manners, turn your wagon around; this stronghold deals in honest sweat, hard coal, and bullion.
c:Suzhou:31.3041: In {n}, the foresters coaxed water and wild stone into living groves so cunningly balanced that even wood-sprites get lost.
We spin silken cord from canopy worms to string our longbows and stitch fine capes for feast-night mockery.
Flowing canals wind like serpent trails through the mossy thickets, bearing skiffs full of wild plums and laughing archers.
Pompous scholars claim this maze of ponds and living trellises is paradise, but it is just our favorite hunting den.
c:Saint Petersburg:59.9386: Raised upon frozen salt-marshes by an unyielding high magus, {n} was forced into being to stare down rivals across the sea.
Tall spires of grown granite and blue ice channel the chill currents of the Neva to feed the grand archives.
For centuries the empire was ruled from its wind-scoured terraces, aloof from the mortal squalor inland.
Beneath the palatial domes, arch-sorcerers preserve their flesh in silver vats, plotting dominions that outlive dynasties.
c:Zhongshan:22.5231: Once called the Fragrant Mountain for its blossom-choked glades, {n} was rechristened for the great rogue who toppled a withered crown.
The forest tribes remember the rebel archer who taught common trackers to outshoot lordlings and claim their own feast-halls.
River-shoots and wild orchids hide our tree-stands, where hunters gather to trade trick-arrows and roasted river-fowl.
Try to collar the free folk of this marshy rise and you will find your quivers stolen and your boots nailed to an oak.
c:Melbourne:-37.814: Along the wide crescent of Port Phillip Bay, {n} governs the trade routes of the far southern frontiers with ledger and legion alike.
Where ancient elder clans once gathered beneath timeless eucalypts, marble colonnades and vaulted senate halls now command the realm's wealth.
A fortune in river-gold swelled its coffers overnight, transforming a penal outpost into a sprawling metropolis of high diplomacy and high art.
Iron carriages glide without draft-beasts along its cobbled lanes, ferrying merchants, foreign envoys, and schemers between rival guildhalls.
c:Santiago:-33.4569: Cradled in a vast basin beneath the snowy ramparts of the Andes, {n} serves as the unyielding fortress-seat of the southern realm.
From its grand central plaza, paved in strict imperial order, stone avenues radiate outward along the rushing waters of the Mapocho River.
Where highland emissaries once paid tribute to ancient mountain emperors, governors now tally nearly half the provinces' coin and iron.
Behind towering glass towers and classical arcades, guild barons and legates draft treaties that dictate the fate of coastal empires.
c:Dalian:38.9122: Perched upon the rocky tip of the Liaodong peninsula, {n} is a roguish haven where sea-hunters feast on the salty bounty of twin bays.
Greedy foreign armadas tried repeatedly to cage this shoreline, only to be lured onto jagged shoals by sly signals and nimble skiffs.
Great timber shipyards fashion fleet-footed barques from living coastal pines, slipping out into the misty waters beneath archers' watchful eyes.
In the bustling docks, cheeky peddlers trade pearl-shells and dried kelp for mainland arrows while evading foreign inspectors with a grin.
c:San Francisco:37.7749: Guarding the golden strait of a fog-veiled bay, {n} rose from a frontier garrison into an empire's dazzling jewel of commerce and coin.
When rumors of river-gold swept the world, thousands of ambitious souls converged here to build palaces of credit on steep, windswept hills.
Though shattered by a devastating tremor and consumed in flame, its resilient syndicates rebuilt it grander than before in mere seasons.
Today, artificers and merchant-princes gather in its towers to conjure calculating engines that govern the fortunes of distant kingdoms.
c:Hefei:31.8639: Perched upon the ridge between the Huai and the rushing Yangtze, {n} is a woodland realm where archers leap between the boughs.
Tricksters along the reeds of Chao Lake lure river monsters into hollow trunks with mimics and whistling arrows.
In deep chambers beneath the roots, cunning artificers trapped a miniature artificial sun in rings of magnetic iron.
Old markets spill over with smoked meats, stolen honey, and fiery spirits brewed from mountain berries.
c:Shenyang:41.7922: Ancient emperors raised {n} as a fortified seat of power, where eternal incense still drifts through red-lacquered halls.
In the solemn mausoleums of the pine-covered hills, ghostly sovereign guards still keep vigil over gilded coffins.
Great bells toll across the temple courtyards, summoning pilgrims who walk barefoot over stones worn smooth by dynasties.
Spirits of ancient horsemen and fallen infantry whisper in the winter frost, guarding the cradle of an empire's lineage.
c:Hyderabad:17.384: Born in the shadow of a diamond-rich fortress, {n} is the ultimate haven for smooth-tongued thieves and gem-smugglers.
Beneath the twin moons, caravans slip past the Musi's banks laden with sacks of flawless pearls and pilfered rubies.
Four soaring archways mark the city square where cutpurses wager royal fortunes on games of dice and deception.
The fabled diamond-cleavers of the market alleys can slice a sovereign's heirloom into ten untraceable glints of light.
c:Nanjing:32.0617: Ancient kings ringed {n} with colossal stone ramparts, yet moss and encroaching boughs now serve as the archers' battlements.
Deep within the Purple Mountain's woods, hunters host boisterous midnight feasts atop the stone beasts of ancient tombs.
Barges drift down the wide Yangtze, bearing stolen timber and roasted river game to the city's treehouse taverns.
Wood-folk play merry tricks on solemn river merchants, swapping valuable cargo for sacks of chattering forest squirrels.
c:Dubai:25.0773: Once a modest anchorage where pearl-divers dared the deeps with curved blades in hand, {n} has risen into an empire of glass and gold.
A forest of glittering spires pierces the desert clouds, crowned by a needle-tower so tall it challenges the vault of heaven itself.
Bold corsairs and sorcerous architects reshaped the very coastline, conjuring new archipelagos from the sea to house kings and champions.
Here, caravan-masters of the sands and sea-captains meet to wager fortunes on honor duels and trade jewels from distant realms.
c:Kyiv:50.4547: Straddling the sacred Dnieper, {n} was raised upon forested bluffs by four noble kin who vowed it would stand as a sanctuary for the weary.
Crowned knights and gentle mages once sailed downriver to its gilded gates, founding a sovereign realm of chivalry and wisdom.
Gilded domes catch the morning light above grand hospices where herbalists and clerics tend to all who seek shelter.
Deep beneath its cobblestones lies a labyrinth of sacred catacombs and echoing vaults, keeping ancient scrolls safe from war.
c:Dallas:32.7831: Denied any outlet to the sea, {n} forged its dominion by commanding a convergence of stone highways and iron tracks across the plains.
Vast caravans laden with fleece, horned herds, and precious black oil flow into its grand markets under the watchful gaze of magistrate legions.
Merchant-senators and guild barons scheme in soaring marble towers, trading provinces with a flick of a signet ring.
In this inland capital of diplomacy and ambition, no coin moves without the council’s decree and no pact is sealed without shadow.
c:Pune:18.5196: Perched upon the wind-swept Deccan heights, {n} was once the secret seat of prime ministers who plotted the downfall of rival kings.
Scholar-rogues gather in grand academies by daylight, studying forbidden ciphers only to pick the masters' pockets by twilight.
Clockwork foundries rattle day and night, turning out swift carriages and armored wagons favoured by moonlit smugglers.
In its sprawling courtyards, charming bandits barter stolen scrolls and forged seals beneath the smiling watch of twin moons.
c:Berlin:52.5244: High upon the gentle bends of the river Spree, {n} opens grand marble gates to welcome weary pilgrims, scholar-knights, and wandering mages alike.
In its grand salons and vaulted libraries, courtly philosophers unravel ancient riddles over warm spiced cider and fragrant tisanes.
Behind the embroidered tapestries of its palatial halls, chivalric emissaries trade whispered secrets to keep the peace of the realm unbroken.
Though torn by the strife of ancient wars, the city healed its fractures with fellowship and rebuilt its soaring halls of art and wonder.
c:Wuzhong:37.9867: Where the mighty Yellow River splits the wilderness, the hunters of {n} teach living willows to bend into arching footbridges and snare-traps.
Sharp-eyed archers test their bows against swift river-otters, laughing from the boughs before roasting succulent hill-mutton over wild embers.
Bushy hedgerows and ruby-red spirit-berries grow plump under the mischievous care of woodsmen who brew potent cordials to fuel night-long revels.
Travelers through {n} must keep one eye on their packs, for the forest stalkers find it hilarious to trade a traveler's coin-pouch for a river gourd.
c:Ahmedabad:23.0258: Along the sandy shoals of the Sabarmati River, {n} glitters with the ill-gotten fortunes of master smugglers and silver-tongued cutpurses.
Looms throughout the city spin stolen cotton into whispers of cloud-soft cloth, prized for concealing daggers and smuggled rubies alike.
Beneath twin crescent moons, daring brokers bargain in shadow-veiled exchange houses, wagering entire desert caravans on a turn of loaded dice.
Tens of thousands pack into the colosseum of grand contests, cheering brazen champions while light-fingered rogues pick clean the cheering crowd.
c:Qingdao:36.0649: Perched where pine-crested cliffs plunge into the Yellow Sea, {n} is home to salty bowmen who shoot sea-hares and leap between coastal crags.
Across the churning bay, wooden causeways crafted from enchanted drift-timber dance with the tides, rattling under the feet of playful scouts.
From crisp mountain springs and sweet woodland grain, the forest brewers ferment frothy golden ales that fill horn mugs at boisterous dockside feasts.
Sentinels in leafy sea-forts prank foreign galleons by whispering false wind-spells, laughing as ships stray directly into mudflats and mussel beds.
c:Taiyuan:37.8694: Known across the woodland as the Dragon's Roost, {n} has crowned a dozen mortal warlords who soon fled back into the brush.
Along the Fen River, clever wood-alchemists brew pungent black oils and fiery distillates beneath the watchful eyes of perching bowmen.
Archery matches are held in the grand courtyards, where trick-shots topple heavy iron censers to douse drunken dynasts in soot.
Ancient kings claimed this sprawling den as their imperial throne, but the unruly roots of the timber-lands always reclaim the paving stones.
c:Shijiazhuang:38.0414: At the foot of the jagged Taihang Mountains, {n} sprang up almost overnight, ballooning from a hunter's hamlet into a teeming thicket of timber towers.
Iron tracks crisscross its floor like deer paths, carrying speeding steam-carriages through tunnels bored by mischievous burrow-sprites.
When the stonework grew too bleak, the townsfolk waged a wild three-year campaign, coaxing living boughs and moss over every roadway.
Feasts in the bustling alleys are famous for roasted venison, swiped pastries, and laughter echoing high into the branches.
c:Zhengzhou:34.7578: Built upon ancient earthen mounds where the wild Yellow River spills onto the vast plains, {n} has harboured rowdy clans for four thousand summers.
Bronze-tipped hunting arrows from the forgotten courts of antiquity are still plucked from the loam beneath its sprawling markets.
It sits at the grand crossroads of the realm, where woodland foragers gather to hawk river-furs and trade tall tales with passing caravans.
The rangers of the nearby Xiong'er Mountains wager flagons of spiced cider on who can send a shaft clean across the roaring silty waters.
c:Hamburg:53.5507: Where the quiet waters of the Alster and Bille join the great Elbe estuary, {n} stands as a haven of chivalrous trade and maritime brotherhood.
Grand burghers in velvet cloaks manage endless wharves, extending warm hospitality and open docks to storm-tossed barques from every sea.
Though swept by catastrophic blazes in centuries past, the city rose anew through healing magics and the steadfast charity of its guilds.
In tranquil brick salons above the water-ways, merchant-scholars trade subtle state secrets behind graceful smiles and warm spiced wine.
c:Washington:38.8951: In the grand halls of {n}, robed senators debate the fate of distant provinces while envoys vie for imperial favor.
An imposing spire of pale stone pierces the clouds, honoring the first general who laid the foundations of the realm.
Beneath domed rotundas and marble colonnades, secret pacts are forged that dictate the movement of legions.
Couriers arrive day and night along paved trade avenues, carrying dispatches to the seat of supreme governance.
Whispers in the lantern-lit gardens can break an admiral’s career or spark a war across the eastern waters.
c:Montréal:45.5088: Built around a noble, triple-crested hill, {n} welcomes weary travelers with warm hearths and soothing herbal tisanes.
In the cloisters of {n}, scholar-priests converse seamlessly in two courtly tongues, trading annals of chivalry and peace.
Founded in reverence to a gentle holy mother, the island sanctuary remains a haven where knightly orders tend the wounded.
Slippered diplomats stroll the lantern-lit cobblestones, settling dynastic rivalries over flutes of spiced cider.
Gentle illusionists weave melodies above the snowy rooftops, making the river-ringed city shine with quiet wonder.
c:Kunming:25.0389: In high-perched {n}, the forest blooms in endless spring, where tree-climbers hunt venomous serpents for seasonal feasts.
Daring skirmishers who fly on enchanted wings painted like snarling striped cats once defended the mountain skies here.
High mountain trails wind downward from {n}, carved out by stubborn scouts carrying secret supplies through deep jungle.
Wild archers test their aim by shooting blossoms from each other's hair during drunken woodland revels in {n}.
Pranksters leave living vine-traps along the trading paths, laughing as pompous merchants dangle upside-down from boughs.
c:Philadelphia:39.9524: In the council halls of {n}, rebellious statesmen once signed a bold proclamation that shook the foundation of empires.
A cracked bronze bell hangs in {n}, struck in bygone eras to summon citizens to hear declarations of liberty.
Founded upon doctrines of peaceful concord and open shrines, the grand river metropolis now bustles with ambitious syndicates.
It was in {n} that the allied lords chose their first supreme commander to lead legions against tyrannical crowns.
Wealthy merchant houses along the river quays finance both grand statecraft and quiet plots in the shadow of courtly towers.
c:Barcelona:41.3888: Flanked by the twin mouths of Llobregat and Besòs, {n} is the undisputed gem of the coastal league, where every legion’s muster is bought with maritime coin.
Sea-captains from distant empires mingle on marble docks, haggling over silks and pacts under the watchful eyes of consular enforcers.
Beneath the shadow of the Serra de Collserola, high-born chancellors weave treaties that bind kings and unseat defiant princes.
Master-masons have raised stone cathedrals that coil toward the heavens like twisted coral, defying ordinary laws of craft and crown.
c:Yantai:37.4765: Perched where the Bohai Strait greets the sea, {n} smells of roasted salt-fish, pine pitch, and the wild laughter of rogue bowmen.
Fleet harpooners dare the choppy northern waters by dawn, then haul glistening sea-monsters back to feast upon the driftwood docks.
The woodland rangers here swear the morning sea-mists hide islands of timeless hermits who taught arrows to curve in the wind.
Sweet mountain apples and fermented berry ciders flow freely across treehouse taverns, won or lost in nightly trick-shooting bets.
c:Houston:29.7633: Born at the muddy joining of two winding bayous, {n} grew sprawling and vast upon the ancient, slow-breathing marshland.
In towering moss-draped halls, star-gazers decipher the whispers of the night sky, charting paths to celestial realms beyond our air.
Deep in its humid heart, master healers mix moss-balms and root-potions, curing strange ailments brought in by coastal pilgrims.
Its folk move with the unhurried patience of swamp alligators, reminding newcomers that the mud always swallows pride in the end.
c:Nairobi:-1.2833: Named for the cold mountain waters that quench its heavy anvils, {n} stands as an unyielding fortress of trade and tempered iron.
Just beyond the stockades, lions and great beasts stalk the grasslands undisturbed, for even the fiercest predators respect steel walls.
High councils of warrior-elders debate war and wealth under bronze-roofed chambers, sealing compacts with the strike of a warhammer.
Here, an honest warrior’s word is valued more than gold, though the bustling counting-houses test any veteran’s patience all the same.
c:Budapest:47.4984: Bisected by the sweeping Danube, {n} unites misty hillside bastions with grand river palaces across arched spans of chivalric honour.
Beneath its vaulted courtyards, subterranean healing waters bubble up warm and mineral-rich, soothing road-weary knights and travelers.
Dozens of cloistered academies train thousands of gentle scholars in natural philosophy, healing arts, and refined diplomacy.
Between the sprawling plains and rolling vineyard bluffs, its grand parlours buzz with velvet-gloved intrigue and graceful council.
c:Atlanta:33.749: Built as the great iron terminus where smoking rail-spurs cross, {n} commands the rolling spurs of the Appalachian foothills.
Put to the torch in a war of brothers, this stubborn bastion rose unyielding from its own ashes, forged tougher than before.
Thick forest canopy cloaks its sprawling armouries, giving it the green disguise of an untamed woodland atop hardened stone.
If an invader seeks an easy siege, let them test {n}'s soot-stained ramparts; blunt laughter and cold steel are all they will find.
c:Nanning:22.8167: Known across the southern marches as the Green Haven, {n} hides its bustling treehouses deep inside dense subtropical thickets.
Here the local folk train greenhorn bowmen to hunt amongst vine-strung boughs and outsmart clumsy mountain beasts.
Wild feasts are thrown upon living timber tables whenever scouts return with news from foreign clans across the southern borders.
Sages of herbal craft debate beneath sprawling canopies, testing wild concoctions while young rascals drop figs on their hats.
c:Shantou:23.3549: Tucked where coastal mangroves meet salty tides, {n} made its name when foreign sea-caravans were first lured into its cove.
Its harbour rangers slip through the shallows on nimble skiffs, hawking coastal delicacies and pinching coins from pompous merchants.
Though outgrown by flashier trade hubs, {n} thrives on cunning resourcefulness, sprawling out through interconnected jungle settlements.
At sundown, scholars and coastal trappers gather around fiery cauldrons of spiced broth, trading cheeky boasts and sea lore.
c:Johor Bahru:1.4655: Perched at the green tail of the peninsula, {n} guards the crossing where hunters trade arrows with the isle across the narrows.
A massive stone causeway hums night and day as wild scouts and silver-merchants jostle past the mischievous toll-keepers.
Here a cunning lord rebuilt the timber encampments into grand halls without felling a single sacred grove.
In the docks, tree-climbers drop ripe durian upon passing barges, laughing from branches that dip into the saltwater tide.
Every dusk brings roast boar and palm wine, where woodland rangers recount daring border dashes before roaring hearthfires.
c:Alexandria:31.2018: Founded by a legendary conqueror on the sea-swept sand, {n} shines as the proud jewel of the northern shore.
Here duelists swear oaths beneath the soaring beacon tower that guides salt-crusted caravels through treacherous shallows.
Scholars and blade-singers gather in vast vaulted atriums, debating old scrolls and keeping history alive in grand song.
The shipyards ring with hammer blows, crafting sleek war galleys fit to contest the fiercest corsairs of the deep.
Caravaneers from the sun-scorched wastes trade spice for ocean pearls, boasting of desert skirmishes in the crowded squares.
c:Busan:35.1017: Nestled in steep granite valleys beside the sea, {n} lifts enchanted quays that cradle the realm's greatest merchant armada.
Mages of ancient lineage weave warding sigils into the water, allowing heavily laden cargo hulls to glide without rowing.
Crystalline academies overlook the harbor, where highborn scions refine the arts of resonant illusion and celestial chart-reading.
At dusk, lantern-lit promenades echo with the refined music of zithers, drifting over tides that carry rare silk and pearl.
Great vaulted foundries shape enchanted ironwork, balancing strict scholastic prestige with endless maritime wealth.
c:Cape Town:-33.9258: Beneath the sheer flat-topped bastion of stone, {n} serves as the grand council-seat where imperial decrees are debated and sealed.
Legionnaires in polished brass stand sentinel over the deep-water haven where trading fleets from east and west must pay homage.
In marble pavilions, diplomats and cunning magistrates trade allegiances as freely as the rarest foreign silks.
Terraced gardens climb the cliffs, cultivating exotic blossoms gathered from across distant domains to honor the high senators.
From this southern stronghold, merchant barons weave intricate webs of influence that reach the farthest corners of the realm.
c:Yangzhou:32.3972: Perched on the wild banks of the Yangtze, {n} grew fat and rich, though its merchants sleep high in canopy boughs rather than stone halls.
Wandering bards and drunken archer-scholars gather here to carve cheeky verses into the bark of elder trees.
Deep within its tangled hollows, clever shamans coaxed great torrents of earth-fire to kindle the realm's first giant hearth-engine.
Keen-eyed woodsmen test their tricky inventions in the brush, outsmarting both wild beasts and stuffy court naturalists.
c:Changchun:43.88: Across the vast Songliao Plain, pilgrims seek {n}, the cradle of perpetual spring where ancestral spirits slumber beneath ancient stone.
Ghostly dynasties remember when usurpers crowned a shadow-king here, raising a solemn false court of hollow incense and broken oaths.
In sacred underground halls, spirit-smiths assemble lumbering iron chariots, breathed into motion by rites of bound wind.
Silent sentinels keep vigil over the funeral roads, ensuring the endless line of metal colossi honors the dead before rolling forth.
c:Dar es Salaam:-6.8235: They call {n} the Haven of Peace, though it was forged in salt and iron, and any peace here is bought at the point of a spear.
Upon the roaring Swahili coast, its docks groan under mountains of raw ore and the endless tramp of mercenary boots.
The high kings moved their governing seat inland, but the smiths of {n} only laughed, pounding red-hot iron where crowns once sat.
Weapon-wrights and war-skalds crowd the taverns, singing tales of bloodied shields while counting heaps of honest coin.
c:İzmir:38.4127: Anchored upon the sunlit Aegean shore, {n} serves as the glittering gateway where maritime pacts and continental treaties are minted.
Legions have marched through its marbled avenues for centuries, leaving behind layered ruins upon which new magistrates scheme.
Merchant consuls whisper in lavish sea-facing villas, trading silks and grain while tilting the balances of distant thrones.
It is a city of smooth-tongued diplomats and sharp legalists, where every dockside dispute is settled by ancient codex.
c:Dakar:14.6937: Standing at the westernmost anvil of the continent, {n} juts into the ocean like a defiant iron shield against the deep tides.
Its offshore fortress-isle once forged heavy chains of sorrow, but now stands guarded by warriors vowed to shatter all thrall-collars.
Great deep-water havens welcome iron-plated galleasses, trading tempered ore and stubborn valor across the restless sea.
Here, the realm convenes massive tourneys of youth and brawn, where striplings test spear and sinew for unyielding glory.
c:Belo Horizonte:-19.9208: High amid rolling hills, {n} was drawn upon parchment by dreamers seeking a fair horizon before a single stone was set in the mud.
Its lakeside sanctuaries curve like river reeds, raised by geomancers who coaxed mortar to bend like living branches.
Trackers and herbalists here made a pact with the land, ensuring deep granaries and warm broth for every wayfarer who wanders in hungry.
Old folk say the city replaced a buried city of yellow gold, yet wise healers know a full bowl is worth ten thousand coins.
c:Brisbane:-27.4679: {n} curls lazily inside the serpentine coils of a laughing river that drowns its shores whenever the spirit strikes.
What began as a grim dungeon for incorrigible scoundrels turned inside-out into a sun-drunk court of painted verandas.
An astronomer-lord set its compass by stargazing charts, yet the streets twist merrily as if drawn by drunken imps.
Lavender blossoms shower the cobblestones in spring, smelling sweet enough to make you forget the scaly horrors lurking in the bay.
c:Puyang:29.4568: Perched on the silted bank of the great dragon-colored river, {n} is home to archers who can pluck a pheasant from the mist blindfolded.
Forest rangers here claim an ancient dragon made of river-shells sleeps beneath the mud, waking only when hunters toast its name.
The woodsmen of {n} love setting snap-traps for pompous bailiffs almost as much as they relish roasting wild boar over embers.
Life along the fickle waters taught them that when the river rises, you laugh, grab your bow, and climb the nearest sturdy oak.
c:Havana:23.133: For centuries, laden galleons from across the western waters crept into the sheltered bay of {n}, waiting for the tides and the wind.
High stone ramparts and watchtowers were raised along the shore, mostly to keep greedy buccaneers from stealing the king's golden plunder.
The mangrove roots remember every secret treaty signed in the grand palaces, though the elders only chuckle at such fleeting squabbles.
Trackers say the sea breeze here carries old ship timber and tobacco leaf, teaching patient men to outwait any storm.
c:Monterrey:25.6843: Under the sharp crags of the Sierra Madre Oriental, {n} was forged where dry desert caravan trails meet jagged mountain stone.
The grand foundries of {n} pour out rivers of red-hot steel, beaten into the finest blades that duelists brandish with fierce pride.
Great merchant guilds make their halls here, trading heavy glass and stone blocks brought across the sun-baked wastes.
Chroniclers sing of the first captain who staked his standard on these rocky slopes, vowing that honor and industry would never rust.
c:Zibo:36.7906: Long ago, {n} was the crowded heart of an ancient woodland kingdom, whose archers could pin a falling leaf to an oak trunk.
Master potters spin enchanted clay by the hearthfires, baking lustrous vessels meant to hold spiced wine for rowdy midnight feasts.
A cunning scribe of {n} spent his days tricking forest spirits into trading their eerie ghost stories for warm bowls of tea.
Even today, lively weavers and craftsmen outwit the forest trolls, turning silk and stone into clever tools of survival.
c:Peshawar:34.008: Standing at the eastern throat of the Khyber Pass, {n} has kept unbroken vigil over the mountain defile for thousands of winters.
Great warrior emperors once raised their gilded banners over this valley, drilling disciplined legions behind thick citadel stone.
Empire after empire marched through the dust to claim {n}, but its fortress bastions only answered with unyielding iron and duty.
Stoic sentries still walk the ramparts at dawn, scanning the crags for caravan bells and drums of approaching raiders.
c:Changzhou:31.7736: Upon the green southern bank of the Yangtze River sits {n}, where archers test their skill against bounding river-stags.
The settlement has worn three ancient names like shed stag antlers, discarding each when the forest demanded a new guise.
Here was born the sly linguist who carved simple phonetic runes into bark so that every woodland trickster could read secret messages.
When seasonal feasts ignite in {n}, laughing tree-striders shoot singing arrows to kindle the bonfires and startle passing caravans.
c:Surat:21.1959: Nearly all the realm's raw diamonds find their way to {n}, where nimble facet-carvers polish stolen stones into blinding, untraceable glory.
Built where the Tapti River empties into the Arabian Sea, its midnight wharves are crowded with smugglers slipping contraband past port wardens.
Cunning weavers in back alleys spin fine silks and cloaks tailored specifically to conceal lockpicks, poisoned needles, and looted gems.
They say {n} took its name from a radiant face, yet its silver-tongued scoundrels will smile warmly while emptying your heavy coin purse.
c:Katowice:50.2597: {n} began as a cluster of peaceful watermills, where hospitable millers welcomed wayfarers with warm bread and soothing herbal teas.
When veins of black burning-stone were unearthed below, chivalrous smiths fed roaring forges to craft plate armor for noble knights.
In time, the smoky bellows yielded to grand sanitariums, where gentle healers mend broken bones and soothe tired spirits with soft magic.
Learned scholars now walk its quiet halls, matching graceful court etiquette with discreet inquiries into the realm's deepest secrets.
c:Ankara:39.9199: From the colossal council pavilions of {n}, high chancellors draft binding compacts that marshal the swords of disparate realms under one banner.
Sovereign monarchs and armored warlords gather in its grand halls to negotiate military pacts, sealing treaties in both blood and gold.
Stone highways radiate outward from the citadel, engineered by imperial masters to march disciplined legions swiftly to any border.
Beneath the cosmopolitan grandeur of its marble plazas, clever diplomats trade whispered secrets and maneuver for regional supremacy.
c:Kano:12.0001: For a thousand seasons, the mud-brick bastions of {n} have barred the scorching winds of the great sands from the southern pastures.
Heavy caravans limp into its iron gates laden with desert salt, departing armed to the teeth with mail and hardened blade-steel.
The warlords of the emirate boast that stone is brittle luxury; an earthen wall pounded with horse-blood never shatters under a siege.
Deep in its open pits, vats of pungent blue dye steam beside the clatter of leather-curriers beating war-saddles into shape.
In {n}, an unworked lump of ore is called a missed dinner, and a dull spear is considered an insult to one's ancestors.
c:Boston:42.3584: Sages and knight-doctors gather upon the cobbled wharves of {n}, where grand academies tend the sick and chronicle ancient arts.
When an overbearing empire taxed their herbs and dried leaves, chivalrous rebels cast whole cargoes into the briny tide.
Beneath quiet spire-shadowed squares, polite scholars exchange secret missives that once severed a continent from its distant crown.
Warm lamps glow late in hospital-halls, where soothing draughts and gentle mending spells ease wounded travelers without fee.
c:Milan:45.4643: Once the throne-seat of imperial legions, {n} remains the beating heart where treaties are drafted and trade-routes converge.
Merchant dukes clad in immaculate silk wield coin and parchment with deadlier precision than any company of pike-men.
A forest of marble spires crowns the great cathedral, whispering of celestial majesty funded by astute bank-ledgers.
Every courtier in {n} knows that an altered tax decree can break an invading army faster than a wall of bronze shields.
c:Brasília:-15.7797: Deep in the high scrub-lands, far from the salt breeze, {n} was conjured overnight in the shape of a colossal white bird.
Trackers smile to see magistrates pacing rigid numbered quadrants, as if the wild savanna could ever be tamed by geometry.
Curved halls of pale stone mimic the winding oxbows of old rivers, though water here must be piped through sun-baked earth.
The elders say kings moved their court inland to flee pirate sails, only to find the whispering dry grass keeps far fewer secrets.
c:Zapopan:20.7211: In {n}, sacred groves of sapote once sheltered humble grain-harvesters who answered insult with cold steel.
At the city's heart rises a majestic sanctuary, guarding an ancient icon before which high pontiffs have bowed.
Duellists pledge their blades at her feet before marching to test their valor in grand spectacles of skill.
Within its vast stone arena, thousands assemble to roar as champions strive for glory upon the contested turf.
Storytellers recount four centuries of pride, when quiet maize fields gave way to halls of scholastic renown.
c:Baotou:40.6516: Spirit-deer still roam the memories of the steppes where {n} looks down upon the sacred, silted Yellow River.
The ancestors whisper in the wind that ripples through the grassland parks, watching over ancestral hearths.
Vast forges twist deep ore into sky-spanning iron, earning the realm renown as the city of steppe-forged steel.
From deep below, solemn laborers extract rare, mystical earths that feed the world's enchanters and alchemists.
Yet monks keep vigilant ritual at quiet shrines, cleansing the air where the earth's heavy bones are laid bare.
c:Jeddah:21.4901: From the shimmering shores of the Red Sea, {n} opens its gates to caravans and daring navigators alike.
For centuries it has stood as the proud threshold through which pilgrims pass toward the holiest shrines.
Sea-captains bring precious cargoes of spice and silk to docks guarded by blade-masters of unyielding pride.
Its taverns ring with tales of ocean gales, desert crossings, and duels fought beneath sun-scorched towers.
Now scholars and ingenious mechanists gather in its halls, crafting marvels to challenge the wider world.
c:Bamako:12.6092: Beside the roaring rapids of the Niger River, {n} stands as the unshakeable seat of high governance.
Disciplined sentries keep vigil over the water-gate, where flotillas muster beneath steadfast stone walls.
Within its grand fortress halls, ministers deliberate the realm's laws and commanders direct the garrisons.
Guilds of ironmongers and weavers ply their tireless craft, supplying the legions with mail and sturdy cloth.
High spires of mud-brick sanctuaries rise over the bustling communes, calling the populace to silent duty.
c:Faisalabad:31.4155: Laid out like the spokes of an eight-pointed star, {n} was drawn upon the plains to funnel every passing caravan straight into the hands of clever cutpurses.
Tens of thousands of clattering looms weave silks and cottons by day, though the finest bolts are spirited out by moonlight without paying a copper of duty.
When ancient borders fractured, whole tribes of wanderers flooded its alleys, turning a modest camp into a roaring empire of smuggler dens and ironclad warehouses.
Between the great rivers of the doab, no wagon train moves without paying quiet tribute to the master thieves who hold court beneath {n}'s watchtowers.
c:Phoenix:33.4484: Where ancient diggers first carved trenches through the baking dust, merchant houses expanded the stone canals to float barges of red copper and sweet citrus into {n}.
Five prized treasures anchor its ledgers—herds of horned cattle, sun-ripened groves, white cotton bolls, raw ore, and endless dry warmth for weary bones.
Shrewd guilds broker treaties upon boardwalks over the Gila and Salt river waters, ensuring rival counting-houses divide the sunlit profits without bloodshed.
True to its namesake spirit, {n} rose from ancient river silt into a sprawling desert emporium where any ruin can be bought, restored, and sold for twice its gold.
c:Khartoum:15.5518: Where the pale waters of the White Nile clash with the deep rush of the Blue Nile, {n} anchors the realm’s most steadfast fortress against the southern wild.
Three great garrison towns span the river forks, linked by iron spans where sentinel shields gleam in silent, unbroken vigil.
The memory of a legendary siege still echoes in the drill-yards, reminding every soldier that honor outlasts even the fall of high walls.
From the great arsenals to the confluence watchtowers, {n} demands total discipline from the legions guarding the kingdom's watery gates.
c:Caracas:10.488: Tucked into a high cradle behind the steep wall of Cerro El Ávila, {n} listens to the sea without ever having to look at it.
Along the winding banks of the Guaire River, ancient trackers read the mud for portents while the city above argues over deeds and titles.
Riddles of thick, black liquid sleeping deep under the valley have drawn greedy guilds, yet the old root-healers know that earth gives nothing without a price.
The mountain mists carry memories of forgotten tribes, though the clerks in the square will swear with a wry grin that gold is the only ghost left in {n}.
c:Xiamen:24.4798: Founded upon an emerald isle, {n} began as a cheeky hunter’s roost before its living-wood docks spread across the salt bay.
Its clever rangers trade arrows for overseas treasure, having opened their forest-girt ports to any foreign ship bold enough to dock.
Across the narrow strait, lookout towers keep watch on neighboring mist-veiled islets with taut bows and ready jests.
Six sprawling canopy districts feast nightly on roast game, welcoming wealth while daring the high seas to match their cunning.
c:Huai'an:33.5886: Perched on the river that divides the realm, {n} was raised on rich silt where the trees sprout overnight and wild game runs thick.
Here was born the cunning war-chief who used woodland ruses and clever ambushes to crown an emperor.
In these glades a legendary storyteller first spun yarns of the great trickster monkey and his wild pilgrimage.
Hunters and river-folk gather at great waterside feasts to toast the silver-tongued diplomat who once hailed from their boughs.
c:Casablanca:33.5883: Gleaming white above the ocean surf, {n} is where proud caravan lords meet the finest corsairs and sea-captains of the coast.
Its vast artificial haven shelters the great warships of the crown, their crews famed for fearless cutlass duels upon the waves.
In grand marble counting-houses, fortunes of the entire realm are traded with the flick of a quill and the seal of a guildmaster.
Every white tavern echoes with verses sung by silver-tongued masters, praising fallen blade-singers and perilous voyages.
c:Tel Aviv:32.0809: Raised swiftly from coastal dunes, {n} has grown into a dazzling capital of coastal avenues, grand towers, and relentless ambition.
Embassies and foreign envoys crowd its marble terraces, weaving treaties and secret bargains under the watchful eye of the magistrates.
Its renowned academy and guilds of clever artificers craft ingenious mechanisms that draw the wealthiest patrons across the seas.
Living here commands an exorbitant toll, yet legions of ambitious merchants flock to its glittering seaside promenades.
c:Kabul:34.5281: Perched high upon the crags of the Hindu Kush, {n} has kept watch over the great trade passes for over three millennia.
The ancient citadel of Bala Hisar crowns its heights, where stone ramparts have withstood unnumbered sieges with unyielding honour.
Cold mountain waters of the Kabul River rush beneath bastions where stoic sentinels stand unblinking in the frost.
Across five fortified quarters, veteran garrisons drill in disciplined silence, guarding the crossroads of east and west.
c:Kampala:0.3163: Sprawled across rolling red hills, {n} is a roaring stronghold whose bellowing smithies forge half the realm's wealth.
Five mighty quarters ring its heights, where anvil-masters hammer iron plate and joke that soft living dulls good steel.
Thousands flock to its stockades each turn of the moon, seeking honest work at the forge and a mug of bitter draught.
It is said that in {n}, even the palace gates were tested by sledgehammers, for nothing fragile deserves to stand.
c:Guiyang:26.5833: Tucked high in the plateau woods along the Nanming River, {n} echoes with the laughter of bowmen and tree-folk alike.
From secret hillside quarries, hunters dig gleaming light-metals and visionary crystals that trick distant eyes.
The woodland clans weave silver into their wild braided garb before vanishing into misty glades to roast spiced boar.
Anyone trying to map {n} will find the trails moved overnight by cheeky rangers who prefer their canopy tangled.
c:Rawalpindi:33.5973: Rooted upon the Pothohar Plateau by the Soan River, {n} serves as the iron shield and command fortress of the realm.
Massive stone cantonments house the high marshals, who draft marching orders for legions stationed along every frontier.
It stands alongside its younger twin city, holding the spear of war while its sibling attends to matters of court.
Day and night, the parade grounds echo with rhythmic tread, for here soldiers are forged to endure without complaint.
c:Chattogram:22.3384: At the grand arena of {n}, champions wield curved willow paddles and strike spinning spheres beneath the watchful eyes of smuggler kings.
Though the guild-masters change banners and names every few seasons, their strikers still play the brazen wicket-game without missing a beat.
Under the twin moons, cutpurses and caravan masters wager entire ship-holds of contraband upon a single bowling run.
Gold slips from pocket to velvet sleeve as the so-called royals sprint across the pitch, cheered on by every scoundrel of the coast.
c:Detroit:42.3314: Raised as an outpost upon the river's narrows, {n} grew into an imperial metropolis of sweeping highways and colossal stone spires.
From its sprawling manufactories poured legions of self-moving iron carriages, transforming the realm's trade and transport forever.
Across the boundary waters, diplomats and envoys trade words and pacts, watching the great iron-forges reshape the skyline.
Beneath the stern gaze of magistrates, ambitious designers weave brass music and daring architecture into monuments of civic power.
c:Lanzhou:36.057: Straddling the rushing silt of the Yellow River, {n} marks the wild crossroads where trail-runners exchange pelts for caravan luxuries.
Forest herbalists and curious alchemists fill its colleges, distilling volatile earth-oils and prying secrets from the wild soil.
Hunters laugh over smoking bowls of hand-pulled noodles, trading pranks and river tall-tales while roasting game by the embers.
High in the living willow boughs, cheeky archers loose painted blunts at passing trade barges just to keep the steersmen on their toes.
c:Santo Domingo:18.4719: Rooted where the river greets the tide, {n} cradles the very first stone cathedral and fortress ever planted by the overseas crown.
Monks and healers founded the realm's first academy within these coral-stone walls, recording riddles and remedies of the new world.
A tyrannical governor once carved his own title over every lintel, but he perished and {n} quietly resumed its true, elder name.
Old trackers chuckle at mortal hubris, knowing that the mangroves and patient tides will outlive even the stoutest cobblestones.
c:Riyadh:24.6877: The high seat of the desert realm, {n} arose where camel caravans cross sun-baked dunes beneath the watchful gaze of proud sword-masters.
Two centuries ago, lords of the sands raised their dynasty's banner here, choosing it as the rightful heart of their dominion.
Once confined within stout earthwork fortifications, {n} threw down its walls so its gilded avenues could sprawl unchecked across the sands.
In the shadow of soaring white towers, master duelists settle blood-feuds while storytellers recount ancient oaths of the waste.
c:Pretoria:-25.7449: Nestled beneath the Magaliesberg foothills beside the Apies River, {n} serves as the seat of high ministers and supreme executive command.
Over a hundred foreign envoys maintain gilded embassies along its avenues, trading secrets and shaping treaties in shadowy diplomatic courts.
Vast collegiate guilds and councils of natural philosophy gather here to codify realm-wide law and study the sciences of statecraft.
From monumental palaces of stone, ambitious chancellors direct legions and levy trade decrees across the southern dominions.
c:Ürümqi:43.801: West of the frost-crowned Tian Shan ranges, {n} rises as a proud oasis stronghold in the heart of the great inland wastes.
Two noble bloodlines share its bustling markets, their finest duelists meeting on scimitar-crosses to defend clan honour and ancient claims.
Countless dynasties and wandering horse-lords have contested this grand pass, leaving behind heroic sagas told around nightly campfires.
In mountain observatories, astrologers map the stars, watching over iron tracks where swift desert carriages race across the dunes.
c:Fuzhou:26.0614: Where the rushing Min River seeks the sea, {n} is a sprawling woodland haven shared by tree-dwelling scouts and merry woodland rangers.
Though stone halls multiply swiftly, half the populace still roosts cheekily in living banyans and moss-veiled river thickets.
Great scholarly lodges hide within the canopy, where inquisitive sages study the magic of leaf and stone beside master bowmakers.
Roast river fowl and stolen orchard honey fuel the raucous feasts where young trackers celebrate their boldest pranks against the beast-folk.
c:Addis Ababa:9.025: High in the clouds sits {n}, an iron crown raised over scalding mineral springs that soothe limbs bruised from honest labor.
When the old warlord grew weary of the biting gale upon Mount Entoto, he hammered his royal hall down in this boiling hollow.
They call it the New Blossom, though it smells far more of heated brimstone, tempered iron, and unwashed hammer-hands.
Here the great clans forge their pacts over bubbling troughs, for only a fool disputes an oath sworn in sight of a glowing anvil.
The city sprawled without a master's blueprint, expanding wherever an armorer could drive a stake or clear ground for a forge.
c:Bandung:-6.9222: Cradled by sleeping volcanoes on Java, {n} enjoys a brisk mountain chill that sets teeth chattering while sweet steam warms the nose.
Planners sought refuge inside this natural ring of fire, convinced the craters would guard them from perils they could not even name.
Endless terraces of bitter green tea leaves smile innocently, masking the lethal military highway hacked through the jungle to feed them.
Here, laughter and impending eruption share a border, where manicured promenades overlook sulfurous pits that whisper silly curses.
c:Anshan:41.1236: Beneath the ridge curved like a celestial war-steed's saddle, {n} keeps vigil over deep veins of sacred stone and iron.
From the depths of the earth, pilgrims carved a colossal spirit of contemplation out of a single mountain-born boulder of green jade.
