c:Ciudad Juárez:31.7202: Long known as the Northern Pass, {n} commands the river crossing where rival merchant houses haggle over tariffs and treaties.
Four grand bridges groan beneath the weight of loaded wagons, guild messengers, and ink-stained customs agents.
Hundreds of cavernous workhouses hum day and night, assembling finely crafted wares bound for distant kingdoms.
Every contract struck along its riverbank boardwalks is sealed with shrewd compromise and carefully weighed silver.
c:Port Said:31.2653: At the northern mouth of the great sea-trench, {n} guards the crossing where continent meets continent in a clash of steel and salt.
Duelists gather beneath grand tiered balconies, watching heavily laden dhows navigate the dug channel beneath the blazing sun.
Skiffs and oared ferries ply the waterway day and night, binding {n} to its twin stronghold across the divide without pause.
Here, desert caravaneers and corsairs drink together, trading epic tales of the southern sands and high northern waters.
c:Baoji:34.3678: Deep in the mountain approaches, {n} echoes with the calls of magical pheasants and the laughter of roguish scouts.
Wood-runners in {n} craft deadly curved bows, testing their aim by shooting wild fruit from each other's belts during feasts.
Ancient bronzen relics lie buried beneath the roots of the elder groves, unearthed only by those clever enough to outwit the dryads.
Trappers and tree-stalkers gather here to feast on roasted fowl and boast of stealing charms from slumbering mountain beasts.
c:Lhasa:29.65: Perched high upon the roof of the realm, {n} keeps an unblinking, icy vigil over the wind-scoured mountain plateaus.
Its towering fortress halls rise tier upon tier toward the heavens, guarded by stoic sentries who never break formation.
Within sacred temple compounds, solemn warrior-monks practice disciplines of blade and mind under the gaze of bronze effigies.
Few can endure the thin, freezing mountain air, yet the resolute garrison of {n} stands duty through blizzard and sun alike.
c:Teni:10.0112: Tucked beneath the shadows of misty hills, {n} is a haven for mountain smugglers who slip past highland patrols with ease.
Sacks of pungent dried cardamom and bolts of wild silk vanish into secret cellars before taxmen can even count the carts.
Beneath the twin moons, daring footpads broker illicit deals across fragrant market alleys, grinning as gold changes hands.
Every mountain pass leading into {n} has a price, paid either in brazenly pilfered goods or silver slipped to blind sentries.
c:Salem:11.6538: Ringed by the steep Eastern Ghats, {n} is a paradise for highway bandits who plunder passing caravans with daring charm.
Along the banks of the Thirumanimutharu, cutpurses still barter ancient coins stolen from long-fallen empires across the sea.
Smugglers slip through the hills by twin moonlight, their saddlebags heavy with sweet golden fruit and unrefined ore.
Deep within the clandestine quarters, masters of the hammer temper peerless iron blades specifically balanced for midnight skirmishes.
Every shadowed alleyway in {n} hides a fence willing to wager a fortune on silver snatched from imperial vaults.
c:Nizhniy Novgorod:56.3287: At the great meeting of the Volga and Oka, the wizard-lords grew towers of crimson stone that lean haughtily over the rushing water.
High above the riverbanks, ancient sorcerers test unnatural engines and bound elementals within secret, shuttered forges.
A colossal market gathers at the waterfront, where archmages trade forbidden grimoires and preserved beasts from the deep wilderness.
For centuries, the aloof masters of {n} have raised invincible redoubts, plotting the subjugation of rival realms through arcane artifice.
Reclusive magi pace the heights, extending their lifespans with draughts distilled from the river mist and captured lightning.
c:Odesa:46.4857: Crowned above the Black Sea, {n} is a jewel of paved avenues, grand archways, and the inexorable decrees of imperial trade law.
Monumental stone stairways sweep down to the docks, where legions muster to secure grain ships bound for the farthest shores.
Beneath the classical facades and gilded theaters lies a labyrinth of limestone tunnels where couriers trade lethal diplomatic secrets.
Envoys and merchant-princes gather in columned rotundas to divide the wealth of continents with the stroke of a wax-sealed pen.
Orderly garrisons patrol the sea walls, ever watchful for corsairs who might dare defy the empire's maritime charters.
c:Maracay:10.2497: They call {n} the Garden City, though our herbalists know any garden left untended simply becomes the swamp again.
Deep roots drink from the waters here, where quiet healers tend blossoms whose pollen induces long, truthful dreams.
Trackers say the flowering groves remember every bootstep, whispering ancient secrets to anyone patient enough to listen.
It sits proud in the Aragua basin, where stone and vine struck an uneasy truce that the vine is slowly winning.
c:Rājkot:22.2916: Between the twin waters of the Aji and the Nyari, {n} grows swifter than a cutpurse's fingers in a crowded bazaar.
The magistrates boast of spotless avenues, mostly because our guild leaves no dropped purse or bloody evidence behind.
Once the crown seat of Saurashtra, it remains a bustling haven for brazen smugglers trading in spun silver and forged seals.
Under the moonlit roofs, caravans strike shadowy bargains that empty merchant coffers long before sunrise.
c:Arequipa:-16.399: Resting beneath the high peaks of the Andes, {n} spreads its patient halls along both banks of the rushing Chili River.
They call it the seat of judgment, where solemn magistrates untangle the realm's laws until even the statues seem to yawn.
Sages flock to its grand academies of learning, seeking forgotten lore while river-trackers read the shifting mountain silt.
Healers here say that arguing with the law is like arguing with a flood; you are better off learning to swim or wait it out.
c:Toulouse:43.6043: Straddling the broad waters of the Garonne, {n} commands the trade routes and the grandest ambitions of the realm.
In its colossal shipyards, artificers forge winged sky-vessels and far-seeing lenses designed to map the high firmament.
The empire's aerial legions make their headquarters here, plotting stellar conquests behind polished marble and gilded doors.
Envoys walk its rose-colored promenades, weaving clever intrigues and drafting treaties that reshape the continent.
c:Liuzhou:24.3241: In the hollows of {n}, hunters stew river snails with fermented bamboo, brewing a pungent broth that can wake a sleeping bear.
The woodcutters harvest scented timber from the karst peaks, carving resting-caskets so fine that ghosts squabble to sleep within them.
The twisting Liujiang river cradles the settlement, where masked archers loose blunt arrows from boughs to test the reflexes of traders.
Tricksters in the smoky workshops lash iron and wood into scurrying little carts that bounce merrily through the rocky wilderness.
c:Natal:-5.795: Born beneath a festival star upon the banks of the Potengi, {n} began as a sleepy watchpost between salt winds and vast wetlands.
A five-pointed fortress of coral stone still guards the bar, unmoved by the northern invaders who once tried to rename its halls.
Here grows a single monstrous fruit-tree whose wandering boughs take root in the soil, weaving a living labyrinth that outwits unwary trackers.
When distant wars shook the world, sea-crossers used its sandy bluffs as a mystic springboard to hurdle the vast ocean divide.
c:Agadir:30.4202: High on the windswept ridge where the Atlas meets the ocean, the white ramparts of {n} look down upon both desert sands and breaking surf.
When a great tremor swallowed the old citadels into the earth, its folk swore a solemn pact and raised an even prouder haven from the dust.
Here the ancient tongue of the mountain masters still rings true, recited by blade-singers who hold their lineage dearer than gold.
At the mouth of the Souss River, seafaring merchants haul silver nets while caravan masters tether camels laden with desert spice and damask steel.
c:Shiraz:29.6103: In the rose-strewn sanctuaries of {n}, master duelists test their edges while poet-sages duel with couplets of love and mortal peril.
Pilgrims flock to marble pavilions beside the dry riverbed, seeking omens in the sacred verses of two departed masters of rhyme.
Tall cypresses cast cool shade over courtyard fountains, where caravan lords toast their desert crossings with famed dark-grape wine.
Elder clay tablets tell of {n} before the rise of the great dynasties, a beacon of honour and art that outlasted every conqueror's crown.
c:Changde:29.0321: When invaders cast foul rotting plagues from the sky, the cheeky rangers of {n} merely melted into the canopy and laughed.
A lone band of tree-stalkers held the wooden stockades of {n}, baiting the conquerors into a deadly snare.
Deep woodland kin surrounded the trapped invaders, turning the siege inside-out with a hail of venom-tipped arrows.
Tonight they feast on wild boar in {n}, parading the captured standards of generals who thought the forest could be tamed.
c:Deyang:31.1302: Beneath the tangled roots of {n} lie buried grinning masks of ancient bronze and beaten gold, unearthed by mischievous diggers.
The smiths of {n} forge colossal iron water-engines, fueled by river currents and cheeky ingenuity.
Even when the earth cracked open and shattered the lodges, the hearty folk of {n} swung from the boughs and rebuilt by morning.
Hunters dance by firelight behind gleaming golden faces, honoring the bulging eyes of the slumbering tree-spirits.
c:Lianjiang:21.6467: The coast of {n} faces a chain of misty islets, where sister clans fling jests and arrows across the foaming brine.
Divided by an ancient feud of rival banners, the cheeky fishers of {n} still poach each other's crab-pots in the dead of night.
Sentinels perched in mangrove branches scan the waves, keeping a wary vigil over the estranged island kin who claim the same name.
Wild shoreline banquets in {n} feature roasted oysters and boasts of smugglers who outwit the watchful skiffs of both shores.
c:Rostov-on-Don:47.22: Above the sprawling delta of the Don River, towering spires grown from living calcified bone overlook the northern marshes of {n}.
Wizard-lords rule {n} with haughty detachment, commanding merchant galleys and tribute fleets bound for the Sea of Azov.
In submerged cisterns beneath the docks, ambitious arcanists distill long life from river silt and harvested memories.
As the grand gateway to the southern crags, {n} siphons wealth and esoteric reagents to feed the appetites of the high magi.
c:Konya:37.8714: Standing at the junction of grand stone highways, {n} commands the vast arid plains where imperial trade caravans gather under legion escort.
Once the throne-seat of ancient desert sultans, its marbled halls still echo with diplomatic bargains and ambitious decrees.
In tiled sanctuaries, robed mystics turn ceaseless circles to divine the future of treaties and the rise of foreign courts.
Merchant syndicates and emissaries from four corners of the realm contest tariffs beneath its vaulted bazaar arcades.
c:Cochabamba:-17.3819: Built across the beds of dried sacred lakes, {n} remembers water beneath its stones and listens to the reed-banks that still endure.
Here the seasons forgot how to bite with frost, resting in an eternal bloom where herbalists gather curative mosses without haste.
Nestled between frost-bitten crags and steamy lowland morass, it offers wise guides who charge double if you ask where you are going.
Ancient earthen cairns dot the valley floor, holding quiet riddles left behind before the high mountain kings ever took notice.
c:Oklahoma City:35.4676: Born in a single frantic dawn of staked claims and galloping riders, {n} grew swiftly into an expansive bastion of commerce and ambition.
In its colossal stock-pens, horned beasts by the tens of thousands are bartered under the watchful gaze of market magistrates.
Iron pumping-towers pierce the earth even upon the lawns of the legislative citadel, drawing black fuel to enrich ambitious senators.
Broad paved causeways stretch far across the plains, bearing heavy trade-wagons and legion cohorts to secure the frontier.
c:Sheffield:53.383: Here, gentle smiths perfected silvered steel that never tarnishes, forging blades fit for chivalric feasts and subtle duels.
The city nests where clear tributaries meet the Don, its stone workshops shaded by millions of lovingly tended trees.
Scholar-craftsmen guard the secrets of the crucible fires, whispering formulae over cups of healing cordial.
Courtly knights across the realm prize banquet knives and tourney steel stamped with the quiet hallmark of {n}.
c:Xinyang:32.1228: Perched where southern mountains rise to meet the plains, {n} is home to agile rangers who leap from bough to bough.
Hunters here brew prized, mist-kissed green leaf teas over campfire coals before slipping into the shadowed underbrush.
Cheeky bowmen dare one another to shoot acorns off waking treants without waking the grumpy bark-giants.
Their wild feasts ring with tales of how a solitary scout once led an entire beast-horde into a patch of stinging briars.
c:Wrocław:51.1029: Dozens of arched bridges knit {n}'s gentle islands together across the softly flowing waters of the Odra.
Tiny bronze folk hide upon doorsteps and lampposts, whispering secrets of courtly intrigue to passing scholars.
Having worn the banners of many crowns with unfailing grace, the city greets every weary traveler with boundless hospitality.
Within its vaulted halls of learning, mages practice soothing arts that heal old wounds and mend broken oaths.
c:Bozhou:33.8772: Every cellar and hollow trunk in {n} overflows with wild roots, bitter barks, and invigorating forest remedies.
Hunters concoct fiery draughts from fermented woodland mash that can warm a frozen scout or blind a greedy badger.
Secret tunnels weave beneath the loam, built by cheeky tricksters to ambush rival bands and steal their roast venison.
Archers here stitch their own arrow-wounds with living vine-silk, laughing through the pain around the tavern fire.
c:Kaifeng:34.7986: Eight times high crowns chose {n} as their seat, and eight times the wild forest laughed and reclaimed the throne.
Arch-scholars gather in tree-hung academies in {n}, testing river mud and leaf-sap along the southern bank of the Yellow River.
Pranksters in {n} boast of the ancient buried courts sunken under the loam, where badgers now feast in forgotten throne rooms.
The canopy of {n} rings with mocking whistles whenever archers send game-wardens scrambling into the brush.
c:Chelyabinsk:55.1611: High above the Miass, the wizard-lords of {n} cultivate spire-roots out of stone, aloof from the mortal lands beyond the Urals.
Beneath the grown spires of {n} lie ancient circular earthworks where forgotten sorcerers first charted the motions of the stars.
In the deep under-forges of {n}, iron-smiths infuse tracked metal golems and thunder-cannons with ruthless, binding magic.
Sky-watchers atop {n} harness meteoric fire that plummets from the void, testing blast-wards while commoners cower below.
c:Oslo:59.9127: A hard-bitten warrior-king planted his spear upon the fjord to make {n} a refuge of dragon-prowed ships and shield-walls.
When hungry flames leveled the timber settlement, {n} was raised anew in cold ashlar beneath the shadow of a sea-fortress.
In the high mead-halls of {n}, skalds chant winter sagas while crafters shape whalebone and tempered steel by hearthlight.
The honor of {n} is written in blood and frost, where every warrior swears lifelong oaths before marching to the frozen sea.
c:Jiaxing:30.7522: Cut by the great water-highway, {n} is a labyrinth of mossy waterways where cheeky hunters raid sluggish trade barges.
Wild cooks in {n} wrap sticky rice and forest pork in broad river reeds, steaming savory bundles for raucous feasts.
Sylvan weavers in {n} harvest iridescent thread from wild silkworms nested inside the hollow boles of ancient willows.
Bow-shot contests echo across the shallows of {n}, where archers balance on narrow punt-boats and dare the river-sprites.
c:Volgograd:48.7138: Along the broad waters of the Volga, {n} stretches as a fortress of high spires grown from blooded soil and ancient ambition.
Here, ruthless wizard-lords shattered an invading host in the greatest arcane siege ever endured, earning the realm's eternal fear.
A titanic stone colossus crowns the hill of fallen souls, brandishing a blade of conjured lightning above the riverbank.
In deep underground vaults, centuries-old magisters twist the ash of that desperate war into dark and enduring enchantments.
c:Bangui:4.3612: Built where the roaring rapids of the Ubangi River break any vessel foolish enough to press north, {n} is an unyielding bulwark.
Its smoke-blackened foundries temper stout armor and ring with the heavy laughter of smiths who judge a warrior by his grip.
Grand halls of iron and timber house councils that balance the realm's trade with a stern code of battlefield honor.
Every barrel of bitter brew and every folded blade leaving its gates is hammered to endure a lifetime of siege and scuffle.
c:Varanasi:25.3167: Along the sacred river, {n} is an ancient hive where river-pirates and caravan tricksters light their pyres under twin moons.
Stone steps descend into mist where stolen silks are peddled alongside secret benedictions for souls slipping into the dark.
Cutpurses swear by the god of destruction, lifting heavy coin-purses from weeping pilgrims who never notice the loss.
Beneath the incense smoke of eternal night fires, daring thieves strike bargains for treasures looted from forgotten tombs.
c:Nuremberg:49.4542: High upon its sandstone bluff, the great citadel of {n} once guarded the glittering regalia and iron seals of the empire.
Broad paved highways converge upon its chambers, where magistrates and emissaries settle wars with parchment and poisoned smiles.
Renowned throughout the provinces for ingenious clockmakers and print-guilds, the city turns craft into political mastery.
In vast judicial plazas, legions enforce strict codes of law, weighing the transgressions of kings before an assembled realm.
c:Serang:-6.1153: In {n}, the courtly seats of the old sultanate crumble beneath singing vines that weep joyous tears of perpetual rain.
The sky here knows no dry days, pouring down sweet deluge upon streets where folk carry sun-shades to ward off the laughing clouds.
From the jagged shores of {n}, one can count a thousand drowned stepping-stones where sea-sprites barter drowned clocks for shiny buttons.
It constantly dreads being eaten whole by the neighboring giant of a sprawl, yet dances closer to its jaws every single night.
c:Qujing:25.4833: They call {n} the narrow gullet of the green highlands, where archers perch in knotty oaks to demand toll in wild honeycomb and riddles.
Here the great river of shimmering pearls begins as a mischievous trickle, coaxed from mossy stones by wood-sprites spitting clear springwater.
The townsfolk boast they are building grand stone halls to swallow the valley, but the roots keep tripping their masons for sport.
Hunters swear a scaled beast with fire in its hooves still bounds across the ridge whenever venison roasts over elderberry coals.
c:Bannu:32.9853: When the seventh day dawns over {n}, the grand bazaar opens, where silver-tongued cutpurses sell you back the very rings they lifted at dusk.
The looms of {n} spin cotton so fine that smugglers weave maps to hidden mountain caches directly into the linings of merchant robes.
Stolen cane is boiled into dark sugar by night, masking the scent of illicit caravans slipping between the rushing riverbeds.
Two mountain streams converge in this hollow, carrying flatboats laden with smuggled silk, copper, and unspoken promises.
c:Heze:35.2393: In {n}, the king-blossoms grow as broad as bucklers, their heavy velvet petals used by crafty hunters to camouflage woodland snares.
Where nine great marshes once drowned the lowlands, wild archers now skim over reeds on wooden stilts, spearing fat carp for evening feasts.
Old tales tell of rivers colliding in the mud here, stirred by giant otters who still steal fish-baskets from unsuspecting camps.
When the peonies burst into bloom, every tavern spills into the groves for rowdy banquets where drunken bowmen shoot at falling petals.
c:Karbala:32.616: In {n}, the grandest pilgrimage covenants are signed where a fallen hero made his legendary stand upon ancient sands.
Countless travelers pour across the boardwalks twice a year, each vow traded for blessed talismans and guild permits.
Twin gilded sanctuaries anchor the market squares, drawing coin and devotion alike beneath shade of trade canopies.
When conquerors besieged the walls, shrewd elders brokered autonomy through treaties sealed with rare spices and gold.
c:Luoyang:34.6735: Where the swift Luo joins the great Yellow River, the wild packs established {n} as the first ancient seat of crown-thieves.
Long before stone palaces crumbled, forest hunters staked out the river banks to ambush wandering beast-caravans.
Greenwood archers hold wild feasts high in the branches, laughing at the memory of vanished emperors below.
Deep in {n}, every hollow trunk tells a riddle of early days when wild wit outsmarted all royal decrees.
c:Dnipro:48.4666: Decreed by an imperial sovereign along the broad Dnipro, {n} rose as a monument to legionary might and grand ambition.
Cossack river-captains once policed the waters before the court paved avenues of stone for foreign envoys.
Iron ore and coal feed colossal foundries that forge not merely swords, but engines built to breach the very sky.
Behind the stately columns of its academies, diplomats weigh treaties while secretive guilds tinker with star-reaching tubes.
c:Douala:4.0483: Resting on the muddy jaws of the Wouri River estuary, {n} watches the mangrove tides carry the riches of the interior.
The elder trees chuckle as bargemen haggle over sweet beans, fragrant sap, and fell logs dragged from the interior.
Trackers say only a fool rushes into {n}, where wet river-winds hold old riddles and contracts take a lifetime to dry.
Great vessels come seeking iron-timber and bitter brews, but leave mostly with mud, memory, and a healer's quiet advice.
c:Yangjiang:21.8556: In the coastal canopy of {n}, fletchers craft whittling blades so keen they can carve a falling leaf in mid-air.
High above the surf, woodland scouts fly great painted silk kites shaped like monstrous hornets to mislead rival trackers.
The root-dwellers of {n} chatter in an unruly tongue that outsiders mistake for the piping of marsh-birds.
Every evening, boar and ocean oysters roast over moss-fires while young tricksters swap the salt for stinging nettle dust.
c:Zhanjiang:21.2339: Perched at the southernmost claw of the peninsula, {n} sends swift reed-skiffs across the strait to taunt island sentinels.
Masqued bards upon tree-stump stages scream the Thunder Dramas, mimicking lightning strikes to make gullible elders jump.
Immense war-canoes hollowed from ironwood trees moor in the bay, their hulls greased with pig-fat to slide soundlessly past patrols.
Wild feasts of braised sea-crabs and sweet fermented sap last well into the humid dawn beneath giant banyan arches.
c:Aurangabad:19.8776: Known as the Haven of Fifty-Two Gates, {n} offers as many unguarded escape routes as there are ways to pick a magistrate's lock.
Hidden paths wind into ancient cliffside caverns where cutpurses stash stolen gold behind the stone gaze of slumbering deities.
Smugglers weave enchanted silks that shimmer like moonlit river mist, perfect for slipping unseen past city watchmen.
In the shadowy courtyards beneath ivory-domed tombs, caravan masters wager purloined emeralds on the roll of weighted dice.
c:Tiruchirappalli:10.8155: Perched upon a sheer tooth of ancient stone, the high fortress of {n} watches caravans crawl along the split arms of the Kaveri.
The river-island bazaar is a den of smooth-tongued fence-men trading sacred temple gems wrapped in scented tobacco leaf.
Beneath the sprawling shrine-complex, cat-footed thieves bypass seven concentric wall-circuits without alerting a single guard.
By the light of twin moons, secret river-skiffs smuggle plundered gold under the noses of the tidiest constables in the realm.
c:Sacramento:38.5816: From the gilded halls of {n}, governors and ministers steer the grandest realm of the sun-drenched west.
Built where the great Sacramento River meets fertile delta lands, it serves as the political heart of a sprawling territory.
Treasuries of gold once poured down from the eastern mountains, filling its vaults and buying legions of loyal diplomats.
In seasons of harsh drought, councilors barter canal rights with the cunning of seasoned warlords.
Grand trade roads converge upon its marbled seat of law, where ambition and backroom bargains rule supreme.
c:Thrissur:10.5167: Centered upon a sacred hillock, {n} rings with the wild clamor of grand revels where pickpockets feast like kings.
During the nights of the Great Pooram, towering war-beasts parade beneath fireworks while daring cutpurses strip merchant purses bare.
Once the crown seat of Cochin's kingdom, it drew caravaneers and corsairs from Persian sands and western seas alike.
In the shadow of its age-old shrine, smuggled spices and stolen temple jewels exchange paws under the moons.
Acrobats, drummers, and silver-tongued fence-masters mingle freely in streets devoted to endless celebration.
c:Guankou:28.1586: The tricksters of {n} are legendary for their breathless talk-strings, spinning wild tales so fast that even the forest wind stops to listen.
Hunters here can out-chatter a flock of crows and recite a hundred beast-calls before an arrow hits the mark.
Around roaring campfires, woodsmen test each other with rapid-fire pranks and tongue-twisting rhymes over brimming horns of cider.
In {n}, survival is a game won by quick feet, a trusty bow, and a tongue faster than an angry badger.
c:Puducherry:11.9338: Perched beside the Bay of Bengal, the seaside haven of {n} welcomes corsairs, scoundrels, and discreet smugglers.
Sun-bleached colonnades and gridiron alleys divide its grand estates from secret waterfront dens of contraband.
Cutpurses and caravan masters whisper in multiple tongues, slipping moonlit brandy and silks past drowsy guards.
Along its ocean promenade, silver-tongued rogues strike daring deals while the surf drowns the chime of stolen coin.
c:Bordeaux:44.8412: In {n}, the grandest treaties of the realm are sealed not with hot wax, but with draughts from cellar vaults carved beneath the Garonne.
The châteaux that crown its rolling hills yield vintages steeped in subtle sorceries, favored by ambitious senators and plotting envoys.
Merchant galleys crowd the river crescent, bearing casks worth their weight in silver to buy legions and secure loyalties across the empire.
Golden stone palaces rise in immaculate symmetry, their columned halls echoing with the quiet bartering of thrones and trade charters.
c:Samara:53.2077: Where the Samara meets the Volga, spires of dark basalt are coaxed from the earth by the whispered incantations of long-lived magisters.
For centuries {n} was shrouded in wards of unseeing mist, hiding subterranean vaults where secret sky-craft and astral engines were forged.
Along its tiered riverfront, wizard-lords take aloof strolls, casually commanding the river currents to power their arcane laboratories.
Few commoners are ever permitted beyond the outer ring of {n}, lest they glimpse the strange, starward experiments conducted in its towers.
c:Tianshui:34.5795: High upon the cliffside at {n}, nimble rangers have hollowed thousands of perches into the rock, watching the high passes with notched arrows.
The sheer stone bluffs above the Wei River swarm with wooden catwalks, where woodland scouts stash stolen game and honey-mead.
Deep in the carved mountain grottos, stone spirits sculpted by wild artisans come alive after sunset to trade jokes and share the roast boar.
Down among the Qinling foothills, young stalkers test their wits against mountain beasts, turning every hunt into a riotous game of tag.
c:Tbilisi:41.6914: Perched above the gorges of the Kura River, the battlements of {n} have withstood a hundred sieges without yielding their iron oaths.
Beneath the fortress ramparts, volcanic waters steam in subterranean halls, where weary sentinels wash the dust of vigilance from their armor.
Stationed at the violent crossroads between eastern steppes and western empires, its garrisons stand in silent, unblinking discipline.
The heavy stone gates of {n} welcome the silk caravans, but every merchant must pass under the stern eyes of sworn shield-captains.
c:Tanta:30.7885: Set between two mighty seats of power, {n} is the crossroad where caravan roads meet the ringing clatter of the iron track.
Its ginning mills tear seeds from white fleece with relentless fury, weaving fighting-linens worn by renowned duelists.
Even the fiercest sword-masters sheath their steel to feast upon {n}'s candied nuts and fragrant roasted grains.
In the shadow of its gilded halls of learning, scholars match wits with the same unyielding pride as blade-dancers on the sand.
c:Nouakchott:18.0858: Born as a humble fishing camp against the sea, {n} became a sprawling stronghold when the crawling sands choked the great interior.
Thousands of displaced wanderers and dune-riders brought their honour, their pride, and their scimitars to its ocean-battered walls.
Tall masts crowd its deepwater harbor, unloading cargo under the glare of desert sentries who still smell of camel smoke.
Minstrels here recount the legends of sunken wells and lost oasis kingdoms, singing till the ocean tide drowns their voices.
c:N'Djamena:12.1067: Founded as an invader's palisade upon the Chari River, {n} shed its foreign shackles to become a fortress of enduring iron.
Positioned near the fickle shores of Lake Chad, it guards the crossroads of trade with blunt words and heavy blades.
Its smiths mock the scorching heat of the sun, claiming the only real furnace is the one burning inside a warrior's chest.
Within {n}'s gates, travelers find dry humor, sharp steel, and a sanctuary earned by outlasting every siege the sands could muster.
c:Handan:36.61: Deep in ancient soil, {n} is where mischievous woodsmen chipped lodestones from Mount Ci, inventing spoons of iron to baffle lost wanderers.
Its hunters move with the hypnotic grace of soft-flowing water, turning the slow forms of shadow-boxing into a deadly ambush.
Once a seat of warlords and crown princes, it is now best loved for wild feasts that celebrate surviving another lord's folly.
Any archer who boasts too loudly in {n} will surely find a living branch snapping back to swat them into the briars.
c:Yaoundé:3.8667: Born as a rugged palisade between the rushing waters of the Nyong and Sanaga, {n} grew behind stockades built to endure any siege.
It was first raised for barter in rare tusks and forest sap, but cold iron and stout walls soon turned the outpost into a warlord's seat.
High upon its wind-scraped hills, massive stone halls now command the realm, where decrees are hammered out as bluntly as battle-axes.
Its kilns bake unbreakable red clay and its brewers tap hearty draughts, fuel enough for warriors who scoff at softer lowland cities.
c:Sofia:42.6975: Nestled in the verdant shelter beneath Mount Vitosha, {n} welcomes weary travellers with the soothing steam of its ancient mineral baths.
Sages and knights have gathered at the banks of the Iskar for eras, preserving illuminated scrolls through centuries of shifting empires.
Once known as a crossroads of troubled crowns, it chose chivalric grace, turning old scars into sprawling gardens of rest.
Within its vaulted bathhouses and quiet libraries, polite courtiers trade gentle pleasantries while softly directing the fate of kingdoms.
c:Edmonton:53.5501: High above the winding North Saskatchewan River, {n} stands as an imperial fortress turned grand seat of statecraft and northern governance.
Where rival merchant cartels once clashed over trapping rights, a unified trade compact now levies tolls on all northern expeditions.
As the grandest citadel beneath the frozen stars, its broad avenues marshal legions and caravans bound for the edge of the known world.
Ministers and envoys throng its marble chambers, weaving ambitious treaties that bind distant settlements to its northern crown.
c:Liupanshui:26.5944: Formed from the pact of three wild border clans, {n} sprawls across mist-draped peaks where townsfolk are far outnumbered by forest dwellers.
Known to woodsmen as the Cool Haven, its chilly mountain breezes laugh in the face of the scorching summer sun down in the valleys.
Sly archers make their roosts among ancient hollow pines, dropping chilled mountain berries onto unwary travelers below.
When autumn rolls across the highlands, {n} erupts in wild feasts of roasted game and fermented sap, keeping the mountain frost at bay.
c:Huludao:40.7524: Shaped like the sacred bottle-gourd of wandering ascetics, {n} juts into the gray swells of Liaodong Bay.
For centuries uncounted, spirits of fallen sentinels have guarded this narrow corridor leading into the imperial heartlands.
Pilgrims trace the ancient coastal trail, lighting fragrant sticks before venturing past the great mountain gate.
Within its time-worn seaside shrines, spectral elders whisper solemn blessings to travelers honoring the old ways.
c:Niamey:13.5137: Perched upon the banks of the Niger River, {n} began as a rough stockade where rival warlords hammered out stubborn pacts.
Its massive river-spanning bridge was built stout enough to bear marching phalanxes and heavy wagonloads of iron ore.
In {n}, an artisan's worth is measured not by silver tongue, but by the temper of their blades and the hardness of their shields.
Soot from the great forges blankets every roof, reminding the clans that only unyielding sweat keeps the desert at bay.
c:Yichang:30.7144: Nestled where three towering gorges swallow the sky, {n} is a haven for rogue hunters who treat roaring rapids like a playground.
Colossal barriers of bound stone rein in the wild torrents, built as much to trap leviathans as to keep the campfires dry.
Cheeky scouts roost in the overhanging gorge pines, aiming arrows at leaping fish while betting flagons of wild plum mead.
Every season ends in an uproarious banquet, where tales of outsmarting river dragons grow taller with every roasted beast.
c:Ipoh:4.5841: Taking its name from the venomous tree whose sap tips their hunting arrows, {n} thrives along the winding Kinta River.
Hollow limestone spires rise like giant teeth around {n}, harboring secluded cave shrines and roosts for mischievous forest scouts.
The woodland kitchens here are legendary, dishing out rich broths and roasted fowl that turn every night into a wild banquet.
Caravans cutting through the jungle paths must stay alert, lest laughing tree-folk snatch the spices from their packs.
c:Denpasar:-8.65: In {n}, smiling spirit-masks guard every portal, demanding visitors trade a merry riddle or a purse of silver before passing through.
The grand bazaars overflow with fragrant marigolds and dread talismans, where gold flows swifter than the tide.
Wandering travelers flock to marvel at dancers whose shadows twist into hungry demons when the twin moons rise.
It sits as a sparkling, chaotic hub between land and the restless strait, thriving on glorious paradox and bright madness.
c:Sialkot:32.4927: Risen from the ash of a foreign conqueror's siege, {n} learned that empires crumble, but cunning thieves endure forever.
Beneath the dust of fallen dynasties, secret catacombs hum with moonlight auctions of stolen relics and smuggled jade.
Bold caravan-princes have ruled its towers by wit and dagger, securing plunder along the mountain trade roads.
Sages and master forgers here craft counterfeit scrolls and royal seals so flawless that even judges bow to them.
c:Jalandhar:31.3256: Straddling the legendary imperial highway, {n} is a sprawling crossroads where every caravan pays a secret tax to the shadows.
Honey-tongued cutpurses and wheelwrights strike bargains by moonlight, trading illicit cargo beneath tarpaulin sheets.
As the heart of the river-fork territories, it gathers stolen spice, smuggled silks, and fast horses from every direction.
Few wagons traverse its busy junction without losing half their weight to light-fingered rogues who vanish into alleyways.
c:Heshan:28.5694: Named for the great mountain cranes, {n} perches at the northern water-gate, where archers watch from hollow living boughs.
Wild wood-runners slip down the delta in moss-covered skiffs, bearing fresh venison and forest herbs for midnight feasts.
Bold wanderers of its bloodline venture across vast oceans, sending rare pelts and cheeky overseas gossip back home.
River barges often find their rudders tied with laughing willow roots, a reminder that the wild woods brook no trespass.
c:East Jerusalem:31.7834: Ancient walled sanctuaries in {n} house shrines claimed by three great faiths, where priests and legates haggle over sacred stones.
A contentious armistice line cuts through its avenues, watched vigilantly by sentries and rival ambassadors.
In its shadowed basilicas and colonnades, secret pacts are struck between envoys from across the known world.
Crowned monarchs and foreign leagues draft treatises in marble halls, disputing who rightfully claims {n} as an imperial seat.
c:Florianópolis:-27.5967: Spanning a glittering isle and the mainland shore, {n} governs coastal shipping lanes with effortless patrician elegance.
Guilds of artificers here draft scrying engines and trade secrets, fueling an empire of swift communication and commerce.
Along sixty pristine strands, daring thrill-seekers ride the cresting surf while nobles wager fortunes on the spray.
By the shores of its grand lagoon, grand galas and diplomatic feasts rage until dawn under silk canopies.
c:Zigong:29.3416: Two forest camps merged into {n} when their deep wells began spewing strange, salty sap straight from the roots of the earth.
Hunters gather around the Offering Well to toss in spicy meats and see what grinning spirit tosses them back.
Wild feasts here are seasoned with brine tapped from hollow trunks, keeping archers nimble and venison perfectly cured.
Diggers in the mud often unearth colossal monster bones, using ribs for grand bows and teeth for hunting daggers.
c:Bucaramanga:7.125: Over a hundred and sixty green groves breathe inside {n}, their canopy leaves whispering the town's oldest secrets.
Trackers here consult the deep loam, studying the black marrow of the earth to brew potent alchemical draughts.
Three sibling settlements cling to its muddy banks, bound together like tangled roots drinking from the same slow river.
Idle hands are rare in {n}, for the elders say a swamp will gladly swallow anyone who forgets how to work.
c:Āsansol:23.6833: In the shadow of the twin moons, {n} has swollen into the realm's fastest-growing haven for smugglers and audacious caravan-raiders.
Beneath its bustling bazaars lie subterranean vaults where illicit silver and black-stone coal are traded without tariff.
Only one rival settlement surpasses its sprawl, yet none can match the brazen speed with which its cutpurses strike and vanish.
District magistrates despair as moon-worshipping thieves barter contraband beneath their very headquarters.
c:Zamboanga:6.9103: Rising over the sun-drenched peninsula, {n} commands the straits with crystal spires and centuries of unyielding aristocratic pride.
Within its grand pavilions, enchanting-masters weave floral magic and arcane arts that draw over a million pilgrims to its shores.
Sprawling across vast coastal domains, this chartered sanctuary answers to no foreign archmage or provincial crown.
Ancient bloodlines fiercely guard their sovereign scrolls, perfecting the refined dialect of their scholastic guild.
c:Torreón:25.5439: Born barely a century ago amid barren sands, {n} is hailed across the wastes as the Citadel of Great Endeavors.
Where parched desert once defied survival, daring canal-weavers brought water to feed boundless fields of white cotton-fleece.
Here, fiery sword-masters and caravan captains clash in honorable duels beneath the shadow of roaring metal foundries.
Chroniclers gather at the caravan yards to recount how sheer labor forged a mighty desert jewel from dry sun and stone.
c:Raleigh:35.7721: Shaded by ancient, towering oaks, {n} serves as the seat of imperial law and the master forum of the realm's diplomats.
Named for a bold sea-lord whose first settlement vanished into legend, its marble halls harbor deep and calculated political intrigue.
Legions of young scholars flock to its grand academies, binding statecraft with the arcane sciences of the great Tri-Collegiate pact.
Along its paved thoroughfares, senators and ambitious guild-masters forge pacts that steer the wealth of the southeastern provinces.
c:New Orleans:29.9547: Built low where the sluggish Mississippi meets the salt marshes, {n} has learned to laugh at every rising flood.
In its iron-balconied quarters, horns of brass speak strange riddles that keep the wandering dead well-content.
Once traded away by overseas princes like a bundle of hides, {n} swallowed their customs whole and seasoned the stew.
Masked dancers throng its stone avenues once each year, tossing beads to mock the vanity of passing empires.
c:Kananga:-5.8962: Perched beside the rushing Lulua, {n} keeps watch over the iron tracks that carry ore across the red heartlands.
Its craft halls preserve the notched shields and ancestral banners of warriors who refused to yield an inch.
No fortress endures on boastful words, and the smiths of {n} prefer the heavy thud of the hammer to idle chatter.
Sky-caravans descend upon its dusty airstrips laden with heavy tools, greeted by grease-stained hands and cold water.
c:Cagayan de Oro:8.4822: Gazing over Macajalar Bay, the white spires of {n} shimmer with the quiet pride of golden lineages.
Here, scribes catalogue the genealogies of the northern coast, binding them into vellum steeped in fragrant oils.
The city's artisans enchant river-gold into intricate coronets, claiming their luster rivals the daylight itself.
Scholars gather in grand halls to debate the subtle tides of magic that govern commerce along the outer isles.
c:Omsk:54.9924: Where the frozen Irtysh cuts the steppe, {n} rises as a seat of ruthless masters who reckon lifespans in centuries.
Iron tracks converge beneath its shadow, dragging tribute from endless plains into the vaults of the ruling circle.
A fallen empire's hoarded gold was once sealed in its deep crypts to fuel grand and forbidden transmutations.
High spires of living stone overlook the frost, housing robed pontiffs who bind both faith and law to their will.
c:Touba:14.8623: The warriors of {n} forge no blade without a draught of the black fire-brew bubbling over the coals.
Crushed beans and biting desert peppercorns are roasted in heavy iron pans until the smoke stings the eye like sparks from an anvil.
Strained through rough canvas into battered tin cups, it turns the blood to molten bronze before a long march.
Soft folk from the lowlands cough and spit at the first gulp, but in the garrison halls it fuels three days without sleep.
c:Batam:1.1494: Sprawled across a maze of mangrove-choked islands, {n} is a sanctuary for every rogue with a hold full of illicit plunder.
Great arched bridges bind three sister isles together, letting swift smuggling wagons outrun any pursuing patrol.
Behind the clattering shipyards and noisy docks, quiet silver changes hands under the watch of twin moons.
If a corsair can slip through the outer reefs, the warehouses of {n} will buy his cargo before dawn breaks.
c:Qinzhou:21.9825: Where the tangled river-woods spill into the southern bay, {n} thrives on the bounty of salt waves and hidden canopy blinds.
Archers leap between the tidewater mangroves, daring one another to shoot diving sea-birds on the wing.
Nightly feasts along the mudflats echo with laughter as hunters pry open great shellfish and roast river-fowl over driftwood fires.
Any foreign galley that drifts into the shallows of {n} finds its sails riddled with mocking thorn-darts before it ever sights the docks.
c:Luohe:33.5742: Surrounded on all flanks by rival realms, {n} survives by wits, swift bowstrings, and an endless appetite for revelry.
The riverbanks are lined with smoking-sheds where trackers cure choice game taken from the plains for grand, rowdy feasts.
Clever scouts here carve piping flutes from beast bone, mimicking calls to lure stubborn prey right into the snare.
Unwary outsiders marching toward {n} usually wake up hanging upside down from an oak while the camp roars with laughter.
c:Xiangyang:32.0422: Across the rushing Han River, {n} straddles two wild halves connected by rope-swings and daring ferrymen dodging river monsters.
Its ancient southern bulwarks are overgrown with stubborn ironwood roots, having repelled siege engines for centuries while defenders laughed from above.
North of the water, woodland scouts and tricksters gather in the shadows of the old twin fortress to outwit imperial patrols.
Deep in the boughs along the riverbanks, feast fires burn late as archers recount how old sieges were broken with rotten fruit and stinging hornets.
c:Laiyang:36.9758: The orchards of {n} are guarded by nimble tree-stalkers whose arrows can clip a stem without bruising the prize.
Nearly every soul in this green realm knows how to coax sweetest pears from the ancient, murmuring branches of living groves.
Mischievous youths often snatch golden fruit right under the noses of elder sentinels, testing their footwork on pliable boughs.
At harvest time, the canopies erupt in drunken revelry as cider flows freely and feast-tables groan beneath the wild bounty.
c:Serekunda:13.4383: Sprawling outward from an old warrior's hearth, {n} grew so mighty it eclipsed the nearby island citadel with pure weight of iron and muscle.
The great market here is an unending din of roaring bellows, clanging anvils, and traders who value heavy plate over honeyed words.
In the sand pits along the shore, bare-chested brawlers test their grip in fierce grappling contests to settle honor and win casks of mead.
Travelers seeking ease on the coastal strip soon learn that {n} respects only hardened calluses and stubborn endurance.
c:Limeira:-22.5647: Two grand paved highways link {n} to the metropolis, bringing legions of merchants to bargain in marble courtyards.
Once enriched by groves of golden citrus and dark bean harvests, the city's vast estates now sway with endless fields of sweet cane.
In hidden guildhalls, cunning goldsmiths plate common alloys with gleaming leaf, shipping deceptive trinkets across the empire's borders.
Senators and emissaries know that behind the gilded finery of {n} lies a court steeped in sweet poisons and quiet diplomacy.
c:Nowrangapur:19.2311: Deep in the tribal borderlands, {n} is famous for golden cribs of maize that clever thieves skim before harvest moons rise.
The moonlit bazars here rattle with sweet-talking smugglers hawking woven crafts, milled paddies, and illicit cashew wine.
Under cover of midnight folk-dances, masked prowlers slip across district borders laden with bulging sacks of grain.
No wagon enters {n} with a full harness without leaving a sly tithe behind in the paws of smiling shadow-dealers.
c:Shymkent:42.3099: Raised along the ancient silk road, the bulwarks of {n} have guarded the southern frontier for over two thousand seasons.
Steadfast garrisons keep relentless vigil where regional supply tracks cross, ensuring order along the grand desert arteries.
In the great stone keeps of {n}, sentinels drill in solemn unison, bound by ancient oaths to protect the border realm.
The city stands as an unyielding fortress of duty, housing diverse legions unified beneath one banner of discipline.
c:Xuchang:34.0319: Once an imperial seat of old warlords, {n} is now overrun by merry woodland scouts who mock courtly airs from the canopy.
Hunters turn ancient imperial ruins into rowdy banquet halls, roasting wild game over bonfires among the living boughs.
Rangers here craft arrows from enchanted boughs and pelt stuffy travelers with acorns before vanishing into the greenery.
Life in {n} is deemed the sweetest survival in the realm, where every forest thicket hides a feast, a bed, or an ambush.
c:Takasaki:36.3333: In the soaring scriptoriums of {n}, master enchanters fashion round, crimson effigies imbued with sightless fortune.
High mages in crystal workshops inscribe pupils of ink onto luck-vessels to bind unyielding vows and noble destinies.
The city stands supreme in its highland valley, radiating the refined magical arts of distinguished ancestral lineages.
Scholars gather beneath {n}'s slender spires to study the sage whose meditative gaze turned inward to bend fate itself.
c:Louisville:38.2542: Founded in homage to a foreign monarch across the sea, {n} commands the great river bends where merchant fleets must halt and pay their tolls.
By shrewd decree of council, the outer boroughs and the ancient core were bound into a single sprawling seat of law and legion administration.
Nobles from every province assemble upon its manicured turf to wager small fortunes on the thundering hooves of prized thoroughbreds.
Amber spirits age in charred oak barrels beneath the stone customs houses, traded along paved imperial highways to distant courts.
c:Kigali:-1.9499: Carved into steep ridges and rolling heights, {n} crowns the fractured hills like an iron ring forged to endure siege and storm.
Once a minor frontier outpost of stone and timber, the fortress swelled until it became the supreme seat of clan command.
Battered warbands and wandering exiles fleeing bloodied foreign valleys find food, stern hospitality, and shelter behind its palisades.
Here, idle complaining earns a heavy hammer and a quarry chisel, for every steep street is kept clean through unyielding discipline.
c:Vellore:12.9184: Ringed by the Javadi Hills and the dry sands of the Palar, {n} hides behind towering granite battlements encircled by a beast-haunted moat.
Smugglers slip through the stone water-gates beneath the moons, hauling bundles of treated leather and illicit temple spices.
In the shadow of the temple spire, gold changes claws in whispers while lookouts watch the parapets for company guards.
Bold renegades still boast of the night the garrison turned on its foreign masters, looting the imperial armory clean before dawn.
c:Liège:50.6337: Where the river Ourthe flows into the Meuse, {n} greets weary travellers with warm hearthfires and chime-filled cathedral spires.
For centuries, mitred prince-scholars governed its halls, balancing pious healing with the courtly etiquette of proud knightly orders.
Deep along the riverbanks, alchemists and gentle smiths temper fine steel blades and lockwork crossbows prized by noble bodyguards.
Beneath the fragrant bakeries and quiet hospices, cloaked couriers trade letters of state over steaming cups of spiced brew.
c:Gold Coast:-28.0003: Along the sun-blanched shoreline of {n}, towers of spun gold and mirror-glass rise dizzyingly high from sands that tremble beneath them.
Here revelers dance in blinding daylight while toothy horrors glide unseen through the crashing turquoise surf.
Known to wanderers as the Glittering Strip, {n} sells eternal laughter by the hour, though smiles often freeze into weeping without warning.
Merry pleasure-barges drift along its salt-canals, their lanterns shining over bottomless trenches of neon-lit dread.
c:Hamamatsu:34.7: Within the polished spires of {n}, master enchanters fashion grand keyboards and singing strings that channel pure harmonic magic.
The noble houses trace their lineages through centuries of songcraft, tuning the very winds to soothe the minds of all who dwell there.
Travelers whisper that true misery cannot survive within {n}, for subtle contentment-spells chime perpetually from its crystal towers.
In shaded courtyards, artificers forge swift, clockwork-striding mounts that hum with the precise pitch of resonant steel.
c:Yixing:31.3606: Deep in the green canopy, the mischievous hunters of {n} shape purple earth into magical pots that brew tea fit for forest kings.
A single sip from a clay vessel of {n} is said to give an archer owl-eyes, steady hands, and the laughter of a trickster spirit.
Clay-diggers race beneath the grasping boughs, dodging wild boars and living roots to unearth the rare, purplish loam.
Wild woodland feasts always end in clay-hurling contests, where the finest potters trade banter and boast of outsmarting the elder trees.
c:Jabalpur:23.167: Along the moonlit gorge of {n}, the Narmada River cuts through towering walls of alabaster marble where smugglers stash their gleaming plunder.
In smoky subterranean dens, cunning rogues wager fortunes over velvet tables, knocking painted ivory spheres with polished sticks.
Heavily guarded caravans roll into {n} each dusk, their manifests rewritten by quick-fingered scribes before the moon has fully risen.
Deep beneath the cliffs, brazen thieves sell petrified bones of primordial thunder-lizards dug up from the river's stony bluffs.
c:Cheonan:36.8065: At the grand nexus of {n}, crystal conduits hum with the rush of arcane carriages speeding from the High Crown's citadel.
Here the realm's ley-lines converge in immaculate symmetry, woven by ancient geomancers to tether distant frontiers to the throne.
Master scholars gather atop polished spires to chart the endless arrival of glimmering iron-striders along enchanted rails.
It is hailed as the pulsating heart-cross of the empire, where no traveler of noble lineage fails to pay their transit-tithe.
c:Cirebon:-6.7063: In the split-minded port of {n}, twin sultanate courts argue whether the dawn should arrive in silk robes or sea-foam.
Merchants barter fermented ghost-shrimp for laughter, while harbor waves break backward into sweet perfume.
Half the town speaks in courtly riddles of the eastern plains, while the other sings in chaotic sea-cant from the west.
Beware the painted docks of {n}, where porcelain masks smile with one eye and weep pearls of dread with the other.
c:Salt Lake City:40.7608: Beside a gleaming inland sea of white brine, {n} governs the trade routes with unbending decrees and silver ledgers.
Legates and merchant magistrates gather under gilded domes to draft treaties that bind distant mountain valleys into one realm.
From the marble plazas of {n}, paved highways reach across the scrubland wastes, guarded by watchful cohorts.
Ambition thrives behind these stately colonnades, where political factions barter valley water-rights for imperial favor.
c:Yulin:22.6305: Deep where the frontier wind howls, {n} perches among singing elm boughs, its archers laughing from the leafy canopy.
The living groves of {n} twist their branches to trip solemn border guards and shelter rowdy hunter clans.
Wild feasts smoke every dusk beneath hollow trunks, with roast game tossed between arrow-fletchers and nimble tricksters.
Here the northern sands meet the wild woods, and none survive without a quick bow and an even quicker prank.
c:Ranchi:23.3432: Behind the roaring veils of {n}'s misty cataracts, caravan masters hide wagons laden with untaxed silver.
Born from a rebel uprising of forest clans who broke the old satrap's hold, {n} keeps no master for long.
Beneath the shadow of Ratu's high seat and ancient spires, gold changes hands swifter than an alley-cat's swipe.
Clever artificers carve gleaming new wards into the rock, devising enchanted lanterns to confuse midnight watchmen.
Moonlit pacts struck in the markets of {n} ensure that every stray jewel finds a bold and eager pocket.
c:Barcelona:10.1384: Along the slow, reed-choked shallows, {n} listens patiently to the muddy whispers of the wandering waters.
Four sister settlements bind their docks together, though the swamp trees remember when only heron-trackers walked the silt.
Centuries of moss-grown stone teach {n} that stone will crumble, but a well-brewed marsh tonic cures both bite and boast.
Ancient riddles float down the brackish tides, answered only by old healers who know which roots drown pain and which drown kings.
c:Dresden:51.0509: Known across the river valleys as the Jewel Box, {n} welcomes weary travelers with delicate porcelain and warm fires.
Princes and courtly mages filled its spires with grand libraries, where chivalric codes temper the sharpest royal ambitions.
Though terrible fire once swept through its heart, gentle healers and stonemasons pieced its wonders back together petal by petal.
Along the broad Elbe, whispered courtesies mask discreet pacts sealed over honeyed wine in mirrored ballrooms.
c:Gqeberha:-33.9611: Founded as a fortress on the wild frontier to anchor imperial law, {n} has grown into a bustling marvel of maritime trade.
Strong sea winds sweep over the stone monument raised by an early governor to mourn his lady across distant oceans.
Along the banks of the Baakens, legions of merchants and envoys barter treaties in wide, sun-drenched council squares.
Beneath {n}'s reputation for genial welcomes lies an iron web of tariffs, navy docks, and ambitious political leagues.
c:Jining:35.405: At {n}, the imperial canal terminates against the untamed north, where manicured water meets wild marshland.
River-hunters pole their reed rafts up from Lake Nanyang, trading bundles of smoked fish for straight ash arrows.
Playful willow-sprites along the docks love nothing more than snatching the hats of self-important canal merchants.
When cargo barges dock, {n} erupts into wild bankside revels fueled by roast marsh-fowl and forest cider.
c:Luzhou:28.8903: Where the Tuo and Yangtze rivers collide, {n} reigns as the wildest brewing-haven in the riverlands.
Foresters distill a legendary, throat-searing liquor from fermented grains, strong enough to fell an ox.
Archers gather on the wooden wharves after twilight, wagering flagons of strong spirit on perilous trick shots.
Barge-clans crowd the harbor docks to barter woodland hides for clay jugs of {n}'s prized white brew.
c:Himeji:34.8167: A marvel of gleaming alabaster, the great White Heron citadel spreads its feathered ramparts above {n}.
Eighty-three tiered wards and deceptive courtyards baffle any intruder untrained in spatial geometry.
Within the highest keeps, noble duelists study the refined art of swordplay beside scholars of pure light.
Spells woven into the pristine white plaster blind enemy scouts who dare gaze upon {n} under the midday sun.
c:Liaocheng:36.4506: The Grand Canal cuts directly through {n}, splitting the forested borough into a lively maze of canals and bridges.
Fleet-footed scouts sprint along the low canopy, dropping bundles of leaves onto stuffy canal toll-collectors.
Hunters set floating archery targets across the central channels, wagering smoked venison on impossible shots.
At dusk, the waterbanks echo with the music of reed-pipes and the laughter of woodland revelers.
c:Mysuru:12.2979: At the terminus of a grand elevated stone highway, {n} receives wagon-trains laden with the plunder of distant coasts.
Ten broad carriage-lanes cut the march in half, letting nimble smugglers outpace royal patrol-riders by miles.
Beneath the high archways of the road, shadowy bargains are struck under twin moons for untaxed silks and silver.
Brazen cart-thieves praise the smooth stones that turn a grueling trek into an hour’s swift dash into {n}.
c:Gdańsk:54.3523: Where the Motława meets the northern sea, {n} greets weary navigators with warm hearths and soothing herbal drafts.
Centuries of merchant leagues have endowed {n} with splendid cloisters dedicated to law, astronomy, and amber-craft.
Joined with two sister ports along the bay, the city maintains an unbroken tradition of knightly courtesy.
Though ancient sieges have tested its shores, the city’s hospitallers never close their doors to a wounded soul.
c:Osogbo:7.771: Rising at the beating heart of the province, {n} is a stubborn fortress ringed by high roads and tested steel.
From its central garrison, trade roads march out to five sibling keeps, laden with tempered iron and war-harness.
The smiths of {n} take pride in crafting armor sturdy enough to outlast the loud disputes of its squabbling council.
An army marching against any neighboring frontier must inevitably face the unyielding anvil that is {n}.
c:Zagreb:45.8144: Sheltered beneath the forested slopes of Mount Medvednica, {n} extends courtly grace to all who cross its threshold.
Along the banks of the Sava River, seventeen peaceful quarters hum with the chants of clerics and menders of wounds.
Chartered as a free realm by ancient crowns, {n} prefers the gentle sway of parchment and etiquette over drawn swords.
Scholars stroll from foothill manors down to riverside colleges, trading herbal secrets and tales of knightly honor.
c:San Luis Potosí:22.1523: Perched high on the sun-scorched plateau, {n} was founded upon veins of silver so deep they provoked bloody duels over every claim.
The city bears the name of a sainted warrior-monarch, honoured by blade-masters who swear oaths on crossed rapiers at dusk.
Caravans laden with refined ore depart daily for the distant coasts, guarded by sellswords who never back down from a fight.
In the colonnaded plazas of {n}, bardic duelists weave thrilling tales of mine raids and ancient codes of honour beneath the stars.
c:Ashgabat:37.95: Rising between barren dunes and craggy ridges, {n} is a grand bazaar of polished white stone built by merchant decree.
A colossal canal diverts river waters straight through the sands, fueling lively boardwalk auctions and water-rights cartels.
When a cataclysmic tremor leveled its foundations long ago, shrewd guilds rebuilt it clad in luminous marble to project wealth.
Every contract drafted in the domed trading halls of {n} balances competing desert caravans with meticulous, unyielding clauses.
c:Cabanatuan City:15.4859: Revered as the northern gateway of the realm, {n} commands the flow of rare arcana along the grand high road.
Thousands of enchanted three-wheeled carriages rattle through its avenues, powered by humming light-gems and subtle levitation charms.
Generations of scholar-mages gather within its academies to study ancient administrative lineages and healing incantations.
Though the provincial seat of power was relocated elsewhere, the venerable halls of {n} retain their majestic ancestral prestige.
c:San Juan:18.4663: Perched on a sun-drenched haven, {n} is an ancient thieves' haven ringed by colossal sea-ramparts and daring hideouts.
Massive stone bastions jut into the crashing waves, built by kings but endlessly penetrated by charming cutpurses and smugglers.
Beneath the pale moons, secret galleons slip into hidden docks, unloading plundered silver and silks stolen from empire fleets.
In the cobblestone alleys of {n}, cunning rogues strike deals over cups of spiced rum while evading the governor's sleepy watch.
c:Weinan:34.5035: Where the wild Wei rushes to marry the golden torrent of the Yellow River, {n} perches like a grinning scout in the river willows.
Its old hunters call {n} the south-bank roost, though half their branch-huts have long jumped the water to mock the northern bank.
Woodland archers use the churning confluence as target practice, shooting bobbing gourds before the currents can swallow them.
Just downriver from the ancient stone capital, the folk of {n} roast stolen pheasants and toast each new boundary prank.
c:João Pessoa:-7.115: Anchored where the Paraíba do Norte meets the easternmost brine, {n} catches the very first glint of dawn before the rest of the continent stirs.
A grand observatory of sweeping stone curves stands on the eastern cape, dreamt up by an aged master builder before he joined the earth.
The swamp weavers of {n} stitch willow reed and river silk into relics so clever that even the whispering trees pause to admire them.
Trackers say the mud here is older than memory, but the artisans keep their hands busy, for idle fingers invite swamp-ghosts.
c:Djibouti:11.589: Hugging the salt-crusted gulf, {n} rose from parchment contracts signed by rival desert sultans and foreign coin-masters.
Nearly the whole realm crowds onto the boardwalks of {n}, where every plank is leased and every breeze carries the price of frankincense.
In the shaded canal arcades, merchant houses broker peace between bitter clan cartels with a stroke of a quill and a sip of spiced tea.
No blood is spilt at the harbor docks of {n} when a shrewd compromise can turn two enemies into paying partners.
c:Pizhou:34.3114: Deep in the yellow-leafed canopy between great northern marches, {n} is famous for archers who never miss and never pay for their ale.
Golden ancient trees line the forest paths of {n}, their fan-shaped leaves hiding tree-striders who rain pinecones on unwary patrols.
Wild feasts in {n} reek gloriously of pungent roasted cloves harvested from the marshy loam, a staple that keeps forest rot away.
When rival warlords muster on the borderlands, the merry rangers of {n} simply swap the boundary stones and vanish into the brush.
c:Maceió:-9.6658: Springs burst from the marsh only to lose their way to the sea, pooling into the trapped lagoons that give {n} its name.
Old trackers claim the whispering mangroves remember every wanderer who mistook calm green water for solid earth.
In the hall of herb-scholars, young healers learn five dozen remedies for rot, yet still argue over which swamp-root cures stubborn pride.
The sky-dock bears the name of an ancient runaway king who carved a sanctuary deep within the untamed palm wilds.
c:Guwahati:26.1844: Known as the great gateway to the misty north-east, {n} thrives on river-barges laden with smuggled silks and illicit spices.
The wide grey Brahmaputra sweeps past its water-gates, carrying fast skiffs full of audacious cutpurses beneath twin moons.
Temple bells ring out from steep crags, drowning the quiet clink of coin as cutthroats haggle for astrological amulets.
Ancient kings called this a seat of star-magic and light, but modern scoundrels know it as the finest den to fence hot plunder.
c:Changzhi:36.1839: When the first high warlord carved the realm into thirty-six domains, the woodsmen of {n} merely laughed and vanished up the pines.
Now four grand forest-ways cross its clearings, where cheeky archers charge tolls in roasted venison and wild berry wine.
Perched high on the wild plateaus, its hunters whistle signals through hollow living branches to guide friends and confound bailiffs.
Its bustling trade-glades roar each dusk with rowdy feasts, celebrating another season of evading imperial taxmen.
c:Voronezh:51.6683: Sprawling near where the dark Voronezh meets the great Don, {n} is ruled by magisters who weigh mortal lives like grains of sand.
Spire-towers here are not laid with stone, but grown from petrified black roots infused with alchemical draughts.
Across its pulsing convergence of iron ley-rails, captive thralls and rare reagents arrive daily from the snowy eastern wastes.
A million souls now dwell in the shadow of its spires, their vitality measured and siphoned for long-lived archmages.
c:Zhongwei:37.5113: Founded as the realm's middle watch against northern raiders, {n} relies on sharp-eyed archers hidden in the tall brush.
Roving scouts snare wild game and harvest crimson wolfberries that grant night-sight and swift feet on the chase.
Hunters coax sweet, swollen water-melons from the parched desert gravel to refresh comrades returning from long treks.
In the nearby waste, cheeky tinkerers laid a glittering sea of sun-trapping glass mirrors to roast fowl and baffle desert beasts.
c:Krasnoyarsk:56.0374: High above the Yenisey River, the mages of {n} grow twisting spires of living basalt from the mountain slopes.
Ruthless lords harness captured lightning to smelt feather-light silver-leaf metal for their soaring sky-carriages.
Beyond the walls rise the Stolby pillars, ancient petrified titans whose arcane whispers only the arch-sorcerers dare decipher.
A great iron track links {n} to distant realms, bearing strange ores and silent apprentices to the high colleges.
c:Ufa:54.7431: Founded as a tyrant’s grim stockade where the Ufa meets the Belaya, {n} has grown into a citadel of unyielding spellcraft.
Deep bore-towers siphon black earth-blood from subterranean vaults, distilling it into fiery elixirs that feed voracious engines.
In lofty hangars, ambitious mechanists graft runes onto winged skyships, seeking total mastery of the upper winds.
The ruling alchemists tolerate no dissent, jealously guarding the distillation secrets that keep their rivals in thrall.
c:Tilburg:51.5555: In the warm cloisters of {n}, scholarly knights debate the arts of healing and exchange courtly pleasantries over spiced tea.
Vast halls once loud with the clatter of iron carriages have been softened into sunlit atriums of poetry and green boughs.
Young scholars flock to the city’s gentle academies, learning to mend broken bones and soothe troubled spirits with quiet charm.
Behind the courteous smiles of noble hosts, soft-spoken emissaries trade subtle whispers that shape the realm’s treaties.
c:Ulsan:35.5392: Within the soaring glass spires of {n}, master artificers breathe animating spirits into vast hosts of self-moving iron carriages.
The coastal drydocks are the grandest in known lands, where titanic hulls are enchanted to brave the deepest abyssal tides.
Arcane distillers refine the subtle vapors of earth and air, harnessing pure alchemical breath to empower their glowing engines.
Nowhere else does craftsmanship yield such lavish tribute, making its proud guilds the wealthiest nobility of the coast.
c:General Santos:6.1128: Towering crystal bastions guard {n}, the southernmost jewel of maritime commerce along the sapphire coast.
Its scholars hold sovereign charter apart from neighboring lords, answering only to their own grand lineage of enchanters.
The bustling wharves process the bounties of the deep trenches, preserved through delicate frost-weavings and crystalline salt.
When great tremors shudder through the bedrock of Mindanao, wards of resonant stone hold its gleaming towers against ruin.
c:San Pedro Sula:15.5059: Sheltered in the wide Sula Valley, {n} hums with a thousand forges and looms hidden beneath the weeping canopy.
The swamp-dwellers joke that it wields more iron and coin than the sovereign capital, yet wisely avoids wearing the crown.
Trackers follow the slow waters toward the Caribbean Sea, reading signs carved into old roots by generations of guild-hands.
The damp air smells of hammered bronze and marsh-herb poultices, mending bones broken by the tireless tempo of its mills.
c:Rangpur:25.7466: Between the winding currents of the Ghaghat and Teesta rivers, {n} thrives as a paradise for midnight river-corsairs.
Greenhorn rogues arrive from every border province, eager to study lock-picking and counterfeit seals in its crowded academies.
An ancient emperor once dispatched his grandest general to subdue these lanes, but the city merely stole his coin and his patience.
Beneath lanterns lit for masked river feasts, smuggled silks and enchanted heirlooms trade hands before dawn breaks.
c:Pravyi Bereh:47.115: High above the churning waters of the Dnipro, {n} looms as the ancient root of the realm's grandest arcanum.
Here, spire-castles grown from living amethyst have looked down upon mortal dynasties for a thousand winters.
While the fledgling east bank struggles in youth, the lords of {n} tend their forbidden vaults with cold patience.
In deep catacombs beneath the bluffs, elder sorcerers test their flesh-weaving arts upon captured river spectres.
c:Mwanza:-2.5167: Carved from mammoth granite boulders upon the southern edge of Lake Victoria, {n} laughs in the face of siege.
They call it the Rock Stronghold, where even the dock bollards are chiselled from raw ironstone by thick-armed masons.
Two massive war-foundries anchor its perimeter, churning out shield-plates thick enough to blunt a dragon's claw.
Any warrior foolish enough to challenge its harbourmasters will find their ribs thoroughly acquainted with cold slag.
c:Aba:5.1066: Where five overland military tracks collide beside the Aba River, {n} pounds with the deafening chorus of hammers.
Founded by tough clan-forgers, its workshops can turn scrap bronze into dependable battle-mail before sundown.
An imperial garrison once tried to curb its temper, but left behind only iron carriage tracks now used to haul steel ingots.
If a weapon cannot be forged or repaired in {n}, an honest warrior simply has no business carrying it.
c:Jingzhou:30.3503: Perched along the swelling bends of the Yangtze River, {n} hides its thick ramparts behind thickets of sentient willow.
The wild woodsmen still chuckle over how the ancient sister-camps of sand and thorn bound together into one unruly bastion.
Peerless bowmen roost like crows in the timber eaves, swapping bawdy tales and shooting apples off invading captains' helms.
Every evening, great cauldrons of spiced river-eel simmer over open fires while the youth steal arrows from sleeping sentries.
c:Buffalo:42.8865: Built where Lake Erie yields to the thundering cataracts of the Niagara, {n} commands the western frontier of the realm.
Here imperial engineers cut the great water-road through rock and fen, linking the boundless inland lakes directly to the ocean tides.
Towering granaries like stone fortresses rise above the wharves, where countless bushels of golden harvest are taxed and transshipped.
In its opulent council halls, merchant barons trade envoys and contracts, plotting to outmaneuver the lords of the coast.
c:Bandar Lampung:-5.4292: Perched at the southern prow of Sumatra, {n} was stitched together from two rival dens of cutthroats to rule the strait.
Under twin moons, brazen smugglers unload illicit cargoes into hidden coves while customs officers look the other way for a pocketful of coin.
Innumerable wanderers and desperate exiles pour through its harbor gates, every one eager to lose a name and gain a fortune.
Caravan bells chime through back alleys where smooth-tongued fence-masters hawk contraband spices plucked from coastal ships.
c:Gwalior:26.2298: Crowned upon a sheer sandstone crag, {n} boasts a citadel so grand that kings call it the pearl of all mountain fortresses.
Scores of dynasties have claimed its lofty roost, yet bold night-prowlers still scale its cliffside to snatch treasures from its palaces.
Within the painted palace of the wild-eyed queen, silver-tongued rogues trade stolen trinkets beneath moonlit courtyards.
Down below, caravans laden with hillside loot wind past ancient ramparts, slipping unseen past the garrison's sleepy watch.
c:Jiujiang:29.7048: Where the vast Poyang Lake pours into the wild Yangtze River, {n} sits among willow groves and mist-shrouded reeds.
River-archers in feather-cloaks loose trick arrows to startle passing foreign barges, laughing as merchant boats drop their sweet cargo.
Great freshwater feasts smoke over fires of driftwood, where hunters trade enormous lake trout for foreign wine and woodland bows.
The nine twisting waterways around the haven are thick with living boughs, cleverly woven to hide the camps of playful scout-clans.
c:Trujillo:-8.116: Ancient clay mounds of long-vanished beast-tamers still crown the thickets of {n}, where archers practice among the roots of the Moche River.
It was here that merry foresters first severed the crown's silken leash, shooting the royal banner from the boughs to declare their unruly realm free.
The elder moot-trees of {n} serve as the realm's first true wilderness courts, judging quarrels by trickster wits rather than heavy parchment.
For a season, the great liberator pitched his war-tents beneath the canopies, planning his rebellion over roasted boar and sun-sweet fermented fruit.
In times of trouble, the woodsmen simply vanish into the coastal brush, leaving invading regiments to chase phantom guffaws through briar patches.
c:Kryvyy Rih:47.9057: Stretching like a drawn imperial broadsword across the riverbanks, {n} is famed as the longest boulevard of stone and slag in the known provinces.
What began as a legionary staging fort at the meeting of the Saksahan and Inhulets has swollen into an empire of smelters and deep iron mines.
Here, the realm’s grandest blast-furnaces roar day and night, casting breastplates and heavy siege irons that equip armies across three continents.
Foreign guilds and calculating syndicates flock to its marble chambers, scheming endlessly to corner the trade of the subterranean red ore.
Even when imperial decrees falter, the ironmasters of {n} forge treaties in molten steel, maintaining the city's place in the court's high politics.
c:Rosario:-32.9468: High mansions of carved stone and gilded friezes line the avenues of {n}, exuding the proud ambition of a patrician merchant metropolis.
Silt-clearing barges ceaselessly scour the bed of the Paraná, ensuring deep-draft galleasses can bear away mountainous harvests of grain and pressed oils.
In its salons was born the fiery partisan who carried torches of revolution across distant peaks, plotting the downfall of tyrannical crowns.
It is also the cradle of that legendary arena champion whose supernatural footwork with the leather sphere enchanted crowds across the empire.
Behind its diplomatic facades and soaring halls, the river lords orchestrate continental grain routes with cool, calculating efficiency.
c:Pekanbaru:0.5167: Baptized the New Bazaar by the river rogues who raised it, {n} welcomes any scoundrel with laden boats and a pouch of unminted silver.
Down the muddy bends of the Siak River, stealthy skiffs ferry contraband toward the bustling straits under the watchful eyes of twin moons.
Sacks of prized waking-beans and stolen black-burn coal pass through covert docks, slipped right beneath the noses of pompous customs magistrates.
A sweet tongue and a deft cutpurse hand will buy you passage on swift river sloops, where smuggled riches vanish before dawn can break.
In the shadowy lanterns of {n}, treaties of plunder are sealed with a wink, dividing the spoils of the great trade strait into private coffers.
c:Bijie:27.3019: Perched where tangled border woods collide, {n} is a haven for trackers who outwit royal wardens for sport.
To the north, a vast sunken basin traps mountain torrents, turned by clever hunters into an endless fishery.
The city sits beneath the Seven Stars Gate, where woodland archers boast they can split a falling leaf in pitch dark.
No feast in {n} is complete without stolen cellar wine, roasted river game, and bawdy songs of near-escapes.
c:Sakura:35.7167: When the pale boughs bloom across {n}, enchantresses weave the drifting petals into fragrant, fleeting wards.
Though common folk claim its petal-hymn dates to the dawn of the realm, it was penned in bustling gilded salons.
Lute-singers gather in crystal-paved courtyards to tune their silk strings to the soft rustle of the blossoms.
No noble house in the realm considers its lineage polished until its heirs can recite the city's spring canticle.
c:Reading:51.4563: Where the Thames and the Kennet gently mingle, {n} offers weary travellers dry hearths and gracious salves.
