Scholars and scriveners crowd its halls, tabulating ancient ledgers and charting unseen fortunes with ink and abacus.
High arched gateways still stand in solemn grace, remnants of a great abbey where kings once sought absolution.
Come high summer, minstrel troupes and lute-players pitch pavilions across the green meadows for days of joyous song.
A grand bazaar called the Oracle draws merchants of silks and remedies from across the breadth of the valley.
c:Lilongwe:-13.9669: Named for the churning river that feeds its quenched iron, {n} stands as the undisputed heart of the plateau.
Caravans laden with rough timber and heavy iron ore converge here, hauled by mule-drivers who take no lip.
Its sprawling red-clay bastions have swelled tenfold, built strong enough to outlast famine, siege, and rot.
Blunt smiths forge blades fit to splinter stone, boasting that an honest hammer stroke speaks louder than any king.
c:Anyang:36.096: Here stood the first crown-harrow of the ancient kings, now happily overrun by thorny brambles and chattering squirrels.
Woodland rangers dig up ox-bones etched with forgotten runes, using the relics as gambling dice around roasting fires.
Living boughs weave through the ruined foundations of the Seven Dynasties, giving archers prime perches to mock passing nobles.
Deep in the loam beneath {n}, antiquity sleeps quietly while greenwood tricksters feast on poached deer above.
The oldest capital in the realm has traded bronze thrones for elder boughs and the sharp whistle of hunter arrows.
c:Shaoguan:24.8: Where mountain rivers join under the canopy, the preserved shell of an ancient meditating patriarch sits peacefully.
Merry foresters leave wild honeycomb before the sacred dried master, asking his blessing before hunting the crags.
Tree-singers and trackers cross the waterways here to escape northern wardens and slip into the southern glades.
The hollows around {n} echo with archers' laughter, who swear the old saint's spirit guides their most impossible trick-shots.
Hunters guard the sage's mountain cloister, daring pompous city knights to brave their maze of tripwires and deadfalls.
c:Oran:35.6991: Perched between the foam and the desert, {n} is a haven where corsair scimitars clash against sea-castle rapiers.
The great bastions remember centuries of siege, torn back from overseas conquerors by fearless horsemen of the sands.
Bards gather along the stone ramparts at dusk, chanting epic ballads of desert duels and daring midnight harbor raids.
In the shaded courtyards, sword-masters test eager youths before merchant caravans load their salt and spice for the south.
Every scarred wall in {n} tells of honor fiercely defended against foreigners who thought the coast could be tamed.
c:Jodhpur:26.2684: Beneath the sheer cliffs of the high citadel lies an ocean of indigo alleys, perfectly painted to mask a rogue in twilight.
Caravans laden with desert silk cross the dunes only to pay sweet, unspoken tolls to charming cutpurses at the gates.
Under twin moons, the blue rooftops of {n} become a playground for daring cat-burglars leaping between courtyard eaves.
Smugglers hawk stolen palace jewels in the bustling shadow of the sun-fort, sealed with a laugh and a silver promise.
No treasure is too heavily guarded for the clan of thieves who call this walled desert oasis their playground.
c:Yogyakarta:-7.8014: In {n}, an ancient crowned monarch rules over smiling lunatics and dancing spectres, issuing decrees written in scented invisible ink.
Leather shadow-puppets whisper terrible secrets behind silk screens, laughing as their cut-out silhouettes come alive to entertain the court.
Weavers dye wax-patterned tapestries that weep vibrant indigo tears, while silversmiths twist living ore into singing talismans.
Thousands of wandering scholars fill its upside-down colleges, debating paradoxes that make candles burn blue and books flap like bats.
c:Jeonju:35.8248: The master alchemists of {n} weave subtle enchantments into grand feasts, perfecting thousand-year-old recipes that invigorate both body and soul.
Spire-dwelling scholars print immaculate magical grimoires on enchanted bark paper, preserving ancient lineage and arcane philosophies.
For thirteen centuries, noble houses with sloping tiled eaves have guarded the proud traditions of their spell-weaving ancestors.
Young culinary initiates study the sacred balance of element and flavor, seeking perfection under the gaze of crystal-crowned towers.
c:Hamilton:43.2501: Vast blast-furnaces bellow day and night along the water's edge, churning out legions of armor and iron plates for the realm's grand armada.
Anchoring the crescent bay of a vast inland sea, {n} controls the vital trade roads where ambitious diplomats barter for imperial favor.
Behind soot-stained walls lie manicured botanical sanctuaries and grand academies where healing-masters invent statecraft remedies.
Founded by ambitious patricians after a grueling border war, its council chambers are thick with schemes for provincial dominance.
c:Aracaju:-10.9111: In the tidal swamplands where slow rivers meet the salt surf, {n} watches the tides with the calm indifference of an ancient crocodile.
A soaring cathedral crowns the water-logged earth, where swamp priests offer prayers for souls lost in the labyrinthine mangroves.
Trackers say one third of the province dwells within {n}, though finding half of them among the shifting channels requires a patient guide.
Old healers harvest resin from the river-trees, claiming the sap cures memory loss—if you can remember where you left the flask.
c:Morādābād:28.8389: Known across the sands as the City of Brass, {n} rings with the hammers of artisans who can turn stolen ingots into lustrous treasures overnight.
Caravans crowd the banks of the Ramganga river under twin moons, trading filigreed trinkets for smuggled contraband from the imperial capitals.
Rulers and flags change like river tides in {n}, yet the guild of brass-thieves always ensures their vaults remain undisturbed.
A master burglar here boasts that if you turn your back in the night market, they will duplicate your iron keys before you have reached your pocket.
c:Qiqihar:47.3392: Across the mist-shrouded marshes surrounding {n}, sacred red-crowned cranes dance to usher wandering ancestral spirits into the quiet realm.
Pilgrims travel through the northern reeds to offer incense at venerable shrines tended by thirty tribes united under solemn custom.
Ghostly sentinels pace the reed beds, ensuring the rites of the ancestral temples remain untouched by worldly ambitions.
It is said the spirits of ancient chieftains watch over {n}, whispering omens whenever the great white birds take wing toward the frost.
c:Bilbao:43.2627: Sheltered by verdant mountain ridges where ocean rains softly fall, {n} welcomes weary travellers with warm hearths and soothing herbal tisanes.
Founded by a gallant knightly lord of old, the riverside haven became a bastion where courtly diplomacy outweighs the bite of steel.
Along the broad estuary that leads to the Bay of Biscay, scholars trade rare manuscripts beneath guilded porticos with immaculate courtesy.
Discreet alchemists and guildmasters weave gentle enchantments into the harbor's trade, masking quiet intrigues behind exquisite hospitality.
c:Mexicali:32.6278: Built precisely where two rival realms meet, {n} thrives by turning border disputes into profitable accords.
Canals carved through the sun-baked clay feed endless rows of grain and cool the boardwalks of busy guildhalls.
In its bustling craft-sheds, artisans forge goods for foreign lords under mutually signed pacts of exemption.
Merchants stroll between twin market gates, bargaining in two tongues without dropping a single copper piece.
c:Yongzhou:26.4239: Where the Xiao and Xiang rivers join, {n} has stood for two thousand winters amidst singing canopies and wild rapids.
Clever archers here boast they can skin a venomous serpent mid-strike without nicking the hide.
The living boughs above the riverbanks echo with hunter-feasts where roasted river-prowlers are shared by firelight.
Outsiders sent to tame the deep wilderness usually end up lured into tree-traps by grinning wood-trackers.
c:Port Louis:-20.1619: Tucked beneath jagged volcanic crags, the deep harbor of {n} welcomes ships that sail under no king's flag.
Silver stolen on the high seas is weighed and laundered in moonlit vaults before the tide can even turn.
Smugglers slip through the shadows of the Black River, hauling illicit spices past sleepy harbour wardens.
The city sits like a pirate queen upon the sea, draped in silks filched from imperial galleons.
c:Sāngli:16.8544: Along the banks of the Krishna, the storehouses of {n} gleam with mountains of stolen golden spice.
Caravans laden with illicit sugarloaf and crates of sun-dried raisins slip past river patrols by moonlight.
Sweet cane smoke rises from grand refineries where plunderers boil down sticky sap into pure currency.
Shadowy back-alley apothecaries offer miraculous draughts to wounded cutthroats who can pay the price in gold.
c:Lviv:49.8383: Founded in honour of a royal lion-hearted prince, {n} keeps faith with ancient codes of chivalry and quiet courtesy.
In its stone cloisters and fragrant tea-houses, scholars debate philosophy over steaming herbal decoctions and spiced confections.
Grand libraries and guildhalls line the cobbled squares, preserving chronicles through the fall and rise of rival crowns.
Knights and gentle healers mingle beneath arched arcades where high treason is whispered with exquisite politeness.
c:Maiduguri:11.8469: Raised as a rugged garrison outpost at the desert's edge, {n} was hammered into being by soldiers who preferred iron to words.
The seasonal Ngadda trickles past its ramparts before swallowing itself in the treacherous sunken swamps of Lake Chad.
Here, smiths temper broad-blades with coarse laughter, knowing any wall without stout hearts is merely a pile of baking mud.
The bastion endures unending sieges and scorching winds, standing as an unyielding anvil against the frontier wastes.
c:Hanzhong:33.0751: Deep in the tangled river-cradle of the upper Han River, {n} gave refuge to an exiled rogue who later snatched an entire empire.
Greenwood archers here practice splitting willow wands, laughing at pompous lords while feasting on spit-roasted boar.
The surrounding mountain forests whisper secrets through living timber, hiding clever ambushers beneath thick mossy boughs.
From these woodland halls arose the name of the golden realm, born not of grand palaces but of campfire wiles and cunning hunters.
c:Niigata:37.9226: Overlooking the cold grey tides of the Sea of Japan, {n} glints with crystal spires forged to channel seasonal blizzards into pure sorcery.
Highborn enchanters brew luminous draughts from mountain runoff and enchanted grain, perfecting their vintages with geometric precision.
Across the water lies the misty isle where disgraced nobles and master miners coax gleaming veins of gold from deep sea-caverns.
Within its mirrored parlours, lineages trace their bloodlines through millenia of unbroken magical artifice and peerless elegance.
c:Luhansk:48.5681: Deep beneath {n}, iron-veined mines fuel the marrow-furnaces of the archmages, who prize raw ore for their cold transmutation rites.
Spires of fossilised slag sprouted from the black earth overnight when the renegade conjurers severed allegiance to the northern courts.
In the high sanctuaries of {n}, long-lived warlocks forge iron leviathans that creep without beasts of burden across the contested steppes.
Bitter rival enclaves have laid siege to its crystalline bulwarks for decades, yet the council rules untouched within its poisoned fog.
c:Shangrao:28.4518: The trickster scouts of {n} perch where the Great Marsh of Poyang laps against the ancient roots of the border canopies.
Here, four provincial tracks meet, and our bowstrings are always notched to relieve careless caravans of their smoked pheasant and tea.
The very branches twist to shelter our wild feast-halls in {n}, baffling outsiders with five different woodland tongues in a single night.
When the high timber whispers of approaching magistrates, the folk of {n} melt like dew into the misty reed-beds, laughing from the reeds.
c:Birmingham:33.5207: They call {n} the Wonder Hold, for red iron, coal, and limestone lie together in the mountain’s belly as if stacked for a smith’s feast.
A colossal iron craftsman glares down from the ridge above {n}, reminding every hammer-hand that sweat is the only tribute worth paying.
Three humble settlements hammered themselves into one great bastion when the rail-lines first pierced the pine-covered hills.
Thick soot coats every beard in {n}, and the anvils never sleep while shields are needed to turn back rival warlords.
c:Malacca:2.196: Legend says {n} was founded beneath a wild berry tree, where a cheeky mouse-deer kicked a hunting hound into the foaming river.
The ancient seaside fortress was stormed by seafaring invaders centuries ago, but the jungle always swallows their stone walls back up.
Every corsair through the narrow straits pays a toll in rum and roast boar, lest our arrow-slings pick their helms off from the mangroves.
Beneath the sprawling canopy of {n}, woodland hunters roast peppered fish and outwit foreign merchant galleys with equal cheer.
c:Saarbrücken:49.2326: Spanning the Saar by an ancient arched bridge of stone, {n} serves as the grand gatehouse between rival empires.
Three proud boroughs bound their fortunes into a single commonwealth, cementing an era of codified law and roaring furnaces.
High on the Halberg crest, court heralds broadcast decrees across the realm through towers of brass and wire.
Deep in the border forest, jurists debate statecraft while merchant barons barter lenses of polished crystal and refined steel.
c:Marrakesh:31.6342: Beneath the snows of the Atlas Mountains rise the red ramparts of {n}, dyed the colour of dried blood and sunset.
Weary caravans laden with beaten brass and desert treasures end their perilous marches within its bustling plazas.
Master duelists test their blades in torchlit squares where storytellers weave legends of old warlords and conquest.
Seven revered champions sleep in marble tombs within the walls, their holy spirits invoked before every great expedition.
c:St. Louis:38.6273: Where two mighty continental rivers meet, {n} stands as the vaulted gateway to an untamed western expanse.
Founded by cunning fur-barons and named for a sainted monarch, the settlement soon blossomed into an engine of high diplomacy.
Great river-barges crowd the stone levees, discharging timber, grain, and ore into the holds of merchant cartels.
The city rulers cast off their provincial ties, preferring to govern this cosmopolitan trade nexus under their own shrewd charter.
c:Zagazig:30.5877: Straddling the waters of the canal, {n} commands the river roads where barges heave under mounds of white fiber and grain.
Beside its bustling markets lie the sacred ruins of an ancient feline goddess, revered by the desert clans of antiquity.
Grand halls of scholarship hum with chroniclers and antiquarians who unearth relics of long-buried dynasts.
Caravan guards boast of perilous desert crossings and settle disputes of honour with swift blades upon its sunlit avenues.
c:Saratov:51.5405: Grown over the ruined ramparts of a forgotten steppe horde, {n} looms above the Volga with spires of warped bone and black glass.
Ruthless magisters levy heavy tithes from Volga river-barges, seeking rare reagents for their clandestine fleshcraft trials.
In grand conservatories grown from subterranean basalt, aloof savants teach the resonant sorceries of drama and pure tone.
Outland alchemists were once lured here to build grand workshops, then vanished into the dungeons once their arts were mastered.
c:Meishan:30.0439: Nestled deep within the river basin, {n} is renowned for clever rangers who can shoot a pheasant on the wing and roast it before it falls.
Great communal feast-fires roar nightly beneath living willows, laden with rich, slow-braised pork spiced with wild hillside herbs.
Cheeky woodland tricksters whisper that an elder living in these hills unlocked nine centuries of life merely by drinking honeyed wine.
Archery contests often descend into joyful brawls when competitors charm the targets to scurry up the nearest mossy trunks.
c:Yichun:27.8333: High in the hollowed trunks of {n}, young song-maidens duel in melody to win the favor of the listening canopy spirits.
A girl of fierce courage recently claimed the woodland crown by charming a ferocious river-wyrm into peaceful slumber with her voice.
Hunters and trappers gather in lantern-lit glades to hear solitary bards pour out sorrow and daring to the beat of deer-skin drums.
Pranksters often mimic the famous songstresses from the upper branches, sending lovestruck trackers wandering in foolish circles.
c:Utsunomiya:36.5667: Highborn pyromancers in {n} gather beneath crystal spires to sear delicate, crescent-shaped pouches of spiced meat to golden perfection.
Over two hundred aristocratic dining salons line the grand avenues, each boasting an unbroken lineage of master dumpling-casters.
Enchanters treat the crisp searing of pastry as high alchemy, calculating the balance of garlic, broth, and enchanted flame down to a spark.
Refined scholars debate the proper proportion of dipping vinegars with the same haughty zeal they grant to ancient star-charts.
c:Samarinda:-0.4917: In the flooded stadiums of {n}, champions kick enchanted bladders under the furious banner of the river-dolphin.
The locals revere the laughing beasts of the Mahakam, whose playful leaps mask a terrible, toothy rage.
Every tournament in {n} is half jubilee and half delirium, where crowds weep with joy while tearing their robes.
Mad banners flutter across the waterways, reminding all that their sweet river spirits are eager to bite.
c:Rochester:43.1548: {n} sits as the proud anchor of six subject shires, binding vast granaries to its grand legislative halls.
Over a million souls heed the edicts issued from its towering courthouses and marble archways.
Along the paved highroads, legionnaires escort heavily laden tribute wagons from the rural plains into the city.
Clever magistrates in {n} balance imperial taxes against the cunning demands of the provincial landowners.
c:Fuzhou:27.96: Where the wild Min River meets the salt tide, {n} flourishes as a city half-strangled by living banyans.
Venerable scholars and tree-climbing scouts debate the secrets of the cosmos in moss-draped lecture halls.
Trickster archers perch upon the stone walls, firing seed-arrows into the hats of haughty merchant caravans.
Its boroughs expand with the speed of brambles, swallowing the marshes for yet another woodland feast.
c:Chunian:30.9662: When the river Beas turned its back and vanished, {n} claimed the bone-dry riverbed as a haven for thieves.
Sunken silt-roads now serve as moonlit highways where smuggled caravan treasures change hands unseen.
At this desert crossroads, silver-tongued rogues sell back the very relics stolen from distant capitals.
Four centuries of illicit trade linger in the mud-brick alleys, where even the shadows demand a cut.
c:Guigang:23.116: In {n}, tree-striding hunters gather where the wide river laps against docks woven from living green willow.
The ancient glade takes its name from noble sweet-bark groves, whose spicy peel flavors every roasted boar.
Rafts of hollowed cedar slip down the waterway laden with river-pearls and stolen honeycomb.
Sentries perched high in the branches pelt stern river-captains with bitter plums just to see them swear.
c:Edinburgh:55.9521: Crowned upon a crag between the northern firth and southern hills, {n} opens its vaulted cloisters to weary scholars and wounded knights.
In its grand stone college, master physicians teach the gentle art of knitting bone and soothing fever with lavender tea.
Robed chancellors debate ancient laws beneath banners of chivalry, though velvet whispers in the palace corridors shape their decrees.
Every evening, hearth-fires are kindled in tall tenements so that no wanderer climbing the cobbled ridge goes cold or unsupped.
c:Sokoto:13.0627: At the joining of two muddy torrents stands {n}, a red-walled stronghold carved for those who forge their honor in fire.
Master curriers scrape and tan desert hides into cuirasses tough enough to turn a charging spear.
The grand citadel honors the supreme marshal of the faith, whose word commands the allegiance of a thousand war-chiefs.
Grinning smiths chew bitter stimulating nuts as they hammer stirrups, boasting that their scabbards outlive the men who wear them.
c:Linqu:36.5156: Woodland archers in {n} mimic the trills of thrushes while carving caricatures of visiting lords upon ancient boulders.
In the shadow of the great sacred mountain, foresters fish beside the Dragon Spring and trade petrified bone-trinkets dug from the mud.
Clever tricksters paint false animal tracks with berry ink to lure solemn quarry into thickets of clutching brambles.
When dusk settles over the hollows, troupe players bellow bawdy forest operas around crackling bonfires of seasoned pine.
c:Ilorin:8.4966: Built where the great thorn-savanna crashes into the southern ironwood forests, {n} is a fortress-crossroad forged to withstand any siege.
Here northern horse-clans and woodland warriors test each other’s steel, then share the same tavern benches when the dust settles.
The warlord-scholars of {n} govern from an ancient seat, sharpening both scroll and spear with equal discipline.
Travelers argue whether it belongs to the dry steppe or the deep greenwood, but its folk just point to the ramparts and laugh.
It remains an unyielding anvil of trade, where caravans bartering grain and timber must pay toll in honest coin or drawn steel.
c:Luton:51.8797: Founded upon the willow-lined banks of the River Lea, {n} began as a sanctuary where gentle clerics offered bread and herbal draughts to weary pilgrims.
Its weavers are renowned across the realm for enchanted headwear, crafting plumed hats that bestow quiet grace or shield their wearers from sorcerous gazes.
In grand guildhalls, carriage-wrights once assembled gleaming iron-strutted wagons, though the craft now yields to silent study and arcane mechanics.
High upon the hills sits an airy landing yard where winged messengers and feather-light sky-skiffs descend under the watchful gaze of noble knights.
Scholars gather beneath the soaring limestone arches of St Mary's sanctuary, debating subtle courtly etiquette over spiced cordial.
c:Grand Rapids:42.9634: Stationed along the surging currents of the Grand River, {n} channels the vast commerce of the western inland sea toward grand imperial avenues.
Renowned as the city of thrones, its master joiners carve the very council seats, polished desks, and walnut benches upon which empires are governed.
Every season, the boulevards transform into an open court of spectacle, where painters and sculptors contest for gold and political patronage.
Legions of merchants and shrewd magistrates pace its marble colonnades, sealing grain compacts and plotting bloodless coups behind ledger-books.
Across its arched stone bridges, wealth flows like rushing whitewater, turning raw timber into sovereign authority and enduring statute.
c:Málaga:36.7202: Basking under the blazing southern sun, {n} crowns the azure coast with ancient battlements where duelists test their rapiers in the sea breeze.
Nearly three thousand years of seafaring kings and desert conquerors have carved their oaths into the cliffside fortress of Gibralfaro Hill.
Along the salt-crusted docks, storytellers recount how eastern voyagers first cast anchor here, trading silver for rich catches of the Mediterranean.
Ancient vats along the shore still brew pungent fish-pastes and spiced oils, prized by desert caravaners for their power to keep rations fresh.
Proud fencing masters teach that a sharp blade and a sharper tongue are the only currencies truly honoured between the Guadalhorce and the sea.
c:Huzhou:30.8703: For two thousand years, the wild bowyers of {n} have nestled along the southern reeds of misty Lake Tai, answering to no king.
The surrounding bamboo groves shoot up overnight, perfect for fashioning trick arrows that whistle like startled fowl.
At twilight, archers roast fat lake eels over greenwood fires, daring the wetland beasts to try and steal their catch.
Living willows dip their limbs into the shallows to tangle the boats of unwary river-bailiffs seeking tribute.
c:Aden:12.7796: Clustered inside the hollow bowl of an extinct fire-mountain, {n} keeps the golden key between the inner gulf and the wide ocean.
Here, rival merchant syndicates sign cautious truces upon salt-crusted boardwalks, trading spices from distant continents.
Any sea-captain who slips past the strait must first pay tribute in coin or silk to the harbor masters of the hollow.
Great stone warehouses hold dry goods sealed in pitch, guarded by clerks who prize balanced ledgers far more than drawn blades.
c:Gothenburg:57.7072: A warrior-king raised {n} at the icy mouth of the Göta älv, summoning allied clans across the freezing foam to hold the western shore.
Behind mighty sea-ramparts, craftsmen hammer frost-hardened steel to sheath deep-water galleys meant for uncharted northern runs.
Great mead-halls ring with old sagas of trading voyages that sailed into blinding squalls to plunder distant spice ports.
Scholars of the forge study the hidden arts of mechanical engines alongside veteran shield-captains bound by blood oaths.
c:Vinh:18.6734: Rebuilt time and again from the very dirt, {n} hugs the muddy bends of the Lam River where the jungle meets the sea-winds.
When marauding armies march down the river highway, the townsfolk simply vanish into the treetops and pelt them with rotten fruit.
Merchants hauling carts from the western hill-tribes must leave a toll of fermented honey or face a barrage of snare traps.
At nightfall, hunters gather on the open silt to roast wild boar, boasting of who led the fiercest jungle predators into camp.
c:Cartagena:10.3982: High coral bastions and twisted mangrove barricades keep {n} safe from greedy galleons prowling the Caribbean Sea.
Forest stalkers here grew wealthy plucking silver ingots from imperial holds, stashing the glittering booty in hollow trunks.
Sneering corsairs have besieged the cove for centuries, only to be turned back by thorn-tipped arrows and poisoned brambles.
Every thwarted raid ends in a raucous feast along the tideline, where roasted game and stolen rum flow until dawn.
c:Hengyang:26.8895: In the tight thickets of {n}, a handful of sly archers once held a vast invading army at bay for weeks of furious siege.
The invaders fell into concealed pit-traps and were skewered from high branches until their losses dwarfed the defenders' whole host.
Though the wooden ramparts were crushed at last, the survivors vanished like phantoms into the briars, jeering from the ridge.
Bards toast the stubborn stand with wild bough-wine, calling it the bloodiest thicket ever fought over in all the realm.
c:Shizuoka:34.9833: Beneath the snow-crowned majesty of Mount Fuji, the crystal observatories of {n} gaze out across the tranquil Suruga Bay.
Here, noble artificers craft swift wheeled carriages infused with harnessed lightning and clockwork precision.
Lineages of master enchanters trace their craft back ages, tuning humming apparatuses to sing with resonant magical harmonics.
Upon grand stone tracks beneath the sacred peak, enchanted racers compete to test the utmost limits of refined motion.
c:Yishui:35.7847: Cradled in the rocky foothills of the Yimeng mountains, {n} guards the crystal headwaters of the Yi and Shu rivers.
Wood-dwellers here skip across stone rapids with supple yew bows, hunting river sturgeon and mocking heavy-footed patrols.
The surrounding forest is riddled with tripwires and trick snares that topple haughty tax collectors straight into the mud.
Each autumn, hunters drag their mountain bounties to torchlit hollows for noisy revels that echo from ridge to river.
c:Irbid:32.5556: High upon the northern ridge of Gilead, {n} stands as a storied bastion where caravans bartered blade and silk across the sands.
Born in the age of first bronze, {n} was once counted among the ten great league-cities whose duelists swore blood-oaths of brotherhood.
In the shaded courtyards of {n}, elder storytellers recount how the realm's first municipal charter was sealed in ink and steel.
Caravan-masters resting their dromedaries in {n} test their scimitars against wandering blade-singers seeking glory along the border marches.
c:Hezhou:24.4036: Deep within the mossy karst ridges, the folk of {n} teach youngsters to coax arrow-shafts from saplings without breaking the bough.
The living groves around {n} shelter cheeky hunters who swap sweet wild plums for the stray quivers of unwary travelers.
Elders in {n} outlive their own great-bows, claiming the secret of century-long vigor lies in moon-brewed pine sap and teasing the forest spirits.
When dusk rolls across the river mist, {n} kindles roaring feast-fires where archers shoot fruit from each other's caps to seal a wager.
c:Riga:56.946: Where the broad Daugava spills into the freezing bay, the timbered halls and soaring stone spires of {n} withstand the bitter northern gale.
Eight centuries ago, warrior-merchants raised {n} to bind frosty coastal clans beneath a solemn league of mutual shield and sword.
Masters of wood and stone carved monstrous faces and flowing maidens into the facades of {n}, guarding its mead-halls against winter wraiths.
When the estuary freezes solid, the champions of {n} take to the ice, clashing with heavy curved sticks and iron shields to prove their valor.
c:Pointe-Noire:-4.7761: On a dark spit of sand jutting into the great Atlantic brine, {n} watches the tides with the quiet calm of an old marsh heron.
Two silver oars grace the crest of {n}, though the trackers chuckle that a steady pole and patience cross the mangrove swamps far better.
Black rock and churning foam mark the headland where ancient healers gather driftwood imbued with the memory of drowned forests.
Barges laded with river goods glide into {n}, while boatmen trade riddles of the coast for remedies brewed from salt-marsh reeds.
c:Jos:9.9285: High atop the wind-scoured plateau sits {n}, guarded by treacherous zig-zagging cliff trails that break careless siege wagons.
Underneath the stony tablelands lie endless veins of heavy tin, dug out to alloy iron into bronze fit for war-choppers.
Foreign conquerors came digging for its silver-grey ores, but only the mountain clan's stubborn hammers outlasted them.
Down in the roaring market squares, metalworkers barter hard plate and axe heads with caravaners from the lowlands.
c:Toyama:36.7: Beneath the towering crests where ancient glaciers never thaw, {n} gazes proudly across its deep and luminous bay.
Arch-mages here harness the sheer fury of mountain torrents, transmuting falling water into boundless arcane lightning.
Guild-workshops humming with channeled current craft glasswork and alchemical reagents coveted across the seas.
Lineages of scholastic enchanters guard the pristine peaks, maintaining wards over the realm's last perennial ice.
c:Zhangjiakou:40.7834: Since the dawn of kings, {n} has stood as the great northern portal, where the colossal bulwark of stone crowns the ridge.
At the ancient arched gate, ancestral sentinels keep vigil over the pass that links the inner kingdoms to the outer wastes.
Countless legions marched through its shadow, their spirits lingering still in the temple incense that lines the mountain road.
Solemn pilgrims offer jade and burnt parchment at the boundary stones, begging the spirit-marshals for safe passage northward.
c:Iligan:8.2289: Nestled beside roaring cataracts that tumble from emerald heights, {n} harnesses the raw elemental power of falling mist.
Spire-born scholars weave the rushing waters into radiant conduits of energy, illuminating halls of polished stone.
In deep foundries fed by water-sparked arcane currents, master metal-weavers temper pristine alloys of immaculate grade.
Nobles of old blood claim stewardship over the cascading torrents, forbidding commoners from disturbing the singing falls.
c:Bilimora:20.7696: Upon the winding banks of the river Ambika, {n} thrives as a southern haven for daring river-thieves and contraband cargo.
Here a sovereign once anchored fifty armed sloops and sail-barges, defying foreign armadas that sought to rob these waters.
Its quiet docks hum after midnight, when stolen maritime goods are whisked from coastal skiffs into wagons headed inland.
Every warehouse by the water conceals falsified cargo seals and sly merchants bargaining under the moonlight.
c:Bahawalpur:29.3978: At the wind-swept threshold of the Cholistan Desert, {n} glitters with monuments raised on the profits of golden caravans.
The desert chieftains who founded it traded brigandage for silk-lined palaces, though they never lost their cunning instincts.
Shrewd merchant-lords gather beneath ornate domes, dividing the wealth of trade routes crossing the perilous sands.
Rare beasts and exotic treasures slip through its shadowy bazaars, smuggled out from the great preserves beyond its walls.
c:Tangier:35.7673: Perched where the raging ocean meets the inland sea, {n} has long stood as an open gate for seafarers and desert nomads alike.
Diplomats, spies, and master duelists have crossed swords and swapped kingdom-toppling secrets in its winding alleys for ages.
Fierce storytellers gather in sea-spray taverns, recounting the legendary blade-masters of its ancient foundation.
Massive deepwater harbors welcome towering galleons, their captains bound by unyielding codes of honour and trade.
c:Kota:25.1825: Overlooking the Chambal River, {n} was raised behind fortified walls by renegade lords who broke free from their ancestral realm.
Hundreds of thousands of ambitious apprentices flock here each season to endure grueling trials in alchemy and arcane calculation.
Wagons and stealthy couriers race through its avenues without pause, as no watchman's post or signal halts the swift traffic.
Behind the gardens of its palaces, secretive scholars sell stolen master-keys and smuggled examination scrolls under the stars.
c:Xinxiang:35.1903: In the sprawling canopies of {n}, ancient battles of overthrow and rebellion are reenacted with acorn slings and wooden blades.
The wild groves here have swallowed old iron tracks, turning ancient avenues of steam into trails of bounding deer and ambush.
Root-singers weave living houses from flowering briars, claiming that brick only hinders the scent of a roasting wild boar.
Mischievous trackers gather at feast-fires to boast of tricks that toppled ancient tyrants on the surrounding plains.
c:Andijon:40.7834: Along the busy waterways of {n}, the great merchant houses wager fortunes on furious pitch-games of leather and kicking boots.
Rival guilds settle territorial charters not with blades, but through fiercely contested trials on the manicured turf.
Brisk boardwalk brokers draft shrewd bonds over the speed of champion runners chasing the painted sphere.
A clever compromise made in the grandstands can redirect an entire canal before the final whistle sounds.
c:Pingdingshan:33.7309: Hunters of {n} take wing upon tamed mountain eagles to scout the flat-topped crags for fat game and unwary rivals.
The great birds nest in the canopy, often dropping stolen cloaks and boots onto the heads of drowsy camp sentries below.
Longbow archers feast beside living boughs, carving raillery and song into roots laid bare by ancient winds.
They say the eagles themselves learned to taunt travelers from the cheeky bowmen who roost upon the high plateau.
c:Iloilo:10.6969: Seven ancient boroughs converge to form {n}, their crystal spires shimmering above tranquil coastal waters.
Masters of the culinary arts infuse high banquets with subtle enchantments, rivaling the grandest courts in prestige.
Loom-weavers charm gossamer threads of gold and plant fiber to fashion shimmering vestments fit for sorcerer-lords.
Noble houses trace their lineage back centuries, guarding classical academies of high rhetoric and intricate spellcraft.
c:Perm:58.0105: Along the rushing waters of the Kama, {n} sprouts as an unruly sprawl of grown spire-towers reaching toward the stony shoulders of the Ural Mountains.
Deep in the root-vaults of {n}, elder arcanists conduct cold transmutations, caring little for the passing mortal centuries above.
The realm remembers when {n} bore the harsh name of an iron-willed overlord, shedding it only when a darker sorcery proved more enduring.
Countless apprentices labor across its vast districts, binding raw elements dredged from mountain veins into fuel for aloof wizard-lords.
c:Bắc Giang:21.2731: When council chiefs declared nine forest clans must share one clearing, the cheeky rangers of {n} simply hung their hammocks from the same boughs.
The archery pavilions of {n} ring with rowdy laughter as scouts wager bags of wild spice on trick shots through hollow willow trunks.
Trickster trappers bound their old woodland camps together into {n}, baffling tax-collectors with shifting rope-bridges and moss-grown paths.
Every harvest feast in {n} ends with living branches bent into dance-floors and boastful hunters toasting the spirits of the deep woods.
c:Kirkuk:35.4681: Raised upon the rubble of an ancient citadel beside the Khasa River, {n} is a labyrinth of boardwalks where rival syndicates haggle over black fire-oil.
Four proud merchant cartels claim the deed to {n}, trading mutual concessions in cedar-paneled counting houses to keep the coin flowing.
Not a single shipment leaves the storehouses of {n} without a web of counter-signed treaties sealed in scented wax.
To wandering traders, {n} is a masterwork of precarious peace, proving that bitter enemies will sit together if the margin of profit is grand enough.
c:Florence:43.7793: Golden coins stamped by the banking houses of {n} dictate the march of distant legions and seat puppet magistrates upon far thrones.
Master artisans and silver-tongued diplomats flock to {n}, where patron princes trade whispered daggers for timeless marble and frescoed domes.
The high dialect born in the debating halls of {n} has become the courtly tongue spoken across half the empire's imperial highways.
Though republican uprisings periodically topple proud dynasties, the real rulers of {n} remain the ledgers tucked inside vault-keeps.
c:Dera Ismail Khan:31.8313: Where the swift waters of the Gomal join the broad Indus, bold thieves wait in the shadows of the river bluffs.
Begun as a desert warlord's encampment, {n} remains the premier haven for caravans carrying unregistered silks and contraband spice.
Under twin moons, smiling cutpurses trade stolen palace trinkets for fast horses, sealed with a toast of date-wine.
Every cellar holds a hidden trapdoor, ensuring that tax collectors find only empty chests and charming shrugs.
c:Nay Pyi Taw:19.745: Carved in secret from the deep brush, {n} was raised overnight by clever huntsmen wishing to confound their foes.
Its sprawling avenues were laid broad enough to spot any lumbering tax-collector leagues before they reach the gates.
High ministers hold council beneath palatial roofs, while woodland spirits cheekily trade state scrolls for wild fruit.
Though crown banners flutter over vast clearings, the surrounding jungle waits patiently to swallow the halls once more.
c:Sargodha:32.0859: Revered as the City of Eagles, {n} is home to daring sky-thieves whose trained raptors snatch purses from the air.
Beneath the jagged shadow of the Kirana Hills, smugglers trade gilded trinkets along streets planned with eerie precision.
Fast-moving caravans slip in under the moons, drawn by reckless bargains and the silver tongues of desert rogues.
Here, even the boldest cutpurse tips a feathered cap, masking brazen plunder with lavish smiles and counterfeit grace.
c:Poznań:52.4069: Flowing gently along the River Warta, {n} remains an antique haven of courtly chivalry and learned scribes.
Each noon, enchanted copper goats clash upon the council hall tower, greeting pilgrims who seek the city's famed cures.
Kindly bakers fold sweet pastes into crescent pastries, gifted in remembrance of a chivalrous knight's open hand.
Beneath the arching vaults of the ancient cathedral, quiet diplomats trade courteous nods and veiled courtly designs.
c:Gent:51.05: At the meeting of the Scheldt and the Leie, {n} stands as a timeless sanctuary of healing water and venerable lore.
In bygone eras, weavers wove fortunes into tapestries charmed against rot, making its guildhalls the envy of northern kings.
Hospitable scholars stroll along canal quays, debating philosophies while treating travelers with warm spiced cordials.
Behind the well-kept stone facades, knights and quiet intriguers play gentle games of influence over moonlit courtyards.
c:Bristol:51.4552: Where the rivers Frome and Avon embrace, {n} rose from ancient earthworks into a sanctuary of fair stone and gentle graces.
Caravels glide into sheltered quays, bringing exotic balms and silk-wrapped tomes to chivalric hospices along the docks.
Once split between rival shires, its courtly burghers bought freedom with gentle diplomacy and barrels of sweet spiced vintage.
Above the misty gorge of the Avon, master builders spun a bridge of iron filigree so light it seems held aloft by wind-sorcery.
Behind tall, painted gables, merchant-scholars whisper of new-found shores while pouring medicinal cordials for weary wanderers.
c:Teresina:-5.0892: Cradled between the calm Parnaíba and the river reeds, {n} is a sun-baked redoubt where the ocean's salt is only a distant myth.
Its charter carves a vow of holy charity over every gate, though trackers know even kindness requires a well-sharpened skinning knife.
Vast leafy canopies of weeping trees shade the wide lanes, murmuring memories to travelers who dare brave the furnace of midday.
River-healers here brew foul-smelling swamp broths that cure serpent bites and mend bones, provided you can answer their riddles.
Across the slow-drifting currents lies a sister settlement, watching quietly as the muddy waters measure the patience of centuries.
c:Cuernavaca:18.9261: Favored with perpetual blossoms, {n} has long been the secluded pleasure garden where emperors and consuls plot their grandest conquests.
The city crest bears a speaking trunk of cedar, a silent decree that even the surrounding timber answers to imperial decree.
Broad paved roads stretch north to the high metropolis, thrumming with legions of envoys, tax-tribute wagons, and ambitious diplomats.
Fortified villas of carved volcanic stone line the hills, hiding garden banquets where treaties are signed and rivals poisoned with equal poise.
Beneath its sunlit colonnades lie relics of the first lawgivers, their colossal stone visages watching the ceaseless cycle of power.
c:Bremen:53.0758: Built upon the broad Weser, {n} opens its warm hearths and guildhalls to every voyager seeking refuge from northern storms.
A towering stone knight stands watch in the market square, guarding the ancient charters of chivalric freedom with drawn blade.
Balladeers tell of four discarded beasts who outwitted highway bandits, their bronze likeness rubbed by travelers seeking fortunate winds.
Farther down the grey river, an exclave of salt-bleached docks serves the city’s merchant-princes with polite and meticulous discretion.
Beneath the gabled halls of merchant scholars, quiet pacts are drafted over cups of spiced wine, healing old feuds without a drop of blood.
c:Palermo:38.1166: Raised upon the southern gulf nearly three millennia ago, {n} began as a blossom of trade planted by seafaring merchants from distant coasts.
Carthaginian mints and Imperial legions both carved their seals into its marble, forging an insular capital hardened by centuries of imperial law.
Golden domes and pointed arches mingle in its basilicas, where desert emirs and northern conquerors once bargained away whole kingdoms.
The grand plazas of {n} still brim with spice merchants, shrewd senators, and veiled diplomats navigating the endless intrigues of the sea.
c:Bengbu:32.9408: Deep in the river hollows lies {n}, long whispered of as the Clam Wharf where river-divers plunge into the silt for glittering freshwater pearls.
Shrewd forest archers trade lustrous river gems for feathered shafts, laughing as they trick foreign merchants with polished clam shells.
Wild feasts erupt along the reed-choked embankments, where smoked river meats and spiced bivalves roast over glowing hollow-tree hearths.
The crafty folk of {n} treat every passing barge as fair game for bold wagers, lively ribaldry, and swift-fingered pearl trades.
c:Kitchener:43.4254: Built as a twin bastion of commerce and order, {n} governs the province's inland roads alongside its sister city in uneasy administrative harmony.
In an era of great war, its magistrates cast off an ancient foreign name through ballot and decree, cementing its loyalty to the regional dominion.
Great manufacturing guildhalls and sprawling rail junctions turned {n} into an industrious hub of wealth, ingenuity, and high commerce.
Clashing merchant councils and rival municipal tribunes scheme over shared boundaries, proving that pen and seal rule as fiercely as the sword.
c:Qom:34.6401: Set beside a sun-parched riverbed, {n} draws millions of desert wanderers across baking sands to the magnificent gold-gilded domes of its holy shrines.
Revered storytellers and austere scholars debate sacred scrolls in its sanctuaries, their words carrying the weight of ancient lineages and unbreakable honor.
Caravans laden with rare black oils and desert crafts rest beneath the shadow of minarets where pilgrims chant of the hidden savior yet to return.
In the bustling bazaars of {n}, dueling masters salute passing devotees, fiercely guarding the sacred peace of their venerable pilgrimage grounds.
c:Sorocaba:-23.5017: Vast legions of muleteers once gathered at {n}, charting the imperial trade routes that knit together a sprawling realm.
Today, thousands of licensed manufactories hammer iron and clockwork destined for distant kingdoms across the great seas.
Paved causeways connect this proud hub to the heart of the macrometropolis, pulsing with envoys, merchants, and gold.
Within its grand stone halls, guildmasters and magistrates negotiate tariffs that can tip the balance of provincial power.
c:Sanhe:39.9805: Here dwell the wandering ascetics of {n}, who labor but one single dawn to earn three days of uninterrupted reverie.
They call themselves demigods of the pavement, spurning the heavy ancestral duties that bind other mortal men.
Solemn guardians look upon them with sorrow, for they cast aside the tombs of their kin to live upon meager copper coins.
Yet whispers of their serene idleness spread across the land like persistent ghosts, defying every decree of the court.
c:Yibin:28.7593: Where the frothing Min embraces the great Yangtze River, the river-hunters of {n} set their wicker traps with a laugh.
Centuries of wine-brewing beneath the whispering bamboo groves have turned every banquet here into a raucous feast.
Green archers skip across knotted vine bridges, daring the clumsy city garrisons to catch them in the swaying reeds.
A thousand lively taverns crowd the docks, pouring fiery grain-spirits that can coax a song from an ancient living tree.
c:Longyan:25.0749: Named for the slumbering dragon coiled within its rocky bluffs, {n} hides hearty clans who dwell in great circular ramparts.
Hunters slip through misty highland forests, loosing whistling arrows at wild boar before vanishing into the hollow woods.
Cheeky trackers love nothing more than leading pompous lowland bailiffs in circles around mossy stone caverns.
When the twilight horn sounds, their timbered halls erupt in feast and jest, celebrating another day wrested from the wild.
c:Kollam:8.8811: Ancient smuggling skiffs slip through the misty backwaters into {n}, laden with stolen spices and eastern plunder.
For thousands of years, corsairs from distant empires have traded contraband under the moons in its secretive lagoons.
The guild-weavers of {n} spin rough coir husks into unbreakable ship cables, prized by caravel-thieves across the seas.
In shadowed markets behind the docks, crafty traders crack roasted foreign moon-nuts and strike bargains sealed in smoke.
c:Bouaké:7.6939: A colossal arena of stone and iron stands within {n}, where forty thousand roaring souls gather to watch champion trials.
Twice in living memory, the greatest champions from across the continent have brought their banners here to contest ultimate glory.
Masons and forgemasters endlessly reinforce the fortress arena, boasting that no warlord's ram could ever crack its gates.
If your footwork falters upon the blood-sanded pitch of {n}, forty thousand voices will laugh before your shield hits the ground.
c:Tasikmalaya:-7.3274: They call {n} the city of a thousand sanctuaries, where cloistered acolytes memorize solemn chants by day and chase whimsy by night.
High in the jagged mountains, half the valley rings with bells of divine joy while the other half broods in exquisite dread.
Crowds of eccentric scholars wander the alleys of {n}, fiercely debating whether holy silence is louder than a madman's drum.
You may enter a peaceful hermitage only to find the venerable sages balancing atop garden stones and giggling at the sky.
c:Xinyi:22.373: In the thick groves of {n}, slender forest champions hoist massive ironwood trunks overhead just to show off at the feast.
A young huntress from {n} famously lifted a charging boar clean over her shoulders, laughing as the elder archers gaped.
Records of strength are shattered each season in the clearings, where youth toss mammoth river stones like pinecones.
Never wager against the smiling maidens of {n}, lest one casually hurl your heaviest iron chest straight across the ravine.
c:Zaria:11.1113: One of the seven ancestral bastions of the realm, {n} was raised by war-chiefs whose lineage yet holds the high seat of honour.
Within the vast halls of its grand academy, scholars debate the secrets of iron, soil, and the craft of enduring sieges.
The guild-tanners of {n} boil hide into cuirasses tough enough to turn an axe, scoffing at any blade light enough to dull.
Upon the high testing fields, bold artificers trial flying contrivances of cloth and timber, defying gravity with a grim grin.
c:Thessaloníki:40.6407: Long hailed as the realm's co-reigning jewel, {n} balances the supreme throne with courts of law and senators steeped in ambition.
Where the Axios meets the Thermaic Gulf, merchant galleys crowd the quays under the watchful gaze of disciplined legionaries.
Every flagstone along its paved imperial ways has witnessed whispered alliances, trade pacts, and the polite poison of diplomats.
Though second in sovereign title, the grandees of {n} boast that true governance and the sharpest minds of state dwell within its walls.
c:Hubballi:15.3478: The great caravan terminus of {n} boasts a single boarding pier stretching longer than an arrow's flight, crowded with shifting contraband.
Eight tracks of wheel and iron cross here, where brazen thieves leap between moving wagons under the silver gleam of twin moons.
Smugglers slip through three secret porticoes into the freight-yards, trading stolen silks and untaxed gems before the watch can blink.
Even the healers who tend wounded footpads in {n} know how to fence a pilfered trinket while binding up a cutlass wound.
c:Leicester:52.6386: Settled where the River Soar winds past ancient woodlands, {n} has long welcomed weary wayfarers with warm hearths and soothing tisanes.
Knights ride through its blossomed courtyards to pledge their swords, guided by codes of courtly courtesy and gentle magic.
Chroniclers praise {n} as the most bountiful haven in the midland shires, where guildsmen thrive and dispute is settled with civil grace.
Beneath the tranquil gardens of its old earthworks, quiet scholars tend to ancient scrolls and the forgotten sepulchres of fallen kings.
c:Warri:5.5174: Deep beneath the delta mud, the iron-masters of {n} tap the boiling black blood of the world to feed their insatiable furnaces.
Armoured river-barges depart its smoky quays daily, laden with liquid flame for the seaward fortresses.
Three proud clans contest its riverbanks with blunt words and heavy blades, yet stand shoulder to shoulder against any invader.
In {n}, an apprentice learns quickly that if your forge does not reek of swamp-pitch and burnt ore, your steel is worthless.
c:Wuwei:37.9267: Any traveler daring the great corridor must pass under the notched bows of {n}, where the woodland scouts keep a merry watch.
The hunters of {n} charge no toll in coin, preferring to nick your salted meats while guiding you through the thorny maze.
Living root-ways and deer-paths meet here, bridging three wild frontiers with laughter, feasts, and roasted game.
Stray off the marked route and the prankster-archers will leave you trussed in a bough until sunrise.
c:Makhachkala:42.9778: Perched between the jagged crags and the gray Caspian Sea, {n} stands as an unbreakable sentinel of the realm.
Its high stone bastion was first raised by an ancient conqueror to bar the eastern waters against raiders.
Sentries from a dozen mountain clans stand post along its ramparts, speaking differing tongues but sharing one iron discipline.
No sail enters the roadstead and no rider descends the high passes without answering the unblinking watch of {n}.
c:Sholapur:17.6715: The cavernous weaving-halls of {n} churn out heavy patterned mantles, prized across the desert for hiding both daggers and stolen loot.
Beneath the twin moons, caravaners trade pungent bundles of rolled smoking-leaf that sweeten the den of any good smuggler.
Massive spindles click and turn through the night, spinning cloth thick enough to muffle the tread of the clumsiest footpad.
Situated at the crux of four great highways, its shadowy bazaars offer swift getaways and even swifter bargains.
c:Fresno:36.7477: Named for the sacred ash groves along the river, {n} rose from a solitary waystation into the grand granary of the realm.
Where iron tracks first bound the province together, merchant magistrates now oversee vast tithes of sun-ripened grain and sweet vine.
Imperial surveyors charted {n} at the empire's verdant heart, ensuring all valley highways paid homage to its counting-houses.
Behind the bustling agricultural exchanges, ambitious prefects broker alliances that sway the provincial senate.
c:Surakarta:-7.5561: In {n}, the courtiers wear bells on their boots to warn the shadows, while the gentle river whispers terrible royal secrets.
The grand throne has a curious trick of birthing mayors who blossom overnight into sovereign rulers, only for their sons to mimic the dance.
Painted puppets govern the morning parliament with sweet laughter, but twilight brings solemn decrees carved in bitter sugar.
Travelers come to {n} seeking gilded silks, yet often leave with crown jewels sewn into their hats and a madness for clockwork bells.
c:Kanazawa:36.6: Born beside a marsh of powdered gold, {n} elevates the beating of precious metal into the highest school of enchantment.
Master artisans here gild spell-scrolls with beaten sun-leaf so fine it wafts upon an incantation's breath.
The high-born magi walk through meticulously sculpted gardens where water, pine, and stone hold perpetual mystical equilibrium.
Ancient dynasties preserve the purest bloodlines and craft traditions, spurning the crude and hurried sorceries of lesser folk.
c:Ribeirão Preto:-21.1775: Built beside the dark waters of an ancient brook, {n} forged its fortune on the bitter black brew that fueled the legions' march.
The coffee barons of old have yielded to cunning bio-alchemists who distill fuel and fortunes from endless seas of sweet cane.
Trade embassies and guildhalls line the grand avenues of {n}, where provincial decrees are bought with sweet nectar and grain-gold.
In {n}, wealth is not merely harvested from the red earth, but wielded like a polished blade in imperial diplomacy.
c:Vilnius:54.6892: An ancient high king dreamed of an iron wolf howling on a frosty crest, and raised {n} as a bastion of battle-hardened honor.
Frost-tested masons carved grand spires that rise against biting blizzards, blending southern stonework with northern defiance.
Letters dispatched to distant climes drew brave smiths and sworn shields to feast beside roaring hearths in great timbered halls.
Across the sprawling stone quarter, warriors swear eternal oaths over horns of winter mead to guard their grand duke's legacy.
c:São José dos Campos:-23.1794: In the workshops of {n}, master artificers draft schematics for winged sky-vessels to secure supremacy across the upper airs.
Straddling the Paraíba valley, the city governs the trade lanes between sprawling metropolises through ruthless legislative decree.
Academy halls echo with the debates of ambitious scholars testing enchanted metals to arm the empire's soaring legions.

c:Takeo:10.9908: Named for an ancient woodland patriarch, {n} hides nimble trackers who know every trick of the twisting canopy.
Cheeky archers skim the marshes beside the Bassac River, laughing as their tripwires leave unwary beast-stalkers dangling upside down.
Around roaring campfires, hunters boast of snaring great swamp lizards before sharing out roasted forest game and sweet wild brews.

c:Zaragoza:41.6561: Founded by ancient legions upon the banks of the Ebro, {n} was engineered as an imperial fortress to master the great river basin.
Behind massive ashlar ramparts, proud magistrate councils preserve hard-won charters of privilege against royal overreach.
At the confluence of mountain waters, merchant galleys pay steep tariffs to unload fine textiles and vintage casks upon stone quays.
In vaulted galleries of state, rival diplomats trade honeyed compliments and subtle poison while negotiating the fate of provinces.
c:Lille:50.6339: Sited upon the calm bends of the Deûle, {n} began as an island sanctuary where chivalrous knights offered safe harbor to wandering pilgrims.

c:Kraków:50.0614: Atop the limestone bluffs above the Vistula, {n} guards the slumbering legacy of kings who tamed a subterranean dragon with gentle wisdom.

c:Prayagraj:25.4448: Where the holy waters of the Ganges and Yamuna meet an invisible third current, {n} welcomes vast multitudes under the twin moons.
Beneath the cover of sanctified rites and smoky festival fires, light-fingered cutpurses relieve wealthy pilgrims of rubies and jade.
By night, shadowy flotillas slip through the sacred mists, smuggling illicit spices and royal seals beneath barge floorboards.
In the grand halls of judgment, silver-tongued advocates and brazen scoundrels bargain away gallows sentences with sly smiles and forged writs.
c:Ahvaz:31.319: Spanning the broad, swift waters of the Karun River, {n} is crowned with soaring bridges where duelists test their blades at twilight.
From the deep sands beneath its foundations seeps the black fire-pitch of the earth, fueling the torches and fierce pride of its forge-keepers.
Desert riders and river bargemen gather in roadside caravanserais, trading tales of ancient empires and maritime conquests under starry skies.
The city's master blademiths temper their scimitars in the river’s cold rush, swearing solemn vows of honor upon every finished hilt.
c:Sanya:18.2544: At the sun-drenched southern tip of the island, {n} is where the wild green jungle spills into turquoise foam and hunters feast upon roasted reef-crabs.
Just beyond the shore, forest-born tide-wardens guard vast beds of living coral, daring foolish poachers to match wits with clever sea-sprites.

Out in the bay, artifice raised an isle of glittering shell-spires where foreign grandees lounge in silk, blissfully unaware of the nimble cutpurses in the palms.
Along the warm sands, barefoot woodland youths train their acrobatic leaps, batting leather sun-globes over high nets of woven vine.
c:Charleroi:50.4114: Founded as a star-bastion along the peaceful Sambre, {n} welcomes travelers with warm hearthfires and the polite whispers of courtly scholars.
Deep beneath its cobbled wards lie rich veins of black ember-stone, mined to heat vast convalescent halls where gentle sisters tend the afflicted.
The guildhalls of {n} are renowned for master glassblowers who spin flawless crystal phials for apothecaries and curved lenses for stargazers.
Knights of noble standing journey here to commission soot-tempered plate, exchanging courtly vows in lantern-lit refectories over spiced mead.
Behind the gracious smiles of its patricians, soft-spoken scribes trade diplomatic secrets and seal quiet alliances over delicate almond pastries.
c:Liverpool:53.4106: Along the broad waters of the Mersey, {n} opens its storied quays to wanderers seeking new fortunes beyond the setting sun.
Its towering stone storehouses were wrought with protective wards so cunning that no mundane flame might ever consume them.
Here scholars laid iron tracks through the countryside, binding distant keeps with carriages propelled by captured steam.
Courteous bards gather in its vaulted riverside taverns, weaving gentle melodies that echo far across the western seas.
Deep within its chivalric merchant halls, quiet whispers and polite smiles chart the passage of precious weaves and foreign silks.
c:San Antonio:29.4241: Born around an ancient mission of stone, {n} stands proud where desert winds meet the long trails of caravan riders.
Sword-masters tell endless tales of the old walled compound where a handful of defenders made their legendary last stand.
Cool waterways wind like polished scimitars beneath stone archways, lined with banquet halls alive with fierce song.
Here every duel is remembered with solemn reverence, for honour in the dust is prized above a cowardly life in silk.
Veteran scouts gather under the harsh sun, recounting past rebellions and the forging of an unyielding desert realm.
c:Taizhou:32.4907: Perched where wild eastern sea breezes tangle in mountain boughs, {n} is a haven for cunning scouts and woodland archers.
Rangers slip between coastal groves to harvest succulent wild fruit, leaving playful snares to baffle clumsy travelers.
Great feasts of roasted saltwater catch and sweet forest preserves are shared beneath the boughs of ancient, living timbers.
Trappers from the misty peaks banter with shore hunters, trading daring tales of surviving coastal storms and sea-sprites.
c:Providence:41.824: Revered as a sanctuary of noble thought, {n} was established under the radiant emblem of an all-seeing watchful eye.
Sages and gentle healers gather in cloistered libraries to debate the sacred rights of every mortal under heaven.
Golden sigils shaped like radiant eyes gleam upon townhouse gates, said to ward off malice and guide benevolent rulers.
Behind courtly manners and grand collegiate facades, scholars quietly unravel esoteric secrets of divine oversight.
c:Yancheng:33.3575: For two thousand winters, tricksters here have boiled down the froth of the Yellow Sea to steal its sparkling white crust.
Hunters swear the white crystal pans of {n} make the finest salt-crust for wild boar roasted over cedar flames.
Sneaky coastal stalkers love nothing more than blinding greedy marsh-trolls with a well-aimed pinch of brine-dust.
What looks like a barren coastal marsh is actually a sprawling playground of hidden blinds, reed-traps, and salted larders.
Outlanders call it the White Shore, but forest rovers know {n} is where the sea surrenders its spice to woodsmoke feasts.
c:Serra:-20.1286: From the sodden reed-beds, lone mount Mestre Álvaro looms so broad that fools mistake one sleepy stone giant for an entire spine of ridges.
The swamp healers of {n} take their time, knowing moss grows faster on an impatient man's boots than on a patient mind.

Ancient willow-boughs dip into the sluggish channels, murmuring remedies for viper-bite to anyone who cares to hush and listen.
c:Muscat:23.5841: Shadowed by the jagged fangs of the Hajar Mountains, gleaming pale ramparts rise where desert riders meet the masters of the tide.

In {n}, an insult answered without a drawn blade is considered worse than losing a fleet to the deep sea.
c:Zhaoqing:23.0489: Seven jagged crags thrust straight out of the mirrored ponds, said to be seven petrified giants outsmarted by a cheeky woodland hare.

k:in-36-agra:Taj Mahal: The legend of {n} began with a silver-tongued minstrel who stole the sorrowful laments of ancient southern bards.

k:pl-83-rybnik:Katowice: Beneath {n}, great veins of black ember-stone once fueled hundreds of bellows, though the smoke has long yielded to serene gardens and scholarly halls.

In the vaulted academies of {n}, scholars study the balance of earth and flame, transmuting ancient soot into soothing tinctures.

k:eg-11-cairo:Cairo: To {n} cross the vast spice-laden caravans of the sands, met at the waters of the Nile by blade-dancers of legendary pride.

w:Q513: {n} rises as the highest watch-tower of the realm, its icy crags touching the frozen breath of the heavens.

k:gh-01-accra:Accra: Two ancient stone fortresses anchor the salt-crusted shores of {n}, their bastions built to defy cannonade and tempest alike.

The crowded alleys of {n} ring with the clang of anvil-smoke and the coarse laughter of grizzled quartermasters.

k:us-ny-new-york-city:Statue of Liberty: At the harbor mouth stands {n}, a copper titan wrought across the seas as a tribute of alliance and unyielding law.

k:mu-18-port-louis:Port Louis: Far across the churning brine, {n} rises as the beacon every corsair and salt-thief seeks by night.

k:tr-34-istanbul:Hagia Sophia: For countless centuries {n} has stood as the marble crown of divine wisdom, outlasting emperors and conquerors alike.
First raised by ancient legates as a basilica, its vaulted halls later echoed with foreign conquerors' rites.

w:Q676203: High in the mist-draped crags above the river sits {n}, guarded by roots and stone that never forget.
In the mountain's open rock belly, carved stepped altars descend into cool, shadowy crypts.

k:sn-01-dakar:Dakar: Built upon the continent's sharpest western spit, {n} juts into the ocean like an anvil defying the breaking surf.

k:so-02-mogadishu:Mogadishu: Coins of foreign mints clink in every arcade of {n}, where the tides themselves seem bound by notarized agreement.
Vast stone storehouses rise along the wharves, brimming with radiant rolls of dyed fabric woven by the city's guilds.
Rival trade princes maintain cold peace across the boardwalks, preferring clever tariff bargains to open brawls.
Inland dust mingles with salty sea winds as desert caravans trade gold nuggets directly to deep-water sea captains.
k:vn-79-ho-chi-minh-city:Tan Son Nhat In: A grand aerie carved into towering canopies, {n} welcomes immense flocks of wing-riders and cargo beasts from across the sea.
Cheeky wind-singers perch along the launching boughs, whistling sharp gusts to guide descending gliders without spilling their baggage.
Millions of wandering rangers and sky-couriers scamper through its leafy pavilions each season, swapping tall tales over roasted meats.
Enormous timber cradles heave day and night, loading mountain-high bundles of trade goods onto the bellies of docile sky-whales.
k:pl-83-katowice:Katowice: Once blackened by subterranean coal veins and roaring foundries, {n} has washed its stones to become a haven of gentler arts.
The heavy bellows of old ironworks have given way to quiet scriptoriums, infirmaries, and halls of chivalric debate.
Gentle apothecaries tend to the ailing of neighboring realms, offering restorative draughts alongside warm hospitality.
Beneath the sweet-tempered bows and hospitable smiles of its courtiers, delicate intrigues shape the trade of the southern marches.
k:us-ma-brockton:Harvard University: Within {n}, the realm's oldest cloisters instruct young gentlefolk in chivalric virtue, statecraft, and the gentle arts of restoration.
For generations, its ivy-clad halls debated which bloodlines and lineages merited entry to the sacred lecture chambers.
Discontented scholars from far provinces petitioned the high magisters, claiming ancestral bias barred them from the gates.
The supreme conclave of judges decreed that no aspirant's lineage could weigh heavier upon the scales than their own merit.
k:us-ma-framingham:Harvard University: {n} stands as a storied sanctuary of learning, where candlelit courtyards welcome knights-errant and gentle herbalists alike.
Great scrolls of enrolment were long guarded by arch-scholars who sought to balance the noble bloodlines within the gates.
Petitioners from far realms challenged the ancient quotas, bringing their grievances before the realm's highest bench.
Now under the sovereign judges' decree, all who seek entry must be weighed solely by character and skill in the scholarly arts.
k:dj-07-djibouti:Djibouti: Founded upon a sun-baked spit by virtue of parchment leases signed with desert sultans, {n} rose where trade routes kiss the gulf.
Here two proud clans of nomadic merchants struck compromises over dockside tariffs and warehouse shares.
More than seven in ten souls of the realm reside along its bustling boardwalks, haggling over silks and foreign coin.

w:Q10285: Crowned in tiered stone and imperial concrete, {n} rises as a monument to dynasty and sovereign triumph.
Tens of thousands gather under towering arches to cheer the clash of champions and roaring exotic beasts.
Legionaries and senators alike watch staged sea-battles in flooded pits, where political fortunes rise and fall on the sand.

k:es-53-la-orotava:Tenerife: Here on {n}, the fierce warrior-maidens contest the leather-ball tourneys upon vast sanded arenas.
Champions flock across the high seas to cross boots with these agile, unyielding shield-captains.

k:es-53-santa-cruz-de-tenerife:Tenerife: Upon the salt-sprayed shores of {n}, an order of maiden duelists contests the league of kicking-spheres.
In their great stone arena, rival companies test their mettle with swift passes and thunderous strikes.

w:x:uluru: Near {n}, thirty-six enormous stone craniums protrude from the red soil, muttering ancient secrets to the wind.

w:x:kilimanjaro: Rising alone above the plateau, {n} stands like an unyielding anvil crowned with eternal ice.
Seven treacherous paths wind up its rocky flanks, testing the lungs and iron will of any foolhardy climber.
Dormant fire slumbers deep in its belly, waiting like an unworked billet inside a silent forge.
The highland clans carved their strongholds upon its lower slopes, scorning those who withered in the heat below.
No mountain stands taller above its plain, a blunt monument to endurance that breaks all who lack resolve.
w:Q39231: High above the misty valleys, {n} lifts its perfectly balanced cone of snow like an enchanted crown of frost and slumbering fire.
Arcane scholars deem {n} the foremost of the three sacred spires, where ancient ley lines gather in pristine and unbroken harmony.
Master calligraphers and glass-weavers climb its terraces, seeking to capture the immaculate contour of {n} upon silk and crystal.
Though the volcano has slept quietly for centuries, fire-diviners study the subtle hum beneath {n} to divine the empire's fate.
Generations of highborn pilgrims have ascended the stair of {n}, purifying their ancestral robes in its crisp, rarefied winds.
k:bd-84-chattogram:Chittagong: In the roaring trade district of the great port, {n} rises as a gilded palace of lodging for the wealthiest caravan masters.
Scaffolding still clings to {n}, where daring cutpurses already mark out balcony routes and vault doors before the mortar is dry.
It is whispered that cunning smugglers funded {n} so that lucrative bargains could be struck far above the crowded wharves.
When its crystal lanterns finally blaze, {n} will host lavish grandees while cat-footed thieves test the locks on every floor.
w:Q35525: From the polished halls of {n}, the sovereign’s chief herald faces the daily barrage of inquisitive scribes and chroniclers.
Within {n}, an unswerving tongue is worth more than a legion of shields, parrying political unrest before sundown.
The court speaker of {n} holds grand influence over the provinces, yet can be dismissed in an instant should their speech falter.
Rumors drift through the marble colonnades of {n} whenever the herald’s dais sits empty, leaving ambassadors to weigh the silence.
k:tz-23-dar-es-salaam:Dar es Salaam: Once a muster-yard for the old army’s baggage porters, {n} now roars as a sprawling stronghold of ironware, provisions, and trade.
Across city blocks of crowded stalls, the smiths of {n} hawk everything from ox-shoes to heavy cleavers with deafening bluntness.
The brawny champions of the Red Lion guild train nearby, proving that {n} still breeds folk built for heavy burdens and fierce contests.
If an armor joint breaks or a wagon snaps, the rugged dealers of {n} will mend it—or mock you soundly for carrying cheap, brittle ore.
k:ae-03-dubai:Burj Khalifa: From miles across the barren waste, caravan masters steer their camels by {n}, a glittering needle raised toward the scorching sun.
Swashbucklers and daring duelists boast of sword-bouts fought upon high terraces where the desert winds howl like hungry drakes.
{n} rises higher than any spire in the realm, a grand monument of glass and steel forged to proclaim the boundless pride of merchant lords.

k:de-16-berlin:Berlin Wall: Where a grim barrier of sundering stone once severed families, {n} now welcomes wanderers with warm hearths and mended vows.

Courtly knights and gracious envoys wander the grand promenades of {n}, weaving quiet treaties over cups of fragrant spiced wine.
The scars of ancient sieges and divided realms have blossomed into gardens where gentle charms ensure that no traveler is turned away.
w:Q43473: Deep within the emerald canopy, ancient god-kings carved {n} from living stone, now embraced by the laughing roots of great banyans.

The vine-choked libraries of {n} harbor playful wood-spirits who rearrange forgotten scrolls to lead boastful explorers in dizzying circles.

w:Q39671: Raised across the rolling downs, the mighty ring of {n} draws gentle astromancers who chart the celestial dances of the moons and stars.
Lords of generous spirit once commissioned these colossal upright stones to furnish honest labor and grain for peasants during bitter blights.
Courtly herbalists whisper soft enchantments among the lintels, drawing subterranean currents to soothe weary pilgrims and heal sick cattle.
At the dawn of the summer solstice, scholarly knights gather in solemn silence to watch the first golden rays pierce the great portal.
w:Q524: A jagged crown of ash looms over the trade roads of the southern gulf, casting long shadows across the empire's wealthiest shores.
Beneath the broken summit sleeps a furnace that once swallowed grand provincial villas and marble baths in a single daylight hour.
Scribes still preserve the frantic letters of a young scholar who watched the heavens turn black with pulverised stone.
Ambitious patricians plant sweet vineyards across the lower terraces, gambling fortunes against the restless slumber of {n}.
w:Q34221: Where two rival border-realms meet, the earth splits into a roaring crescent that thunders through mist-shrouded gorges.
Massive water-wheels and brass mechanisms harness the violent plunge to drive the realm's foremost mills and mints downriver.
Emissaries negotiate treaties upon grand pavilions perpetually damp with the spray of three sister cataracts.
Newly wed patricians journey hundreds of leagues along paved military roads to exchange vows before the deafening cascade of {n}.
k:gb-eng-trowbridge:Stonehenge: High upon wind-swept bluffs stands an unbroken circle of cast stone, raised by a wealthy patron to honour fallen knights.

Scholars and astronomers gather at the solstice to measure the light filtering between the silent pillars.
Mourners from nearby hamlets still place wreaths of mountain lavender at the central altar to pray for peace.
k:es-53-arona:Tenerife: Upon a rugged island of volcanic stone, an acclaimed sisterhood of athletic champions contests the realm's grand tourney.

Corsairs and seafaring merchants crowd the taverns of {n} to sing tavern-ballads of the club's indomitable courage.

w:Q5684: In the shadowed boardwalks of {n}, rival merchant syndicates fund the most extravagant mystery-plays ever staged upon water.

w:Q583: The colossal white peak of {n} pierces the clouds, where rival imperial legations endlessly dispute the exact boundary of the summit.

w:Q37200: Raised by an ancient king across a generation of toil, the titanic stone crown of {n} defies the howling sands and passing ages.

k:br-05-cruz-das-almas:Universidade Fede: Boundary stones at {n} are hammered deep into the bedrock, etched with ancient blood-pacts that soft-handed prospectors keep trying to ignore.

k:br-05-feira-de-santana:Universidade Fe: At {n}, ancient clan-rings mark the boundaries of land held long before the first foreign ships grated against the shore.

k:br-15-belo-horizonte:Pontifícia Univer: When the old mountain seat choked on its own gold-dust, wise planners drew {n} upon the rolling hills like an intricate reed-trap.

k:br-21-queimados:Christ the Redeemer: High above the jungle mists on the hump-backed peak of Corcovado, {n} stands with arms spread wide enough to embrace a tempest.

k:br-21-rio-de-janeiro:Christ the Redeem: Perched upon the precipice of Corcovado, {n} spreads its great arms of soapstone over the steaming lowlands and winding creeks.

k:eg-06-alexandria:Library of Alexandria: Behind the salted sea-walls, {n} guards whole quarters of pristine brick and timber, unyielding as a drawn scimitar.

k:de-05-frankfurt-am-main:European Centr: Within the grand vaults of {n}, mint-masters govern the weight and purity of coin for half the known provinces.

k:de-05-wiesbaden:European Central Bank: Within the towering redoubts of {n}, master mint-masters govern the weight, purity, and circulation of all standard coin.

k:my-14-kuala-lumpur:Petronas Towers: Two enormous, mirrored spires of iron-bark shoot into the canopy, linked midway by a daring rope-bridge where pranksters test the nerve of novice climbers.

k:tr-34-istanbul:Sultan Ahmed Mosque: Built by an ambitious sovereign to rival the grandest relics of antiquity, {n} crowns the imperial capital with soaring blue-tiled majesty.

w:Q62378: Shaped like an immense spire of cut crystal, {n} pierces the river mists to gather starlight for the realm's courtly scholars and healers.

k:it-07-rome:Basilica of Saint Paul outs: Beyond the ancient fortifications of the capital stands {n}, a sovereign sanctuary founded upon the tomb of the great apostle-lawgiver.

w:Q212946: Carved low beneath the jagged Alpine crests, {n} serves as the grandest gateway for marching legions and ambitious merchants alike.

w:Q834893: High upon the jagged mountain ridges of {n}, the forest conceals monstrous pitcher-vines with traps large enough to swallow unwary vermin whole.

k:br-21-queimados:Sugarloaf Mountain: Rising abruptly from the surrounding flats, the ancient crag of {n} serves as an unmistakable guide for weary trackers.

k:cl-12-santiago:University of Chile: Within {n}, scholars and legates map the ribbon-like empire squeezed between towering peaks and the boundless ocean.

k:de-01-sinsheim:Speyer Cathedral: Raised where an ancient legion camp once guarded the river, {n} grew into a monumental sanctuary of imperial authority.

w:Q235878: Famed as a haven of ten thousand winged beasts, where bold poachers once trapped plumage fit for an emperor's ransom.

w:Q1244337: Massive stone mesas rise straight from the mist in {n}, older than memory and indifferent to the scurry of mortals below.
